en.summary: A loop diuretic that increases sodium and chloride excretion.

indications: Edema with cardiac, hepatic or renal disease; oral treatment also for hypertension. Injection is adjunctive for acute pulmonary edema.

majorWarnings: Dehydration, hypovolemia, electrolyte disturbances and ototoxicity; hepatic encephalopathy risk in cirrhosis. Rapid IV dosing and ototoxic combinations increase risk.

monitoring: Volume status, electrolytes, creatinine/BUN; blood pressure, glucose and uric acid as appropriate.

en.summary: A GnRH agonist that suppresses gonadotropins with sustained exposure.

indications: US 3.6 mg implant: selected prostate cancer, endometriosis, endometrial thinning before ablation and selected advanced breast cancer. The 10.8 mg product has its own indications.
contraindications: GnRH or analog hypersensitivity. The US 3.6 mg label contraindicates pregnancy except selected advanced breast-cancer palliation.
majorWarnings: Initial hormone and tumor flare, glycemic or QT risks, bone loss, injection injury and severe skin reactions.
majorInteractions: Assess arrhythmia risk from QT-prolonging combinations during androgen deprivation.
monitoring: Indication-specific follow-up, glycemia, bone health and ECG/electrolytes as indicated.

notes: Initial hormone rise precedes sustained suppression. The US label reports castrate testosterone in men after about 2–4 weeks.
timeCourse.effectTimelineNote: The goserelin implant releases continuously; the cited source has no single-dose Tmax or half-life for a peak-and-decay curve, so no timeline is drawn.

contraindications: GnRH or GnRH agonist hypersensitivity, or pregnancy.
majorWarnings: Transient hormone flare, implant complications, mood symptoms, seizures, severe skin reactions and pediatric intracranial hypertension.

zh-CN.summary: 口服合成雌激素。临床风险和用量需按具体产品判断。

indications: 可作为复方口服避孕药的雌激素成分。所引 Jinteli 是用于绝经症状的另一种复方。
contraindications: 所引 Jinteli 复方禁忌包括血栓性疾病、肝病、乳腺癌、雌激素依赖性肿瘤、不明原因出血、妊娠及成分过敏。
majorWarnings: 关注血栓风险。WPATH SOC8 不建议将炔雌醇用于性别肯定激素治疗。
majorInteractions: 含炔雌醇的制剂可能受 CYP3A4 诱导剂或抑制剂影响。
monitoring: 所引绝经治疗复方需随访异常出血，甲状腺替代治疗者关注甲状腺功能。

en.summary: A synthetic oral estrogen. Clinical risks and dosing are product-specific.

indications: A component of combined oral contraceptives. The cited Jinteli is a separate menopausal combination.
contraindications: Jinteli combination exclusions include thrombosis, liver disease, breast cancer, estrogen-dependent tumors, unexplained bleeding, pregnancy and hypersensitivity.
majorWarnings: Thrombotic risk warrants attention. WPATH SOC8 advises against ethinyl estradiol in gender-affirming hormone therapy.
majorInteractions: CYP3A4 induction or inhibition may affect ethinyl-estradiol products.
monitoring: In the cited menopausal combination, evaluate bleeding and thyroid function during thyroid replacement.

zh-CN.summary: 合成孕激素。以下资料采用美国 Provera 口服片标签。

indications: 继发性闭经、排除器质性病变后的激素失衡相关出血，以及特定绝经后雌激素方案中的内膜增生预防。
contraindications: 不明生殖道出血、乳腺癌或病史或疑诊、激素依赖性肿瘤、血栓性疾病或病史、肝病、严重过敏和妊娠或疑似妊娠。
majorWarnings: 注意异常出血、水肿及合用雌激素时的血栓、卒中和乳腺风险。
majorInteractions: CYP3A4 诱导剂或抑制剂可能影响代谢。
monitoring: 持续异常出血和体液潴留，联合绝经激素治疗按个体风险随访。

notes: 进食可提高所引 10 mg 片剂的暴露。

doseUseReferences.amountText: 每日 5 mg 或 10 mg，连续 5–10 日。
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日，疗程 5–10 日

mechanisms: 促进受雌激素作用的子宫内膜分泌期转化。

en.summary: Synthetic progestogen. This information is scoped to US Provera tablets.

indications: Secondary amenorrhea, hormonal bleeding after excluding organic pathology, and endometrial protection with specified postmenopausal estrogen therapy.
contraindications: Unexplained bleeding, breast cancer/history/suspicion, hormone-dependent tumors, thromboembolism/history, liver disease, severe allergy and known/suspected pregnancy.
majorWarnings: Abnormal bleeding and edema. Combined estrogen therapy carries thrombotic, stroke and breast risks.
majorInteractions: CYP3A4 inducers or inhibitors may affect metabolism.
monitoring: Persistent abnormal bleeding and fluid retention. Individualized follow-up for combined menopausal therapy.

notes: Food can increase exposure after the cited 10 mg tablet.

doseUseReferences.amountText: 5 mg or 10 mg daily for 5–10 days.
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Daily for 5–10 days

mechanisms: Promotes secretory changes in estrogen-primed endometrium.

zh-CN.summary: 口服合成孕激素。醋酸酯给药后转化为炔诺酮。

indications: 美国所引片剂用于继发性闭经、子宫内膜异位症及排除器质性病变后的激素失衡相关出血。
contraindications: 已知或疑似妊娠、未明阴道出血、乳腺癌或病史、静脉血栓或病史、活动性或近期动脉血栓事件、肝病及成分过敏。
majorWarnings: 关注血栓、水钠潴留、抑郁复发及异常出血。
monitoring: 异常出血、情绪和体液状态，按风险评估血脂与血糖。

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日，起始两周

mechanisms: 在雌激素作用后的子宫内膜引起分泌期改变。

en.summary: An oral progestogen ester converted to norethindrone after administration.

indications: The cited US tablets treat secondary amenorrhea, endometriosis and hormonal bleeding without organic pathology.
contraindications: Pregnancy/suspicion, unexplained vaginal bleeding, breast cancer/history, venous thrombosis/history, active or recent arterial thrombosis, liver disease or hypersensitivity.
majorWarnings: Thrombotic risk, fluid retention, recurrent depression and abnormal bleeding.
monitoring: Bleeding, mood, volume status and risk-based glucose or lipid assessment.

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Daily, initial two weeks

zh-CN.summary: 口服 GnRH 受体拮抗剂。

indications: 美国 Orgovyx 说明书用于成人晚期前列腺癌。
contraindications: 对瑞卢戈利或制剂成分有严重过敏史。
majorWarnings: 注意 QT 间期延长、严重过敏及妊娠暴露风险。
majorInteractions: 口服 P-gp 抑制剂可增加暴露，P-gp 与强 CYP3A 联合诱导剂可降低暴露。
monitoring: 前列腺癌用药按标签随访 PSA，升高时检测睾酮。有 QT 风险时关注心电图和电解质。

notes: 标签另列平均有效半衰期 25 小时。

en.summary: An oral GnRH receptor antagonist.

indications: US Orgovyx: advanced prostate cancer in adults.
contraindications: Severe hypersensitivity to relugolix or formulation components.
majorWarnings: QT prolongation, severe hypersensitivity and fetal risk.
majorInteractions: Oral P-gp inhibitors can raise exposure. Combined P-gp and strong CYP3A induction lowers exposure.
monitoring: Follow PSA in prostate cancer, and measure testosterone if PSA rises. ECG and electrolytes when QT risk warrants.

notes: The label separately reports a mean effective half-life of 25 hours.

zh-CN.summary: 单成分口服合成孕激素。

indications: 其他干预不合适时，用于绝经前孕激素不足相关的部分月经问题，或绝经后与雌激素组成周期治疗。
contraindications: 脑膜瘤或其病史、已知或疑似乳腺癌、雌激素依赖性肿瘤、原因不明的生殖道出血、未治疗的子宫内膜增生、血栓或血栓倾向、近期或活动性动脉血栓性疾病、肝功能仍异常的肝病、卟啉病或过敏。
majorWarnings: 累积暴露和治疗时间增加会提高脑膜瘤风险。
majorInteractions: 部分抗癫痫药、利福平等酶诱导剂可能降低孕激素效应。
monitoring: 定期复核继续用药的必要性，按法国说明书评估脑膜瘤风险和磁共振检查。

en.summary: A single-ingredient oral synthetic progestogen.

indications: When other options are unsuitable, selected premenopausal menstrual disorders related to progesterone deficiency or cyclic therapy with an estrogen after menopause.
contraindications: Meningioma or history of it, known or suspected breast cancer, estrogen-dependent tumors, unexplained genital bleeding, untreated endometrial hyperplasia, venous thrombosis or thrombophilia, active or recent arterial thromboembolism, liver disease with unresolved abnormalities, porphyria or hypersensitivity.
majorWarnings: Meningioma risk increases with cumulative exposure and duration.
majorInteractions: Enzyme inducers such as rifampicin and certain antiseizure drugs may reduce the progestogen effect.
monitoring: Periodically reassess need for therapy and follow the French label for meningioma risk assessment and MRI.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the French label.

doseUseReferences.indication: Premenopausal menstrual disorders related to progesterone deficiency
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally daily on cycle days 16 through 25

mechanisms: Activates progesterone receptors.

zh-CN.summary: 供吞服的雌二醇片剂。

indications: 缓解绝经相关血管舒缩症状、治疗外阴及阴道萎缩和某些低雌激素状态。
该美国说明书也包括特定肿瘤的姑息治疗与适当人群的骨质疏松预防。
contraindications: 妊娠、原因不明的生殖道出血、雌激素依赖性肿瘤、既往或活动性静脉血栓、近期动脉血栓事件、肝病或过敏。已知、疑似或既往乳腺癌也属禁忌，特定转移性乳腺癌的姑息治疗除外。
majorWarnings: 全身雌激素可增加血栓和卒中风险。有子宫时，单用雌激素可增加子宫内膜癌风险。
majorInteractions: CYP3A4 诱导剂或抑制剂可能改变雌激素暴露。
monitoring: 评估异常出血，定期复核用药。合用甲状腺激素替代治疗时检查甲状腺功能。

notes: 吞服后经历肝脏首过代谢，雌二醇与雌酮可相互转化。

en.summary: Estradiol tablets for swallowing.

indications: Menopausal vasomotor symptoms, vulvovaginal atrophy and certain hypoestrogenic states.
The US label also includes selected palliative oncology indications and osteoporosis prevention in appropriate patients.
contraindications: Pregnancy, unexplained genital bleeding, estrogen-dependent tumors, current or past venous thrombosis, recent arterial thrombosis, liver disease or hypersensitivity. Known, suspected or previous breast cancer is also contraindicated except for selected metastatic palliative use.
majorWarnings: Systemic estrogen may increase thromboembolism and stroke risk. Unopposed estrogen raises endometrial cancer risk in people with a uterus.
majorInteractions: CYP3A4 inducers or inhibitors may alter estrogen exposure.
monitoring: Evaluate abnormal bleeding and reassess therapy periodically. Check thyroid function in patients taking thyroid replacement.

notes: Swallowed estradiol undergoes hepatic first-pass metabolism and interconverts with estrone.
Tmax and half-life come from single-dose data for the cited oral combination product; the 24-hour window is daily dosing.

tmax.basis: Activella label: peak plasma estradiol within 5–8 h; table median 6 h (range 0.5–16 h)

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Activella label: 12–14 h after a single dose

effectTimelineWindow.basis: Once-daily dosing interval; plot range only

timeCourse.effectTimelineNote: Approximate visualization of the plasma concentration time course.

doseUseReferences.indication: Menopausal vasomotor symptoms or vulvovaginal atrophy
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally once daily with cyclic administration per label

mechanisms: Acts through estrogen receptors.

contraindications: 乳腺癌或雌激素依赖性恶性肿瘤、原因不明的生殖道出血、未治疗的子宫内膜增生、静脉血栓或血栓倾向、活动性或近期动脉血栓性疾病、肝功能仍异常的肝病、卟啉病或过敏。
majorWarnings: 治疗前评估血栓与乳腺癌风险。保留子宫者需评估内膜保护。
majorInteractions: 卡马西平、利福平、圣约翰草等酶诱导剂可降低雌激素暴露。
monitoring: 定期复核获益和风险，评估治疗后持续或新发的异常出血。

notes: 约 6–8 小时可出现第二个峰。

en.summary: Estradiol valerate is an estradiol ester. Oral strength is expressed as estradiol valerate.

indications: Symptoms of estrogen deficiency after menopause.
Postmenopausal osteoporosis prevention in patients at high fracture risk when other approved medicines are unsuitable.
contraindications: Breast cancer or estrogen-dependent malignancy, unexplained genital bleeding, untreated endometrial hyperplasia, venous thromboembolism or thrombophilia, active or recent arterial thromboembolic disease, liver disease with unresolved abnormalities, porphyria or hypersensitivity.
majorWarnings: Assess thrombotic and breast cancer risks before therapy. Evaluate endometrial protection in patients with a uterus.
majorInteractions: Enzyme inducers such as carbamazepine, rifampicin and St John’s wort may reduce estrogen exposure.
monitoring: Periodically reassess benefits and risks, and investigate persistent or new abnormal bleeding.

notes: A second peak may occur around 6–8 hours.
The 27-hour value is an excretion half-life, not a universal plasma terminal half-life; the 24-hour window is daily dosing.

contraindications: 妊娠，或对 GnRH、GnRH 激动剂或制剂成分过敏。

monitoring: 按制剂说明书检查 LH 或性激素，随访身高和骨龄。

en.summary: Intramuscular leuprolide acetate depots come in distinct strengths and administration intervals.

indications: Central precocious puberty
contraindications: Pregnancy or hypersensitivity to GnRH, GnRH agonists or formulation ingredients.
majorWarnings: Hormones can rise transiently at initiation. Psychiatric symptoms, convulsions, severe skin reactions and intracranial hypertension in children have also been reported.
majorInteractions: The label reports no formal pharmacokinetic interaction studies. Consider seizure risk with concomitant medicines that may lower seizure threshold.
monitoring: Check LH or sex steroids per the product label and follow height and bone age.

notes: Peak timing is from adults receiving the monthly depot.

tmax.basis: Approximate mean after one adult IM dose. Assay also detected the major inactive metabolite.

doseUseReferences.population: Children treated according to the US pediatric label
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Intramuscularly once every 24 weeks

mechanisms: Continued exposure downregulates the pituitary response to GnRH and reduces gonadotropin secretion.

zh-CN.summary: 所引产品为双羟萘酸曲普瑞林缓释注射剂，标示强度按曲普瑞林计。

indications: 中枢性性早熟
contraindications: 妊娠，或对 GnRH、GnRH 激动剂或制剂成分过敏。
majorWarnings: 初期可出现激素短暂升高。也有精神症状、惊厥、严重皮肤反应和儿童颅内压升高的报告。
majorInteractions: 说明书提醒谨慎合用可升高泌乳素的药物。
monitoring: 按制剂说明书检查 LH 或性激素，随访身高和骨龄。

notes: 峰值时间来自该 24 周制剂的儿科数据。

tmax.basis: 2–9 岁性早熟儿童肌内注射后

doseUseReferences.formulation: 双羟萘酸盐缓释注射剂
doseUseReferences.amountText: 22.5 mg 曲普瑞林，相当于约 31 mg 双羟萘酸曲普瑞林
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每 24 周肌内注射一次

mechanisms: 持续用药可降低垂体对 GnRH 的反应，减少促性腺激素分泌。

en.summary: The cited product is a triptorelin pamoate depot with labeled strength expressed as triptorelin.

indications: Central precocious puberty
contraindications: Pregnancy or hypersensitivity to GnRH, GnRH agonists or formulation ingredients.
majorWarnings: Hormones can rise transiently at initiation. Psychiatric symptoms, convulsions, severe skin reactions and intracranial hypertension in children have also been reported.
majorInteractions: The label cautions about concomitant use of drugs that raise prolactin.
monitoring: Check LH or sex steroids per the product label and follow height and bone age.

notes: Peak timing is from the pediatric study of this 24-week depot.

tmax.basis: After IM dosing in children aged 2–9 with precocious puberty

doseUseReferences.amountText: 22.5 mg triptorelin, equivalent to about 31 mg triptorelin pamoate
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Intramuscularly once every 24 weeks

mechanisms: Continued exposure downregulates the pituitary response to GnRH and reduces gonadotropin secretion.

zh-CN.summary: 合成孕激素。此处引用 1.5 mg 单成分口服紧急避孕片的资料。

majorInteractions: CYP3A4 诱导剂可能降低紧急避孕效果。
monitoring: 若预期月经推迟超过一周，评估妊娠。

en.summary: A synthetic progestogen. These details describe the single-ingredient 1.5 mg oral emergency contraceptive.

indications: Emergency contraception after unprotected intercourse or contraceptive failure.
contraindications: The product should not be used in established pregnancy or with hypersensitivity to levonorgestrel or product ingredients.
majorWarnings: Menstrual changes may occur. Evaluate for ectopic pregnancy if significant lower abdominal pain or pregnancy occurs after use.
majorInteractions: CYP3A4 inducers may reduce emergency contraceptive effectiveness.
monitoring: Evaluate for pregnancy if expected menses are delayed by more than a week.

zh-CN.summary: 将黄体酮微粒化制成口服胶囊。

indications: 保留子宫且使用结合雌激素的绝经后女性，预防子宫内膜增生。
继发性闭经。
contraindications: 原因不明的生殖道出血、已知或疑似乳腺癌、血栓病史或活动性血栓、肝病、已知或疑似妊娠、对制剂成分过敏。所引胶囊含花生油。
majorWarnings: 可能嗜睡或头晕。和雌激素合用时应评估血栓等风险。
majorInteractions: 体外资料提示 CYP3A4 抑制剂可增加暴露，临床影响程度不明。
monitoring: 评估异常出血、嗜睡或眩晕，定期复核合并雌激素的适用性。

notes: 该说明书报告服药后约 3 小时内达峰。

tmax.basis: 绝经后女性连续服 100 mg，第 5 天平均值

doseUseReferences.population: 保留子宫并使用结合雌激素的绝经后女性
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每 28 天周期内连续 12 天睡前服用

mechanisms: 黄体酮受体激动作用。

en.summary: Oral capsules containing micronized progesterone.

indications: Prevention of endometrial hyperplasia in postmenopausal women with a uterus taking conjugated estrogens.
Secondary amenorrhea.
contraindications: Unexplained genital bleeding, known or suspected breast cancer, active or prior thrombosis, liver disease, known or suspected pregnancy or hypersensitivity. The cited capsules contain peanut oil.
majorWarnings: May cause drowsiness or dizziness. Assess risks including thrombosis when combined with estrogen.
majorInteractions: In vitro evidence suggests CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase exposure. Clinical magnitude is unknown.
monitoring: Evaluate abnormal bleeding, drowsiness or dizziness, and periodically reassess combined estrogen therapy.

notes: The label reports peaks within approximately three hours.

tmax.basis: Day 5 mean after repeated 100 mg in postmenopausal women

doseUseReferences.population: Postmenopausal women with a uterus taking conjugated estrogens
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: At bedtime for 12 consecutive days of each 28-day cycle

mechanisms: Progesterone receptor agonism.

zh-CN.summary: 苯海索的盐酸盐，一种中枢抗胆碱药。

indications: 辅助治疗帕金森综合征及控制特定药物诱发的锥体外系反应。
contraindications: 所引美国口服液说明书将对成分过敏及窄角型青光眼列为禁忌。
majorWarnings: 可能引起口干、便秘、尿潴留、视物模糊或认知混乱。可升高眼压，也可能加重迟发性运动障碍。
majorInteractions: 与左旋多巴合用时，说明书提示可能需依据症状和不良反应调整剂量。
monitoring: 片剂说明书建议眼科房角检查和定期监测眼压。随访排尿、排便及精神状态。

notes: 单次给药的血浆达峰时间。

tmax.basis: 8 名健康男性单次口服 4 mg，血浆放射免疫法均值

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 口服，后续根据耐受和疗效逐步调整

en.summary: The hydrochloride salt of trihexyphenidyl, a centrally acting anticholinergic.

indications: Adjunctive treatment of parkinsonism and control of extrapyramidal reactions from certain medicines.
contraindications: The cited US oral solution label lists hypersensitivity to ingredients and narrow-angle glaucoma as contraindications.
majorWarnings: May cause dry mouth, constipation, urinary retention, blurred vision or confusion. May raise intraocular pressure or worsen tardive dyskinesia.
majorInteractions: When combined with levodopa, the label notes that dose adjustment may be needed based on symptoms and adverse effects.
monitoring: The tablet label calls for gonioscopy and periodic intraocular pressure monitoring. Follow urinary and bowel function and mental status.

notes: Time to peak plasma concentration after one dose.

tmax.basis: Plasma radioimmunoassay mean in eight healthy men after one oral 4 mg dose

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally, with later titration based on tolerance and response

zh-CN.summary: 口服苯二氮䓬类药物，有镇静作用。

indications: 成人广泛性焦虑障碍急性期，以及伴或不伴广场恐惧的惊恐障碍。
contraindications: 对本品或其他苯二氮䓬类过敏，或正在使用强 CYP3A 抑制剂（利托那韦按说明书另行处理）。
majorWarnings: 有镇静、呼吸抑制、依赖和戒断风险。持续用药后骤停可诱发惊厥。
majorInteractions: 与阿片类、酒精及其他中枢抑制剂合用可加重镇静和呼吸抑制。
monitoring: 定期评估症状、继续用药必要性、镇静和依赖风险。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 健康成人范围，均值约 11.2 小时

doseUseReferences.indication: 广泛性焦虑障碍急性期
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 口服，每日三次

en.summary: An oral benzodiazepine with sedative effects.

indications: Acute generalized anxiety disorder and panic disorder, with or without agoraphobia, in adults.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to this drug or other benzodiazepines, or strong CYP3A inhibitor use, with label-specific management for ritonavir.
majorWarnings: Sedation, respiratory depression, dependence and withdrawal may occur. Abrupt cessation after continued use can trigger seizures.
majorInteractions: Opioids, alcohol and other CNS depressants can worsen sedation and respiratory depression.
monitoring: Reassess symptoms, ongoing need, sedation and dependence risk regularly.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Range in healthy adults, mean approximately 11.2 hours

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally three times daily

zh-CN.summary: 此条目为苯丙胺，所引临床用量按硫酸苯丙胺片计。混合盐缓释胶囊属于不同制剂。

indications: 美国硫酸苯丙胺片说明书列有发作性睡病和 ADHD，另有其他治疗无效时短期辅助治疗外源性肥胖的用途。
contraindications: 苯丙胺制剂过敏，使用单胺氧化酶抑制剂期间或停药后 14 天内。
majorWarnings: 有滥用、依赖、血压升高、心率加快及精神症状风险。严重心脏病患者尤其需要评估。
majorInteractions: 与 MAOI 合用可引发高血压危象。某些促血清素药可增加血清素综合征风险。
monitoring: 核对心脏病和抽动病史，随访血压、心率、食欲、儿童生长及精神症状。

doseUseReferences.amountText: 起始每日 10 mg 硫酸苯丙胺
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 醒来后服首剂，后续根据反应调整

en.summary: This is the amphetamine entry. Clinical doses below are expressed for amphetamine sulfate tablets. Mixed-salt extended-release capsules are a distinct product.

indications: The US amphetamine sulfate tablet label lists narcolepsy, ADHD and short-term adjunctive use for exogenous obesity refractory to other treatments.
contraindications: Amphetamine product hypersensitivity or MAOI use during treatment or within the preceding 14 days.
majorWarnings: Risks include misuse, dependence, increased blood pressure or heart rate, and psychiatric symptoms. Serious cardiac disease warrants particular assessment.
majorInteractions: MAOIs can precipitate a hypertensive crisis. Other serotonergic medicines may increase the risk of serotonin syndrome.
monitoring: Check cardiac and tic history and monitor blood pressure, pulse, appetite, pediatric growth and psychiatric symptoms.

doseUseReferences.amountText: Initially 10 mg amphetamine sulfate per day
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: First dose on awakening, with subsequent titration by response

zh-CN.summary: 莫达非尼的 R 对映体，制成口服片。

indications: 改善成人发作性睡病、阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停或轮班工作睡眠障碍相关的过度嗜睡。阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停仍需处理基础气道问题。
contraindications: 对阿莫达非尼、莫达非尼或制剂成分过敏。
majorWarnings: 关注严重皮疹和多器官过敏反应、精神症状及持续嗜睡。
majorInteractions: 可降低某些激素避孕药及环孢素的暴露，并升高部分 CYP2C19 底物浓度。
monitoring: 复评嗜睡及驾驶风险，必要时随访血压、心率和精神症状。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 表观终末消除

doseUseReferences.indication: 轮班工作睡眠障碍相关嗜睡
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 轮班开始前约 1 小时口服

en.summary: The R-enantiomer of modafinil in oral tablet form.

indications: Improves wakefulness in adults with excessive sleepiness related to narcolepsy, obstructive sleep apnea or shift work disorder. Underlying airway obstruction still requires management.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to armodafinil, modafinil or product ingredients.
majorWarnings: Watch for severe rash, multiorgan hypersensitivity, psychiatric symptoms and persistent sleepiness.
majorInteractions: Can reduce exposure to certain hormonal contraceptives and cyclosporine, and raise levels of some CYP2C19 substrates.
monitoring: Reassess sleepiness and driving risk, and monitor blood pressure, pulse and psychiatric symptoms as appropriate.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Apparent terminal elimination

doseUseReferences.indication: Sleepiness associated with shift work disorder
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally approximately one hour before the work shift

zh-CN.summary: 所引口服片采用盐酸丁螺环酮，临床剂量按所引产品的标示计。

drugClass: 非苯二氮䓬类抗焦虑药
indications: 用于焦虑障碍或短期缓解焦虑症状。支持疗效的试验对象主要与广泛性焦虑障碍相近。
contraindications: 对本品过敏，或使用治疗抑郁的 MAOI 及相关 14 天洗脱期。使用利奈唑胺或静脉亚甲蓝期间不得新开始该药。
majorWarnings: 可能出现头晕和恶心，促血清素合用时有血清素综合征风险。
majorInteractions: 伊曲康唑、维拉帕米或大量葡萄柚汁可升高暴露，利福平可降低暴露。
monitoring: 随访焦虑症状、头晕及合并用药，固定随餐或空腹方式。进行尿儿茶酚胺检测时告知用药情况。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日两次口服

en.summary: The cited oral tablet contains buspirone hydrochloride. Clinical doses use the cited product strength basis.

indications: Used for anxiety disorders or short-term relief of anxiety symptoms. The supporting trials mainly enrolled people comparable to those with generalized anxiety disorder.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity or antidepressant MAOI use within the relevant 14-day washout. Do not initiate during treatment with linezolid or intravenous methylene blue.
majorWarnings: Dizziness and nausea may occur. Serotonergic combinations can increase serotonin syndrome risk.
majorInteractions: Itraconazole, verapamil or large amounts of grapefruit juice can raise exposure. Rifampin can lower it.
monitoring: Follow anxiety symptoms, dizziness and concomitant drugs. Keep food timing consistent and disclose use before urinary catecholamine testing.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Unchanged drug after a single 10–40 mg dose

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally twice daily

zh-CN.summary: 此处临床资料引用普通口服片。

indications: 所引美国口服片标签列有精神分裂症、自闭症相关易激惹及抽动秽语综合征。
contraindications: 既往对阿立哌唑过敏。
majorWarnings: 老年痴呆相关精神病患者使用抗精神病药死亡风险增加。关注静坐不能、异常运动、体重及代谢变化、冲动控制问题和恶性综合征。
majorInteractions: 强 CYP2D6 或 CYP3A4 抑制剂可升高药物暴露，强 CYP3A4 诱导剂可降低暴露。
monitoring: 随访体重、血糖、血脂、异常运动及冲动控制变化。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 阿立哌唑均值，CYP2D6 慢代谢者可延长

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日一次口服

en.summary: Clinical details here refer to standard oral tablets.

indications: The cited US tablet label includes schizophrenia, irritability associated with autism and Tourette disorder.
contraindications: Previous hypersensitivity to aripiprazole.
majorWarnings: Antipsychotics increase mortality in older adults with dementia-related psychosis. Watch for akathisia, abnormal movements, weight or metabolic changes, impulse-control problems and neuroleptic malignant syndrome.
majorInteractions: Strong CYP2D6 or CYP3A4 inhibitors can raise exposure. Strong CYP3A4 inducers can reduce it.
monitoring: Follow weight, glucose, lipids, abnormal movements and changes in impulse control.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Aripiprazole mean, prolonged in CYP2D6 poor metabolizers

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally once daily

zh-CN.summary: 有抗焦虑和镇静作用的口服苯二氮䓬类药物。

indications: 加拿大说明书用于短期缓解明显焦虑症状。
contraindications: 对本品或其他苯二氮䓬类过敏、重症肌无力、严重肝或呼吸功能不全、睡眠呼吸暂停或窄角型青光眼。
majorWarnings: 可能出现嗜睡、记忆损害和依赖。快速减量或骤停可引起戒断。
majorInteractions: 合用阿片类或酒精可加重呼吸和中枢抑制。氟伏沙明可增加溴西泮暴露。
monitoring: 治疗开始和续用前评估症状、镇静程度及呼吸风险。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

tmax.basis: 健康男性单次 6 mg，范围，中位数 1.5 小时

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 说明书约值，老年人可能更长

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 口服，等分剂量，按症状和耐受调整，初期一周复评

en.summary: An oral benzodiazepine with anxiolytic and sedative effects.

indications: The Canadian monograph covers short-term relief of marked anxiety symptoms.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to this drug or other benzodiazepines, myasthenia gravis, severe hepatic or respiratory insufficiency, sleep apnea or narrow-angle glaucoma.
majorWarnings: Somnolence, memory impairment and dependence may occur. Rapid reduction or abrupt withdrawal can cause withdrawal symptoms.
majorInteractions: Opioids or alcohol can increase respiratory and CNS depression. Fluvoxamine can increase bromazepam exposure.
monitoring: Assess symptoms, sedation and respiratory risk at initiation and before continuation.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Approximate monograph value, may be longer in older adults

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally in equal divided doses, adjusted to symptoms and tolerance, with initial reassessment at one week

zh-CN.summary: 此处资料为单成分舌下片。注射剂和贴剂的适应证、剂量及药代需分别查阅。

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 舌下，按监督下的临床反应调整

en.summary: This information concerns single-ingredient sublingual tablets. Injectable and patch products have separate indications, doses and pharmacokinetics.

indications: The single-ingredient sublingual tablet treats opioid dependence, primarily during induction, with psychosocial support.
contraindications: Previous hypersensitivity to buprenorphine.
majorWarnings: Respiratory depression may occur. Starting induction too early can precipitate withdrawal, and sedatives increase the risk of serious adverse events.
majorInteractions: Benzodiazepines, alcohol and other CNS depressants increase respiratory-depression risk. CYP3A4 inhibitors or inducers can change exposure.
monitoring: Assess withdrawal severity, sedation and breathing, and check liver function at baseline and during treatment.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Plasma elimination after sublingual tablets

doseUseReferences.indication: Induction for dependence on short-acting opioids
doseUseReferences.population: Patients with objective signs of moderate withdrawal
doseUseReferences.amountText: Label describes optional first-day increments of 2–4 mg
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Sublingual, adjusted to response under clinical supervision

zh-CN.summary: 此处资料为治疗精神分裂症的口服片。

drugClass: 苯甲酰胺类抗精神病药
indications: 英国说明书用于有阳性或阴性症状的急性或慢性精神分裂症。
contraindications: 过敏、泌乳素依赖性肿瘤、嗜铬细胞瘤、青春期前儿童或正在使用左旋多巴。
majorWarnings: 关注 QT 间期延长、泌乳素升高、锥体外系症状和神经阻滞剂恶性综合征。
majorInteractions: 与左旋多巴作用相互拮抗。其他延长 QT 间期或中枢抑制药可能加重相关风险。
monitoring: 根据肾功能评估剂量，结合风险评估心电图和电解质，随访运动症状、泌乳素相关症状和血糖。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

tmax.basis: 口服 50 mg 后的第二个吸收峰，首次约 1 小时

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 口服后消除约值

doseUseReferences.indication: 以阴性症状为主的精神分裂症
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 口服，按反应调整

en.summary: These details concern oral tablets for schizophrenia.

indications: The UK label covers acute or chronic schizophrenia with positive or negative symptoms.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity, prolactin-dependent tumors, pheochromocytoma, prepubertal children or concomitant levodopa.
majorWarnings: Watch for QT prolongation, elevated prolactin, extrapyramidal symptoms and neuroleptic malignant syndrome.
majorInteractions: Levodopa and amisulpride have opposing effects. Other QT-prolonging or CNS-depressant medicines can add to related risks.
monitoring: Assess dosing against renal function, check ECG and electrolytes according to risk, and follow movement symptoms, prolactin-related symptoms and glucose.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

tmax.basis: Second absorption peak after oral 50 mg, with a first peak at about one hour

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Approximate oral elimination

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally, adjusted to response

zh-CN.summary: 口服胶囊，具有活性代谢物，剂量调整的影响可持续数周。

indications: 美国说明书列有精神分裂症、双相 I 型躁狂或混合发作、成人双相抑郁及成人重性抑郁障碍的抗抑郁药辅助治疗。各用途有年龄限制。
contraindications: 既往对卡利拉嗪过敏。
majorWarnings: 可能出现静坐不能、锥体外系症状和代谢变化。不良反应可能在开始或加量数周后才明显。老年痴呆相关精神病患者死亡风险增加。
majorInteractions: CYP3A4 抑制剂可改变母药及活性代谢物暴露。美国标签不建议合用 CYP3A4 诱导剂。
monitoring: 开始和变更剂量后随访数周，评估反应、异常运动、体重、血糖和血脂。

notes: 说明书报告终末消除半衰期约 8–9 小时，但早期消除快，等效半衰期约 1–2 小时，因此需每 4 小时给药。

tmax.basis: 单次口服后母药血浆约值

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日一次口服

en.summary: Oral capsules with active metabolites. Effects of dose changes can evolve over several weeks.

indications: The US label includes schizophrenia, manic or mixed bipolar I episodes, adult bipolar depression and adjunctive treatment of adult major depression. Age limits differ by indication.
contraindications: Previous hypersensitivity to cariprazine.
majorWarnings: Akathisia, extrapyramidal symptoms and metabolic changes can occur. Adverse effects can appear weeks after starting or increasing the dose. Mortality is increased in older adults with dementia-related psychosis.
majorInteractions: CYP3A4 inhibitors alter exposure to the parent drug and active metabolites. The US label advises against coadministration with CYP3A4 inducers.
monitoring: Follow response, movement symptoms, weight, glucose and lipids for several weeks after initiation and dosage changes.

notes: The label reports a terminal half-life of about 8 to 9 hours, but early elimination is much faster and corresponds to a 1 to 2 hour half-life; this is why dosing is required every four hours.

tmax.basis: Approximate plasma peak for the parent drug after a single oral dose

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally once daily

zh-CN.summary: 口服片剂，药代资料来自美国 Rexulti 说明书。

indications: 精神分裂症、成人重性抑郁障碍的抗抑郁药辅助治疗，以及阿尔茨海默病痴呆伴激越的规律治疗。
contraindications: 对依匹哌唑或制剂成分过敏。
majorWarnings: 老年痴呆相关精神病患者使用抗精神病药死亡风险增加。还需关注体重增加、异常运动、体位性低血压与冲动控制问题。
majorInteractions: CYP2D6 或 CYP3A4 抑制剂及强 CYP3A4 诱导剂可能需要按具体适应证调整。
monitoring: 随访体重、血糖、血脂、运动症状和血压。存在肾或肝功能损害时核对标签限量。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

tmax.basis: 单次口服后约 4 小时内达峰

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 依匹哌唑终末消除约值

doseUseReferences.indication: 重性抑郁障碍的辅助治疗
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日一次口服，按周评估调整

en.summary: Oral tablets, with pharmacokinetics from the US Rexulti label.

indications: Schizophrenia, adjunctive antidepressant therapy for adult major depression, and scheduled treatment of agitation associated with Alzheimer’s dementia.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to brexpiprazole or formulation ingredients.
majorWarnings: Antipsychotics increase mortality in older adults with dementia-related psychosis. Other risks include weight gain, abnormal movements, orthostatic hypotension and impulse-control problems.
majorInteractions: CYP2D6 or CYP3A4 inhibitors and strong CYP3A4 inducers may require indication-specific adjustment.
monitoring: Follow weight, glucose, lipids, movement symptoms and blood pressure. Check label limits in renal or hepatic impairment.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

tmax.basis: Plasma peak within approximately four hours after one oral dose

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Approximate terminal elimination of brexpiprazole

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally once daily, assessing adjustments weekly

zh-CN.summary: 所引产品为舌下片。吞服时的吸收远低于舌下给药。

indications: 美国舌下片用于成人精神分裂症，以及部分双相 I 型急性躁狂或混合发作、联合治疗或成人维持治疗。
contraindications: 严重肝功能损害（Child–Pugh C）或对阿塞那平过敏。
majorWarnings: 可能有暂时口腔感觉减退、嗜睡、代谢变化、异常运动和体位性低血压。痴呆相关精神病老年患者死亡风险增加。
majorInteractions: 可能增加帕罗西汀暴露，合用延长 QT 间期或降压药可加重相关风险。
monitoring: 随访体重、血糖、血脂、血压及运动症状。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 终末消除约值

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日两次舌下给药，给药后 10 分钟内勿饮食

en.summary: The cited product is a sublingual tablet. Exposure is much lower when swallowed.

indications: US sublingual tablet indications include adult schizophrenia and selected acute manic or mixed, adjunctive and adult maintenance uses in bipolar I disorder.
contraindications: Severe hepatic impairment (Child–Pugh C) or hypersensitivity to asenapine.
majorWarnings: Transient oral numbness, somnolence, metabolic changes, abnormal movements and orthostatic hypotension may occur. Mortality is increased in older adults with dementia-related psychosis.
majorInteractions: Can increase paroxetine exposure. QT-prolonging or hypotensive medicines can add to related risks.
monitoring: Follow weight, glucose, lipids, blood pressure and movement symptoms.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Approximate terminal elimination

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Sublingually twice daily, avoiding food or drink for 10 minutes after administration

zh-CN.summary: 此处剂量及达峰数据对应盐酸安非他酮 XL 缓释片。普通片、SR 片和戒烟产品有各自说明书。

drugClass: 去甲肾上腺素及多巴胺再摄取抑制剂
indications: 所引美国 XL 说明书用于重性抑郁障碍和预防季节性情感障碍相关抑郁发作。
contraindications: 癫痫或惊厥性疾病、神经性厌食或贪食病史、酒精或部分镇静及抗癫痫药的突然停用、过敏，及 MAOI 禁用期。
majorWarnings: 惊厥风险与剂量相关。也需注意血压升高、躁狂激活及情绪或自杀意念变化。
majorInteractions: 抑制 CYP2D6，可升高部分合用药物浓度。应核对其他含安非他酮产品及降低惊厥阈值的药物。
monitoring: 开始治疗前和治疗期间监测血压，随访情绪、睡眠和惊厥风险。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

tmax.basis: XL 片口服后中位数约值

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 母药平均值

doseUseReferences.amountText: 起始 150 mg 盐酸安非他酮
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: XL 片每日早晨口服一次，整片吞服

en.summary: Dosing and time to peak here concern bupropion hydrochloride XL tablets. Immediate-release, SR and smoking-cessation products have separate labels.

indications: The cited US XL label covers major depressive disorder and prevention of depressive episodes associated with seasonal affective disorder.
contraindications: Seizure disorder, history of anorexia nervosa or bulimia, abrupt withdrawal from alcohol or certain sedative or antiseizure drugs, hypersensitivity, and contraindicated MAOI periods.
majorWarnings: Seizure risk is dose-related. Also watch for hypertension, activation of mania and changes in mood or suicidal thoughts.
majorInteractions: Inhibits CYP2D6 and can raise concentrations of some concomitant drugs. Check for other bupropion-containing products and drugs that lower seizure threshold.
monitoring: Monitor blood pressure before and during treatment and follow mood, sleep and seizure risk.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

tmax.basis: Approximate median after oral XL tablets

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Parent-drug mean

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Oral XL tablet every morning, swallowed whole

zh-CN.summary: 所引英国口服片为盐酸阿米替林制剂。

indications: 成人重性抑郁障碍、神经病理性疼痛及慢性紧张型头痛和偏头痛预防。部分难治性儿童遗尿有专科适应证。
contraindications: 近期心肌梗死、心脏传导阻滞、心律失常、冠脉供血不足、与 MAOI 合用、严重肝病或过敏。
majorWarnings: 可能出现镇静、抗胆碱反应、体位性低血压及心律失常，过量可危及生命。
majorInteractions: 避免与 MAOI 合用。其他延长 QT 间期、镇静或抗胆碱药可叠加风险，强 CYP2D6 抑制剂可提高暴露。
monitoring: 随访情绪、血压和抗胆碱不良反应，有心脏风险时评估心电图。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 口服母药范围，均值约 25 小时

doseUseReferences.population: 成人，老年及心血管病患者另有起始量
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日两次口服

en.summary: The cited UK oral tablet contains amitriptyline hydrochloride.

indications: Adult major depression, neuropathic pain and prevention of chronic tension-type headache or migraine. Specialist use is also listed for selected refractory pediatric enuresis.
contraindications: Recent myocardial infarction, conduction block, arrhythmia, coronary insufficiency, concomitant MAOIs, severe liver disease or hypersensitivity.
majorWarnings: Sedation, anticholinergic effects, orthostatic hypotension and arrhythmias may occur. Overdose can be life-threatening.
majorInteractions: Avoid MAOI combinations. QT-prolonging, sedating or anticholinergic agents can add risk. Strong CYP2D6 inhibitors may increase exposure.
monitoring: Follow mood, blood pressure and anticholinergic adverse effects, with ECG assessment where cardiac risk warrants it.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Oral parent-drug range, mean about 25 hours

doseUseReferences.population: Adults, with separate starting doses for older patients and cardiovascular disease
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally twice daily

zh-CN.summary: 口服抗抑郁药，治疗需结合肝功能检查。

drugClass: 褪黑素受体激动型抗抑郁药
indications: 成人重性抑郁发作。
contraindications: 活动性肝病或肝硬化、转氨酶超过正常上限三倍、合用强 CYP1A2 抑制剂或过敏。
majorWarnings: 有药物性肝损伤风险，也需关注情绪恶化和躁狂。
majorInteractions: 氟伏沙明及环丙沙星可显著增加暴露，禁止合用。
monitoring: 治疗前检查转氨酶，并按说明书在约第 3、6、12、24 周复查。加量后重新按相同频率监测。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 说明书平均血浆消除

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日睡前口服一次

en.summary: Oral antidepressant requiring liver function testing.

indications: Major depressive episodes in adults.
contraindications: Active liver disease or cirrhosis, transaminases above three times the upper limit of normal, potent CYP1A2 inhibitors or hypersensitivity.
majorWarnings: Risk of drug-induced liver injury. Monitor also for deteriorating mood or mania.
majorInteractions: Fluvoxamine and ciprofloxacin can markedly raise exposure and are contraindicated.
monitoring: Check transaminases at baseline and around weeks 3, 6, 12 and 24. Restart this monitoring schedule after an increase.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Mean plasma elimination in the label

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally once daily at bedtime

zh-CN.summary: 所引药品是普通卡马西平片。连续给药可诱导自身代谢。

indications: 美国所引标签用于某些癫痫发作及三叉神经痛。
contraindications: 骨髓抑制病史、对卡马西平或相关三环化合物过敏、与奈法唑酮合用。说明书要求在开始治疗前留出至少 14 天的 MAOI 停药间隔。
majorWarnings: 可出现严重皮肤反应、骨髓抑制、肝损伤及低钠血症。某些遗传背景的人群需评估 HLA-B*15:02。
majorInteractions: 酶诱导可降低多种药物及部分激素避孕药暴露。某些 CYP3A4 抑制剂可升高卡马西平浓度。
monitoring: 基线和治疗期间关注血象、肝功能和血钠。必要时测血药浓度。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 重复用药后，初期约 25–65 小时

doseUseReferences.population: 成人及 12 岁以上儿童
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日两次口服，后续按发作控制和耐受调整

en.summary: The cited product is a standard carbamazepine tablet. Repeated use can induce its own metabolism.

indications: The cited US label covers selected seizure types and trigeminal neuralgia.
contraindications: History of marrow suppression, hypersensitivity to carbamazepine or related tricyclic compounds, and concomitant nefazodone. The label calls for at least 14 days after stopping MAOIs.
majorWarnings: Severe skin reactions, marrow suppression, hepatic injury and hyponatremia may occur. Evaluate HLA-B*15:02 in genetically at-risk populations.
majorInteractions: Enzyme induction can reduce exposure to many drugs and some hormonal contraceptives. Certain CYP3A4 inhibitors can raise carbamazepine levels.
monitoring: Follow blood counts, hepatic function and sodium as appropriate. Consider plasma levels when indicated.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: With repeated dosing, compared with about 25–65 hours initially

doseUseReferences.amountText: Standard tablets initially 200 mg per dose
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally twice daily, then adjusted to seizure control and tolerance

zh-CN.summary: 所引英国制剂为 143 mg/5 mL 口服溶液。

indications: 其他治疗失败时短期治疗影响日常活动的重度失眠。儿童用途限符合条件的神经发育障碍患者，由专科评估。
contraindications: 过敏、严重肝肾损害、严重心脏病、活动性胃炎或食管炎、胃十二指肠溃疡或穿孔，以及易发生急性卟啉病发作。
majorWarnings: 关注过度镇静、呼吸抑制、心律失常和依赖。所引疗程最长两周。
majorInteractions: 酒精及其他中枢抑制剂可加重镇静。应核对延长 QT 间期的合并用药。
monitoring: 评估警觉程度、呼吸及心脏风险，重复疗程前需专科复评。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 三氯乙醇血浆消除，非原形药

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 143 mg/5 mL 溶液，睡前 15–30 分钟口服一次

en.summary: The cited UK product is a 143 mg/5 mL oral solution.

indications: Short-term treatment of severe insomnia impairing daily life after other options fail. Pediatric use is restricted to eligible patients with neurodevelopmental disorders under specialist care.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity, severe hepatic, renal or cardiac disease, active gastritis or esophagitis, gastroduodenal ulceration or perforation, and susceptibility to acute porphyria.
majorWarnings: Watch for excessive sedation, respiratory depression, arrhythmias and dependence. The cited course is limited to two weeks.
majorInteractions: Alcohol and other CNS depressants can intensify sedation. Check for other QT-prolonging medicines.
monitoring: Assess alertness, breathing and cardiac risk. Repeat courses require specialist reassessment.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Plasma elimination of trichloroethanol, the active metabolite

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: One oral dose of the 143 mg/5 mL solution 15–30 minutes before bedtime

zh-CN.summary: 所引口服胶囊含盐酸托莫西汀，强度以托莫西汀计。

drugClass: 非兴奋剂类 ADHD 药
indications: 用于 ADHD。
contraindications: 过敏、与 MAOI 合用或处于相应停药间隔、窄角型青光眼、嗜铬细胞瘤或其病史，以及血压或心率升高会加重的严重心血管疾病。
majorWarnings: 儿童及青少年需关注自杀意念。还可能出现血压升高、心率加快或少见严重肝损伤。
majorInteractions: 氟西汀和帕罗西汀等强 CYP2D6 抑制剂可增加暴露。与升压药同用需谨慎。
monitoring: 治疗前、调量后和定期测血压及心率，随访情绪、儿童生长及肝损伤症状。

notes: 口服后 20 分钟即可检出，平均约 1 小时达峰；稳态约需 2–3 天。终末半衰期约 8.6 小时，但多数药物在最初 8 小时内清除，临床上以早期 2–4 小时半衰期描述更合适。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: CYP2D6 正常代谢人群平均值，慢代谢者约 21.6 小时

doseUseReferences.population: 成人，强 CYP2D6 抑制剂合用或慢代谢者按说明书调整
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 口服，可早晨一次或分早晨和下午晚些时候服用

en.summary: The cited oral capsules contain atomoxetine hydrochloride with strength expressed as atomoxetine.

indications: Used for ADHD.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity, MAOI coadministration or its washout period, narrow-angle glaucoma, pheochromocytoma or its history, and severe cardiovascular disease that could worsen with higher blood pressure or pulse.
majorWarnings: Monitor for suicidal ideation in children and adolescents. Increased blood pressure or pulse and rare severe liver injury can occur.
majorInteractions: Strong CYP2D6 inhibitors such as fluoxetine or paroxetine can increase exposure. Use caution with pressor drugs.
monitoring: Check blood pressure and pulse before therapy, after dose changes and periodically. Follow mood, pediatric growth and symptoms of liver injury.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Mean in CYP2D6 extensive metabolizers, about 21.6 hours in poor metabolizers

doseUseReferences.population: Adults, with label-specific titration for strong CYP2D6 inhibitors or poor metabolizers
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally in the morning or split between morning and late afternoon

zh-CN.summary: 所引产品为阿坎酸钙肠溶片，剂量按钙盐标示。

indications: 用于已戒酒的酒精依赖患者维持戒酒，结合心理和社会支持。
contraindications: 对产品过敏或严重肾功能损害（肌酐清除率不超过 30 mL/min）。
majorWarnings: 腹泻较常见。关注抑郁、自杀意念及行为。
majorInteractions: 所引说明书未见与地西泮或双硫仑有临床意义的药代相互作用。
monitoring: 按肾功能核对剂量，随访饮酒情况、胃肠道耐受及情绪。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 肠溶片口服后终末消除约值

doseUseReferences.population: 肾功能无需减量的成人
doseUseReferences.amountText: 每次 666 mg 阿坎酸钙
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日三次口服

en.summary: The cited product is an acamprosate calcium delayed-release tablet, with strength expressed as the calcium salt.

indications: Helps maintain abstinence in people with alcohol dependence who are abstinent at initiation, alongside psychosocial support.
contraindications: Product hypersensitivity or severe renal impairment with creatinine clearance at or below 30 mL/min.
majorWarnings: Diarrhea is common. Watch for depression and suicidal thoughts or behavior.
majorInteractions: The cited label reports no clinically meaningful pharmacokinetic interaction with diazepam or disulfiram.
monitoring: Check dosing against renal function and follow alcohol use, gastrointestinal tolerance and mood.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

tmax.basis: After delayed-release dosing at steady state

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Approximate terminal elimination after oral delayed-release dosing

doseUseReferences.population: Adults without a renal dose reduction
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally three times daily

zh-CN.summary: 所引荷兰片剂为每片 0.25 mg。

drugClass: 苯二氮䓬受体镇静催眠药
indications: 短期治疗严重影响生活的失眠。
contraindications: 过敏、重症肌无力、严重呼吸抑制、睡眠呼吸暂停、严重肝功能损害及未满 18 岁。
majorWarnings: 有镇静、记忆受损、依赖及戒断风险。
majorInteractions: 酒精、阿片及其他中枢抑制剂可加重镇静或呼吸抑制，CYP3A4 抑制剂可影响暴露。
monitoring: 复评睡眠、次日警觉性和呼吸风险。说明书通常将疗程限制在两周内。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

tmax.basis: 吞服 0.25 mg 后平均约 45 分钟

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 健康受试者血浆消除

doseUseReferences.population: 成人，老年人另有较低起始量
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 空腹临睡前口服一次

en.summary: The cited Dutch tablets contain 0.25 mg each.

indications: Short-term treatment of severe, impairing insomnia.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity, myasthenia gravis, severe respiratory depression, sleep apnea, severe hepatic impairment and age under 18 years.
majorWarnings: Sedation, impaired memory, dependence and withdrawal can occur.
majorInteractions: Alcohol, opioids and other CNS depressants can worsen sedation or respiratory depression. CYP3A4 inhibitors may alter exposure.
monitoring: Reassess sleep, next-day alertness and respiratory risk. The label generally limits treatment to two weeks.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

tmax.basis: Mean about 45 minutes after swallowing 0.25 mg

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Plasma elimination in healthy subjects

doseUseReferences.population: Adults, with a lower starting dose for older patients
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: One oral dose on an empty stomach immediately before bed

sourceRefs.title: PMDA · Blonanserin Amel tablets and powder

zh-CN.summary: 所引日本说明书涵盖普通片剂及口服散剂。

indications: 用于精神分裂症。
contraindications: 昏迷、强烈中枢抑制、过敏或合用说明书列出的部分抗真菌药和抗病毒药。肾上腺素合用亦受限，过敏性休克等紧急治疗及说明书所列牙科局麻用途除外。
majorWarnings: 关注锥体外系症状、恶性综合征、血糖异常和泌乳素升高。
majorInteractions: 部分 CYP3A4 抑制剂可显著增加暴露。核对伊曲康唑等说明书列出的禁忌合用药。
monitoring: 随访运动症状、体重和代谢指标，并评估泌乳素相关症状。

sourceRefs.title: PMDA · Blonanserin Amel tablets and powder

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 同一生物等效性试验中 Amel 片的均值

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日两次餐后口服

en.summary: The cited Japanese label covers standard tablets and oral powder.

indications: Used for schizophrenia.
contraindications: Coma, marked CNS depression, hypersensitivity or use of certain listed antifungals or antivirals. Epinephrine is restricted except for emergency treatment of anaphylaxis and the listed dental anesthesia uses.
majorWarnings: Watch for extrapyramidal symptoms, neuroleptic malignant syndrome, glucose abnormalities and increased prolactin.
majorInteractions: Some CYP3A4 inhibitors can markedly increase exposure. Check contraindicated combinations listed in the label, such as itraconazole.
monitoring: Follow movement symptoms, weight and metabolic measures, and assess prolactin-related symptoms.

sourceRefs.title: PMDA · Blonanserin Amel tablets and powder

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

sourceRefs.title: PMDA · Blonanserin Amel tablets and powder

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Mean for the Amel tablet in the same bioequivalence study

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally twice daily after meals

zh-CN.summary: 氯硝西泮具有抗惊厥和镇静作用。此处资料针对普通口服片。

indications: 美国说明书用于部分癫痫发作，以及伴或不伴广场恐惧的惊恐障碍。
contraindications: 苯二氮䓬类过敏、显著肝病或急性窄角型青光眼。
majorWarnings: 可导致嗜睡、运动协调受损和依赖，骤停可能引起严重戒断或惊厥。
majorInteractions: 与阿片类、酒精及其他中枢抑制剂合用可增加镇静和呼吸抑制风险。
monitoring: 随访发作或惊恐症状、镇静、呼吸风险及依赖。长期用药时按说明书考虑血象和肝功能检查。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 典型消除范围

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日两次口服

en.summary: Clonazepam has antiseizure and sedative effects. These details concern standard oral tablets.

indications: The US label covers selected seizure disorders and panic disorder with or without agoraphobia.
contraindications: Benzodiazepine hypersensitivity, significant liver disease or acute narrow-angle glaucoma.
majorWarnings: May cause somnolence, impaired coordination and dependence. Abrupt cessation can cause severe withdrawal or seizures.
majorInteractions: Opioids, alcohol and other CNS depressants can increase the risks of sedation and respiratory depression.
monitoring: Follow seizures or panic symptoms, sedation, respiratory risk and dependence. Consider blood counts and liver function tests during long-term therapy as described in the label.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Typical elimination range

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally twice daily

zh-CN.summary: 长效苯二氮䓬类药物，有活性代谢物。所引用量对应口服片。

indications: 美国口服片用于焦虑障碍或短期缓解焦虑、急性酒精戒断，并可辅助治疗某些肌痉挛或惊厥。
contraindications: 地西泮过敏、重症肌无力、严重呼吸或肝功能不全、睡眠呼吸暂停、急性窄角型青光眼或未满 6 个月。
majorWarnings: 有嗜睡、蓄积、依赖和戒断风险，老年人尤其易受镇静及运动协调影响。
majorInteractions: 阿片类、酒精和其他中枢抑制剂可叠加镇静及呼吸抑制。部分 CYP3A4 或 CYP2C19 抑制剂可能延长镇静。
monitoring: 定期复评症状、清醒度、呼吸、跌倒和依赖风险，长期使用后按个体情况逐步减量。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

tmax.basis: 口服片范围，平均约 1–1.5 小时

doseUseReferences.indication: 焦虑障碍或短期缓解焦虑
doseUseReferences.population: 成人，老年及体弱者另有较低起始量
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日口服 2–4 次，按症状和耐受调整

en.summary: A long-acting benzodiazepine with active metabolites. The cited doses apply to oral tablets.

indications: US oral-tablet uses include anxiety disorders or short-term anxiety relief and acute alcohol withdrawal. It is also an adjunct for selected muscle spasms and convulsive disorders.
contraindications: Diazepam hypersensitivity, myasthenia gravis, severe respiratory or hepatic insufficiency, sleep apnea, acute narrow-angle glaucoma, or age under six months.
majorWarnings: Somnolence, accumulation, dependence and withdrawal can occur. Older adults are particularly vulnerable to sedation and impaired coordination.
majorInteractions: Opioids, alcohol and other CNS depressants can add sedation and respiratory depression. Some CYP3A4 or CYP2C19 inhibitors can prolong sedation.
monitoring: Reassess symptoms, alertness, breathing, fall risk and dependence. Use an individualized taper after continued treatment.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

tmax.basis: Oral tablet range, mean about 1–1.5 hours

doseUseReferences.indication: Anxiety disorders or short-term relief of anxiety
doseUseReferences.population: Adults, with lower starting doses in older or debilitated patients
doseUseReferences.amountText: 2–10 mg per dose depending on symptoms
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally two to four times a day, individualized to symptoms and tolerance

zh-CN.summary: 口服抗抑郁药，所引片剂以西酞普兰标示强度。

drugClass: 选择性血清素再摄取抑制剂
indications: 成人重性抑郁障碍。
contraindications: 合用或刚停用规定的 MAOI、合用匹莫齐特，或对制剂过敏。
majorWarnings: 可发生剂量相关的 QT 延长，也需关注低钠血症、血清素综合征、出血及自杀意念变化。
majorInteractions: 其他延长 QT 间期的药物可增加心律风险。CYP2C19 抑制剂可增加暴露，抗凝药或 NSAID 可增加出血风险。
monitoring: 随访情绪、耐受性和合并用药。对有心律风险者按说明书检查钾、镁及心电图。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 母药终末消除均值约 35 小时

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日一次口服，可随餐或空腹

en.summary: Oral antidepressant. The cited tablets express strength as citalopram.

indications: Major depressive disorder in adults.
contraindications: Concomitant or recently discontinued MAOIs within the label washout, concomitant pimozide, or product hypersensitivity.
majorWarnings: Dose-related QT prolongation can occur. Watch also for hyponatremia, serotonin syndrome, bleeding and changes in suicidal thoughts.
majorInteractions: Other QT-prolonging medicines may increase arrhythmia risk. CYP2C19 inhibitors can increase exposure, and anticoagulants or NSAIDs can increase bleeding.
monitoring: Follow mood, tolerability and concurrent medicines. Check potassium, magnesium and ECG as indicated by arrhythmia risk.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Mean terminal elimination about 35 hours

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally once daily, with or without food

zh-CN.summary: 文拉法辛的活性代谢物，此处资料对应琥珀酸去甲文拉法辛缓释片。

drugClass: 血清素及去甲肾上腺素再摄取抑制剂
indications: 成人重性抑郁障碍。
contraindications: 对去甲文拉法辛、文拉法辛或辅料过敏，或处于说明书规定的 MAOI 禁用期。
majorWarnings: 可能升高血压。关注血清素综合征、停药症状、低钠血症和自杀意念变化。
majorInteractions: 促血清素药可增加血清素综合征风险。抗凝药、抗血小板药和 NSAID 可增加出血风险。
monitoring: 治疗前和治疗中监测血压，并按肾功能核对剂量，随访情绪及耐受性。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

timeToSteadyState.basis: 每日给药约 4–5 天达到稳态

effectTimelineWindow.basis: 给药间隔；仅用于确定曲线横轴

timeCourse.effectTimelineNote: 每日给药间隔；仅用于确定曲线横轴。

doseUseReferences.population: 肾功能无需调整的成人
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日一次口服，整片吞服

en.summary: The active metabolite of venlafaxine. These details apply to desvenlafaxine succinate extended-release tablets.

indications: Major depressive disorder in adults.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to desvenlafaxine, venlafaxine or excipients, or a contraindicated MAOI period.
majorWarnings: Blood pressure can rise. Watch for serotonin syndrome, discontinuation symptoms, hyponatremia and changes in suicidal thoughts.
majorInteractions: Serotonergic drugs can increase serotonin syndrome risk. Anticoagulants, antiplatelet agents and NSAIDs can increase bleeding risk.
monitoring: Monitor blood pressure before and during treatment, check dose against renal function, and follow mood and tolerability.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

timeToSteadyState.basis: Steady state after about 4–5 days of daily dosing

effectTimelineWindow.basis: Dosing interval; plot range only

timeCourse.effectTimelineNote: Daily dosing interval; plot range only.

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally once daily, swallowed whole

zh-CN.summary: 所引美国制剂是盐酸氯米帕明口服胶囊。

indications: 治疗强迫症的强迫思维及强迫行为。
contraindications: 对本品或其他三环类抗抑郁药过敏、处于 MAOI 禁用期或急性心肌梗死恢复期。
majorWarnings: 可出现嗜睡、抗胆碱不良反应、体位性低血压、惊厥和心脏传导异常。
majorInteractions: 促血清素药可叠加血清素综合征风险，部分 CYP2D6 抑制剂可升高暴露。
monitoring: 随访症状、情绪、血压、心率和不良反应，结合风险评估心电图及惊厥。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 150 mg 后母药范围，均值 32 小时

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 口服，逐步调整，初期调量时与食物同服以减少胃肠不适

en.summary: The cited US product is an oral clomipramine hydrochloride capsule.

indications: Treats obsessions and compulsions in obsessive-compulsive disorder.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to this drug or other tricyclic antidepressants, a contraindicated MAOI period, or acute recovery after myocardial infarction.
majorWarnings: Somnolence, anticholinergic effects, orthostatic hypotension, seizures and conduction abnormalities can occur.
majorInteractions: Serotonergic drugs increase serotonin syndrome risk. Some CYP2D6 inhibitors can raise exposure.
monitoring: Follow symptoms, mood, blood pressure, heart rate and adverse effects, with ECG and seizure assessment according to risk.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Parent-drug range after 150 mg, mean 32 hours

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally with gradual titration. Take with meals during early titration to reduce gastrointestinal effects.

zh-CN.summary: 口服催眠药，通过抑制觉醒信号作用。

indications: 成人入睡困难或睡眠维持困难所致的失眠。
contraindications: 发作性睡病或对达利雷生及制剂成分过敏。
majorWarnings: 可能影响次日警觉性，或出现睡眠瘫痪、复杂睡眠行为及抑郁加重。
majorInteractions: 避免与强 CYP3A4 抑制剂或中强度 CYP3A4 诱导剂合用。酒精和中枢抑制剂可叠加镇静。
monitoring: 随访睡眠改善、日间嗜睡和异常睡眠行为。存在呼吸功能损害时评估风险。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 终末消除约值

doseUseReferences.population: 成人，肝功能及相互作用需另行核对
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 临睡前 30 分钟内口服一次，距计划起床至少 7 小时

en.summary: Oral hypnotic that suppresses wake-promoting signaling.

indications: Adult insomnia involving difficulty initiating or maintaining sleep.
contraindications: Narcolepsy or hypersensitivity to daridorexant or formulation ingredients.
majorWarnings: May impair next-day alertness. Sleep paralysis, complex sleep behaviors or worsening depression can occur.
majorInteractions: Avoid strong CYP3A4 inhibitors and moderate or strong CYP3A4 inducers. Alcohol and CNS depressants can add sedation.
monitoring: Follow sleep response, daytime sleepiness and abnormal sleep behaviors. Assess risk in respiratory impairment.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Approximate terminal elimination

doseUseReferences.population: Adults, with separate hepatic and interaction considerations
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: One oral dose within 30 minutes before bedtime, with at least seven hours before planned awakening

zh-CN.summary: 所引口服片含盐酸多奈哌齐。

indications: 阿尔茨海默病相关痴呆。
contraindications: 对多奈哌齐或哌啶衍生物过敏。
majorWarnings: 可能出现恶心、腹泻、心动过缓或晕厥，也需关注胃肠道出血及体重下降。
majorInteractions: 可能与抗胆碱药作用相反，并增强某些胆碱能药和琥珀胆碱类肌松药的作用。
monitoring: 随访认知及日常功能、体重、胃肠耐受和心率，评估晕厥或消化道出血症状。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 口服后消除约值

doseUseReferences.indication: 阿尔茨海默病相关痴呆
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日一次，于晚上临睡前口服

en.summary: The cited oral tablets contain donepezil hydrochloride.

indications: Dementia associated with Alzheimer’s disease.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to donepezil or piperidine derivatives.
majorWarnings: Nausea, diarrhea, bradycardia or syncope can occur. Watch also for gastrointestinal bleeding and weight loss.
majorInteractions: Can oppose anticholinergics and enhance the effects of certain cholinergic drugs and succinylcholine-type muscle relaxants.
monitoring: Follow cognition and daily function, weight, gastrointestinal tolerance and pulse. Evaluate syncope or gastrointestinal bleeding symptoms.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Approximate oral elimination

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally once daily in the evening before bed

zh-CN.summary: 苯丙胺的右旋异构体。此处资料对应硫酸右旋苯丙胺即释片。

indications: 所引美国单成分片剂用于发作性睡病及 ADHD。
contraindications: 对苯丙胺制剂过敏，或使用 MAOI 期间及停用后 14 天内。
majorWarnings: 有滥用、成瘾及过量风险。可升高血压及心率，诱发或加重精神症状。
majorInteractions: 合用 MAOI 可引起高血压危象。促血清素药及 CYP2D6 抑制剂需核对血清素综合征风险。
monitoring: 治疗前评估心脏病及抽动病史，随访血压、心率、儿童生长及精神症状。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

tmax.basis: 12 名健康受试者服用三片 5 mg 即释片后的均值约 3 小时

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 同一比较中即释片血浆均值约 12 小时

doseUseReferences.amountText: 起始每次 5 mg 硫酸右旋苯丙胺
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日口服一次或两次，首剂在醒来时服用

en.summary: The dextrorotatory isomer of amphetamine. These details concern immediate-release dextroamphetamine sulfate tablets.

indications: The cited US single-ingredient tablets are used for narcolepsy and ADHD.
contraindications: Amphetamine product hypersensitivity or MAOI use during treatment and within 14 days after discontinuation.
majorWarnings: Risks include misuse, addiction and overdose. Blood pressure and pulse may increase, and psychiatric symptoms can emerge or worsen.
majorInteractions: MAOIs can precipitate hypertensive crisis. Check serotonergic drugs and CYP2D6 inhibitors for serotonin syndrome risk.
monitoring: Assess cardiac and tic history before treatment, then follow blood pressure, pulse, pediatric growth and psychiatric symptoms.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

tmax.basis: Approximate mean of three hours after three 5 mg immediate-release tablets in 12 healthy participants

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Approximate mean plasma half-life of 12 hours for the immediate-release tablets in the same comparison

doseUseReferences.population: Pediatric patients aged six years and older
doseUseReferences.amountText: Initially 5 mg dextroamphetamine sulfate per dose
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally once or twice daily, with the first dose on awakening

zh-CN.summary: 哌甲酯的右旋苏式异构体。此处资料对应盐酸右哌甲酯即释片。

indications: 用于 ADHD。美国 Focalin 片的用量资料适用于儿童。
contraindications: 对哌甲酯或制剂成分过敏，或合用 MAOI 及停药后 14 天内。
majorWarnings: 有滥用和成瘾风险，可升高血压及心率，并可能影响儿童生长。关注新发精神症状。
majorInteractions: MAOI 可引发高血压危象。右哌甲酯可降低部分降压药效果。
monitoring: 治疗前核对心脏病和抽动病史，随访血压、心率、身高、体重和精神症状。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 即释片口服后平均终末消除约 2.2 小时

doseUseReferences.population: 6 岁及以上，未使用哌甲酯的儿童
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日两次口服，两次至少间隔 4 小时

en.summary: The d-threo enantiomer of methylphenidate. These details concern immediate-release dexmethylphenidate hydrochloride tablets.

indications: Used for ADHD. The US Focalin tablet dosing information applies to pediatric patients.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to methylphenidate or formulation ingredients, or concomitant MAOI use or use within 14 days of discontinuation.
majorWarnings: Misuse and addiction are possible. Blood pressure and heart rate can rise, and pediatric growth may be affected. Watch for new psychiatric symptoms.
majorInteractions: MAOIs may precipitate hypertensive crisis. Dexmethylphenidate can reduce the effect of some antihypertensive medicines.
monitoring: Check cardiac and tic history before treatment, and follow blood pressure, pulse, height, weight and psychiatric symptoms.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Mean terminal elimination about 2.2 hours after oral immediate-release tablets

doseUseReferences.population: Pediatric patients six years or older not taking methylphenidate
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally twice daily at least four hours apart

zh-CN.summary: 口服二钾盐，给药后迅速转化为活性代谢物去甲地西泮。

indications: 用于焦虑障碍或短期缓解焦虑、局灶性发作的辅助治疗及急性酒精戒断。
contraindications: 对本品过敏或急性窄角型青光眼。
majorWarnings: 可出现镇静、运动协调障碍及依赖。快速减量或骤停可引起戒断和惊厥。
majorInteractions: 阿片类、酒精及其他中枢抑制剂可加重镇静和呼吸抑制。
monitoring: 复评疗效、镇静、呼吸和依赖风险，长期治疗时结合说明书考虑血象和肝功能检查。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 活性代谢物去甲地西泮的表观血浆消除

doseUseReferences.amountText: 所引说明书每日起始 7.5–15 mg 二钾盐
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 口服，按反应及耐受调整

en.summary: The oral dipotassium salt is rapidly converted to the active metabolite nordiazepam.

indications: Used for anxiety disorders or short-term anxiety relief, adjunctive treatment of focal seizures, and acute alcohol withdrawal.
contraindications: Product hypersensitivity or acute narrow-angle glaucoma.
majorWarnings: Sedation, impaired coordination and dependence may occur. Rapid reduction or abrupt cessation can cause withdrawal and seizures.
majorInteractions: Opioids, alcohol and other CNS depressants can intensify sedation and respiratory depression.
monitoring: Reassess response, sedation, respiratory and dependence risks. Consider blood counts and hepatic tests during prolonged treatment as described in the label.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Apparent plasma elimination of the active metabolite nordiazepam

doseUseReferences.amountText: Cited starting amount of 7.5–15 mg dipotassium salt per day
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally, adjusted according to response and tolerability

zh-CN.summary: 所引美国口服混悬液是单成分氯巴占制剂。

indications: 2 岁及以上患者 Lennox–Gastaut 综合征相关发作的辅助治疗。
contraindications: 既往对氯巴占或制剂成分过敏。
majorWarnings: 可出现嗜睡、依赖及戒断，严重皮肤反应包括 SJS/TEN 和 DRESS。
majorInteractions: 与阿片或其他中枢抑制剂同用可加重镇静和呼吸抑制。CYP2C19 抑制剂可升高活性代谢物暴露。
monitoring: 随访癫痫发作、镇静、呼吸、皮疹和过敏症状，调量时注意蓄积。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 母药均值范围，活性代谢物约 71–82 小时

doseUseReferences.population: 2 岁及以上且体重不超过 30 kg，特殊人群另行核对
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 口服混悬液每日一次，调量按说明书执行

en.summary: The cited US oral suspension contains clobazam as its sole active ingredient.

indications: Adjunctive therapy for seizures associated with Lennox–Gastaut syndrome in patients aged two years and older.
contraindications: Prior hypersensitivity to clobazam or formulation ingredients.
majorWarnings: Somnolence, dependence and withdrawal may occur. Serious cutaneous reactions include SJS/TEN and DRESS.
majorInteractions: Opioids or other CNS depressants can add sedation and respiratory depression. CYP2C19 inhibitors may increase active-metabolite exposure.
monitoring: Follow seizures, sedation, breathing, rash and hypersensitivity symptoms. Account for accumulation when adjusting dose.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Parent-drug mean range, versus about 71–82 hours for the active metabolite

doseUseReferences.population: Age two years or older and weight up to 30 kg, with separate considerations for special populations
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Oral suspension once daily, with titration per the label

zh-CN.summary: 通过造成乙醛蓄积增强饮酒后不适反应，用于辅助维持戒酒。

indications: 用于有戒酒意愿的部分慢性酒精依赖患者，配合支持性和心理治疗。
contraindications: 近期使用甲硝唑、副醛、酒精或含酒精制剂，严重心肌疾病或冠状动脉闭塞、精神病性障碍，或对双硫仑及相关秋兰姆衍生物过敏。
majorWarnings: 饮酒可引起低血压、呼吸困难及其他严重反应。停药后长达 14 天仍可发生反应。还需关注肝炎和神经病变。
majorInteractions: 核对隐性酒精来源。可升高苯妥英暴露，并影响口服抗凝药效果。
monitoring: 核对戒酒时间、基线肝功能及早期复查，随访肝损伤和神经症状。

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 口服，结合耐受及治疗反应调整

en.summary: A sobriety aid that increases acetaldehyde accumulation and causes an adverse reaction to alcohol.

indications: Used in selected patients with chronic alcohol dependence who wish to remain abstinent, alongside supportive and psychological treatment.
contraindications: Recent metronidazole, paraldehyde, alcohol or alcohol-containing preparations, severe myocardial disease or coronary occlusion, psychosis, or hypersensitivity to disulfiram or related thiuram derivatives.
majorWarnings: Alcohol exposure can cause hypotension, breathing difficulty and other severe reactions. Reactions remain possible for up to 14 days after the last dose. Watch for hepatitis and neuropathy.
majorInteractions: Check for hidden alcohol sources. Disulfiram can raise phenytoin exposure and affect oral anticoagulant response.
monitoring: Confirm the period of abstinence and check baseline and early follow-up liver tests. Watch for hepatic and neurological symptoms.

doseUseReferences.amountText: Average maintenance dose 250 mg per day
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally, individualized to tolerability and response

zh-CN.summary: 所引英国胶囊含盐酸氯氮䓬，具有镇静作用。

indications: 短期缓解严重或明显影响生活的焦虑。
contraindications: 过敏、重症肌无力、严重呼吸或肝功能不全及睡眠呼吸暂停等情况禁用。
majorWarnings: 可能嗜睡、记忆受损和形成依赖。快速减量或突然停药可引起戒断。
majorInteractions: 阿片、酒精及其他中枢抑制剂可加重镇静及呼吸抑制。
monitoring: 开始前确定停药策略，随访症状、警觉性、呼吸及依赖风险。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 说明书母药范围，活性代谢物另有动力学

doseUseReferences.population: 成人，老年或体弱者另有剂量规定
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日口服 2–3 次

en.summary: The cited UK capsules contain chlordiazepoxide hydrochloride and have sedative effects.

indications: Short-term relief of severe or disabling anxiety.
contraindications: Contraindications include hypersensitivity, myasthenia gravis, severe respiratory or hepatic insufficiency, and sleep apnea.
majorWarnings: Somnolence, memory impairment and dependence may occur. Rapid reduction or abrupt cessation can trigger withdrawal.
majorInteractions: Opioids, alcohol and other CNS depressants can intensify sedation and respiratory depression.
monitoring: Agree on a discontinuation strategy before starting, and follow symptoms, alertness, breathing and dependence risk.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Label range for the parent drug. Active metabolites have separate kinetics.

doseUseReferences.population: Adults, with separate dosing for older or debilitated patients
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally two or three times daily

zh-CN.summary: 三环类抗抑郁药，英文旧名 dothiepin。过量时心脏毒性突出。

indications: 所引英国说明书用于抑郁症状，尤其伴焦虑者。新开始用药的处方有专科限制。
contraindications: 近期心肌梗死、心脏传导阻滞或其他心律失常、躁狂、严重肝病或对制剂过敏。
majorWarnings: 过量可能致命。可出现嗜睡、抗胆碱作用、体位性低血压及心律异常。
majorInteractions: 避免与 MAOI 合用。酒精、中枢抑制剂和其他抗胆碱药可增加不良反应。
monitoring: 随访情绪、自杀及过量风险、血压和心脏症状。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 说明书对药物及其代谢物报告的约值

doseUseReferences.population: 成人，老年患者另有起始量
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 分次口服或夜间一次口服，按专科评估调整

en.summary: Tricyclic antidepressant formerly named dothiepin, with important cardiotoxicity in overdose.

indications: The cited UK label covers depressive symptoms, particularly with anxiety. Initiation is subject to specialist prescribing restrictions.
contraindications: Recent myocardial infarction, heart block or other arrhythmias, mania, severe hepatic disease, or product hypersensitivity.
majorWarnings: Overdose can be fatal. Somnolence, anticholinergic effects, orthostatic hypotension and arrhythmias can occur.
majorInteractions: Avoid MAOI combinations. Alcohol, CNS depressants and other anticholinergics can increase adverse effects.
monitoring: Follow mood, suicidal or overdose risk, blood pressure and cardiac symptoms.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Approximate value reported in the label for dosulepin and its metabolites

doseUseReferences.population: Adults, with separate starting amounts for older patients
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally in divided doses or once at night, adjusted by specialist assessment

zh-CN.summary: 所引美国制剂为双丙戊酸钠缓释片，标示剂量按丙戊酸当量。

drugClass: 丙戊酸类抗癫痫药及心境稳定剂
indications: 用于躁狂或混合发作、部分癫痫发作以及偏头痛预防。
contraindications: 肝病或显著肝功能异常、规定的 POLG 相关线粒体病、尿素循环障碍或过敏。偏头痛预防时妊娠及未采取有效避孕的可生育女性禁用。
majorWarnings: 有严重肝损伤、胰腺炎和胎儿损害风险，也可能出现血小板减少及高氨血症。
majorInteractions: 可升高拉莫三嗪暴露。碳青霉烯类可大幅降低丙戊酸浓度。
monitoring: 基线及治疗早期监测肝功能，随访血象和凝血指标，有适应证时测血药浓度，意识异常时考虑查血氨。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 丙戊酸口服单药时的平均终末半衰期范围

doseUseReferences.population: 符合说明书条件的成人
doseUseReferences.amountText: 首周每日 500 mg（以丙戊酸计）
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 缓释片每日一次口服，后续按说明书调整

en.summary: The cited US extended-release tablets contain divalproex sodium, with strength expressed as valproic acid equivalent.

drugClass: Valproate antiseizure medicine and mood stabilizer
indications: Used for manic or mixed episodes, selected seizures and migraine prevention.
contraindications: Hepatic disease or significant dysfunction, specified POLG-related mitochondrial disorders, urea-cycle disorders or hypersensitivity. For migraine prevention, contraindicated during pregnancy or in women of childbearing potential without effective contraception.
majorWarnings: Risks include severe hepatic injury, pancreatitis and fetal harm. Thrombocytopenia and hyperammonemia may also occur.
majorInteractions: Can increase lamotrigine exposure. Carbapenems can substantially reduce valproate concentrations.
monitoring: Check hepatic function at baseline and early in treatment. Follow blood counts and coagulation, measure concentrations when indicated, and consider ammonia testing with altered mental status.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Range of mean terminal half-lives during oral valproate monotherapy

doseUseReferences.amountText: 500 mg per day for the first week, expressed as valproic acid
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Extended-release tablet orally once daily, with later titration per label

zh-CN.summary: 所引软胶囊每粒含 192 mg 氯美噻唑游离碱。

indications: 用于老年患者躁动、短期治疗老年重度失眠，以及在严密监护下治疗酒精戒断症状。
contraindications: 对成分过敏或急性肺功能不全。
majorWarnings: 可导致呼吸抑制、过度镇静及依赖。老年患者及肝功能损害患者暴露可能增加。
majorInteractions: 与酒精或其他中枢抑制剂同用可显著增强抑制作用。
monitoring: 随访警觉性、呼吸、治疗反应和依赖风险。

doseUseReferences.amountText: 192–384 mg 游离碱，先试较低量
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 睡前口服 1–2 粒 192 mg 胶囊

en.summary: The cited soft capsules contain 192 mg clomethiazole base each.

indications: Used for restlessness or agitation in older patients, short-term treatment of severe insomnia in older patients, and closely supervised treatment of alcohol withdrawal.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to ingredients or acute pulmonary insufficiency.
majorWarnings: Respiratory depression, excessive sedation and dependence may occur. Exposure may increase in older adults or in hepatic impairment.
majorInteractions: Alcohol and other CNS depressants can substantially increase depressant effects.
monitoring: Follow alertness, breathing, response and dependence risk.

doseUseReferences.amountText: 192–384 mg base, trying the lower amount first
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: One or two 192 mg capsules orally before bed

zh-CN.summary: 此处资料对应盐酸可乐定缓释片。即释片和贴剂的用途、药代和剂量需分别核对。

drugClass: 中枢 α2 受体激动剂
indications: 美国所引缓释片用于 ADHD，可单独使用或辅助兴奋剂治疗。
contraindications: 既往对可乐定过敏。
majorWarnings: 可发生嗜睡、低血压、心动过缓或晕厥。突然停药可引起反跳性高血压。
majorInteractions: 镇静药可加重嗜睡，降压或影响心脏传导的药物可叠加低血压或心动过缓。
monitoring: 治疗前、加量后及治疗期间监测血压和心率，随访镇静。停药需逐渐减量。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

tmax.basis: 健康成人空腹服单次 0.1 mg 缓释片后的均值

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 同一空腹缓释片组的均值

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 睡前口服一片，整片吞服

en.summary: These details apply to clonidine hydrochloride extended-release tablets. Immediate-release tablets and patches have separate indications, kinetics and dosing.

indications: The cited US extended-release tablets are used for ADHD as monotherapy or an adjunct to stimulants.
contraindications: Prior hypersensitivity to clonidine.
majorWarnings: Somnolence, hypotension, bradycardia or syncope can occur. Abrupt cessation can cause rebound hypertension.
majorInteractions: Sedatives can increase drowsiness. Antihypertensive drugs or drugs affecting cardiac conduction can add hypotension or bradycardia.
monitoring: Check blood pressure and pulse at baseline, after dose increases and periodically, and follow sedation. Taper when discontinuing.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

zh-CN.summary: 所引英国口服液为盐酸氯丙嗪 25 mg/5 mL。

indications: 说明书包括精神分裂症及其他精神病性障碍、躁狂，以及特定情境下的短期镇静、止吐或顽固性呃逆治疗。
contraindications: 对成分过敏、昏迷、严重中枢抑制或心血管疾病、血液病史及闭角型青光眼风险等情况禁用。
majorWarnings: 可出现镇静、体位性低血压、QT 延长、异常运动、恶性综合征和严重血液或皮肤反应。
majorInteractions: 酒精及其他中枢抑制剂可增加镇静。延长 QT 间期的药物可增加严重心律失常风险。
monitoring: 评估血压、异常运动及心脏风险，按说明书安排心电图、血象和代谢指标检查。

en.summary: The cited UK oral solution contains chlorpromazine hydrochloride 25 mg per 5 mL.

indications: The label includes schizophrenia and other psychoses, mania, and selected short-term sedation, antiemetic or intractable hiccup indications.
contraindications: Contraindications include ingredient hypersensitivity, coma, severe CNS depression or cardiovascular disease, history of blood dyscrasia and risk of angle-closure glaucoma.
majorWarnings: Sedation, orthostatic hypotension, QT prolongation, abnormal movements, neuroleptic malignant syndrome and serious blood or skin reactions may occur.
majorInteractions: Alcohol and other CNS depressants can intensify sedation. QT-prolonging drugs can increase serious arrhythmia risk.
monitoring: Assess blood pressure, abnormal movements and cardiac risk. Arrange ECG, blood counts and metabolic checks as indicated in the label.

zh-CN.summary: 所引美国制剂为氯氮平口崩片，治疗需进行血液监测。

indications: 用于难治性精神分裂症，以及降低部分精神分裂症或分裂情感障碍患者反复自杀行为的风险。
contraindications: 既往对氯氮平或制剂成分过敏。开始治疗还需符合说明书的基线中性粒细胞要求。
majorWarnings: 严重风险包括中性粒细胞减少、心肌炎、惊厥、初期低血压及严重胃肠蠕动减慢。
majorInteractions: 强 CYP1A2 抑制剂可明显升高暴露。吸烟状态变化可改变血药浓度，其他抗胆碱药可加重便秘。
monitoring: 按说明书在基线及治疗中监测中性粒细胞绝对计数，同时随访排便、体位性血压、心脏症状和代谢指标。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 所引标签中单次 75 mg 资料，均值 8 小时，多次用药可能延长

doseUseReferences.population: 符合基线血象要求的成人
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 口服每日一次或两次，耐受后逐步加量

en.summary: The cited US product is a clozapine orally disintegrating tablet. Treatment requires hematologic monitoring.

indications: Used for treatment-resistant schizophrenia and to reduce recurrent suicidal behavior risk in selected patients with schizophrenia or schizoaffective disorder.
contraindications: Previous hypersensitivity to clozapine or formulation ingredients. Starting therapy also requires meeting label baseline neutrophil criteria.
majorWarnings: Serious risks include neutropenia, myocarditis, seizures, early hypotension and severe gastrointestinal hypomotility.
majorInteractions: Strong CYP1A2 inhibitors can substantially raise exposure. Changes in smoking status can alter concentrations, and other anticholinergics can worsen constipation.
monitoring: Check absolute neutrophil count at baseline and during treatment per the label. Follow bowel function, orthostatic blood pressure, cardiac symptoms and metabolic measures.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Label data after a single 75 mg dose, mean eight hours. Repeated dosing can prolong elimination.

doseUseReferences.population: Adults who meet baseline hematologic criteria
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally once or twice daily, with gradual titration as tolerated

zh-CN.summary: 所引挪威薄膜衣片含盐酸氯普噻吨。

contraindications: 昏迷、中毒所致意识降低、循环衰竭、神经阻滞剂恶性综合征或过敏。特定心脏病、长 QT、未纠正低钾或低镁及合用明显延长 QT 药物也禁用。
majorWarnings: 可发生 QT 延长、镇静、体位性低血压及异常运动。
majorInteractions: 明显延长 QT 间期的药物禁忌合用。酒精及其他中枢抑制剂可增加镇静。
monitoring: 开始前评估心电图，定期检查电解质，按风险复查心电图，并随访体位性低血压及异常运动。

en.summary: The cited Norwegian film-coated tablets contain chlorprothixene hydrochloride.

indications: The Norwegian label covers acute and chronic psychoses and sleep problems associated with mental disorders, as well as adjunctive uses for persistent anxiety and withdrawal symptoms.
contraindications: Contraindications include coma, intoxication-related impaired consciousness, circulatory collapse, neuroleptic malignant syndrome and hypersensitivity. Specified cardiac disease, long QT, uncorrected low potassium or magnesium and coadministration of strongly QT-prolonging drugs are also contraindications.
majorWarnings: QT prolongation, sedation, orthostatic hypotension and abnormal movements can occur.
majorInteractions: Coadministration with drugs that substantially prolong QT is contraindicated. Alcohol and other CNS depressants can intensify sedation.
monitoring: Assess ECG before initiation, monitor electrolytes regularly, repeat ECG according to risk, and follow orthostatic hypotension and abnormal movements.

zh-CN.summary: 佐匹克隆的 S 对映体，所引资料针对普通口服片。

indications: 用于失眠，可缩短入睡时间并改善睡眠维持。
contraindications: 既往服用本药后出现复杂睡眠行为，或对右佐匹克隆过敏。
majorWarnings: 梦游、睡眠驾驶等复杂睡眠行为可造成严重伤害。也可出现次日警觉性受损。
majorInteractions: 酒精和其他中枢抑制剂可叠加镇静。强 CYP3A4 抑制剂可升高暴露。
monitoring: 随访睡眠、次日警觉性、异常睡眠行为和情绪变化。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 母药终末消除约值

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 临睡前口服，距计划起床至少 7–8 小时

en.summary: The S-enantiomer of zopiclone. These details concern standard oral tablets.

indications: Used for insomnia to shorten time to sleep and improve sleep maintenance.
contraindications: Prior complex sleep behavior after taking this drug, or hypersensitivity to eszopiclone.
majorWarnings: Complex sleep behaviors such as sleepwalking or sleep-driving can cause serious injury. Next-day alertness can also be impaired.
majorInteractions: Alcohol and other CNS depressants can add sedation. Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors can increase exposure.
monitoring: Follow sleep, next-day alertness, abnormal sleep behaviors and changes in mood.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Approximate terminal elimination of the parent drug

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally immediately before bed, allowing at least seven to eight hours before planned awakening

zh-CN.summary: 此处资料对应普通口服加巴喷丁。

drugClass: 加巴喷丁类镇痛与抗癫痫药
indications: 用于成人带状疱疹后神经痛，以及局灶起始性癫痫发作的辅助治疗。
contraindications: 对加巴喷丁或制剂成分过敏。
majorWarnings: 可能嗜睡、头晕或步态不稳。存在呼吸风险因素或与阿片合用时可发生严重呼吸抑制。

monitoring: 按肾功能核对剂量，并随访神经痛或发作控制、镇静和呼吸状况。

contraindications: Hypersensitivity to gabapentin or formulation ingredients.

monitoring: Check dosing against renal function and follow pain or seizure control, sedation and breathing.
