contraindications: 嗜铬细胞瘤等分泌儿茶酚胺肿瘤及标签列出的禁忌药物或换药间隔。
majorWarnings: 可发生高血压危象、体位性低血压、血清素综合征和肝损伤。
majorInteractions: 避免高酪胺食物和规定的促血清素或拟交感药物。
monitoring: 监测血压、情绪和肝损伤症状，持续核对用药。

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 分次口服

en.summary: Oral MAOI requiring dietary and interaction review.

indications: Adult major depression inadequately responsive to other antidepressants.
contraindications: Pheochromocytoma or related catecholamine-secreting tumors, and contraindicated medicines or switching intervals.
majorWarnings: Hypertensive crisis, orthostatic hypotension, serotonin syndrome and hepatic injury can occur.
majorInteractions: Avoid high-tyramine food and specified serotonergic or sympathomimetic medicines.
monitoring: Monitor blood pressure, mood and hepatic symptoms, reviewing medicines regularly.

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally in divided doses

zh-CN.summary: 口服催眠药。

indications: 入睡或睡眠维持困难。
contraindications: 发作性睡病。
majorWarnings: 可发生次日警觉性受损、复杂睡眠行为及睡眠瘫痪。
majorInteractions: 强 CYP3A 抑制剂显著升高暴露，酒精和中枢抑制剂增加镇静。
monitoring: 随访睡眠、日间嗜睡、异常行为及情绪。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

doseUseReferences.population: 成人，无需相互作用减量
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每晚最多一次，睡前 30 分钟内服，距起床至少 7 小时

en.summary: Oral hypnotic.

indications: Difficulty initiating or maintaining sleep.
contraindications: Narcolepsy.
majorWarnings: Impaired next-day alertness, complex sleep behaviors and sleep paralysis may occur.
majorInteractions: Strong CYP3A inhibitors raise exposure. Alcohol and CNS depressants add sedation.
monitoring: Follow sleep, daytime somnolence, abnormal behavior and mood.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: At most once nightly within 30 minutes before bed, allowing at least seven hours before awakening

zh-CN.summary: 所引胶囊与口服混悬液不能直接替换。

indications: 成人非 24 小时睡眠觉醒节律障碍。
contraindications: 所引美国标签未列禁忌。
majorWarnings: 可出现嗜睡及警觉性下降。
majorInteractions: 避免强 CYP1A2 抑制剂和强 CYP3A4 诱导剂。
monitoring: 随访睡眠节律和日间警觉性，保持每天同一用药时间。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 母药平均终末值

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日同一时间睡前 1 小时口服，空腹

en.summary: The cited capsules are not directly interchangeable with oral suspension.

indications: Adult non-24-hour sleep-wake disorder.
contraindications: The cited US label lists none.
majorWarnings: Somnolence and impaired alertness can occur.
majorInteractions: Avoid strong CYP1A2 inhibitors and strong CYP3A4 inducers.
monitoring: Follow sleep rhythm and daytime alertness, keeping a consistent daily dosing time.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Mean terminal parent-drug value

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally at the same time nightly, one hour before bed, without food

zh-CN.summary: 所引片剂按索利氨酯计量。

indications: 成人发作性睡病或阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停相关嗜睡。
contraindications: MAOI 合用或停药后 14 天内。
majorWarnings: 可升高血压和心率，或出现焦虑、失眠及精神症状。
majorInteractions: 其他升压药及多巴胺相关药物需谨慎核对。
monitoring: 开始前控制血压，随访血压心率、觉醒和精神症状，并按肾功能调整。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 表观平均终末消除

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 醒来后口服一次

en.summary: Cited tablet strength is expressed as solriamfetol.

indications: Adult sleepiness associated with narcolepsy or obstructive sleep apnea.
contraindications: Concurrent MAOI use or within 14 days of discontinuation.
majorWarnings: Can raise blood pressure and pulse or cause anxiety, insomnia and psychiatric symptoms.
majorInteractions: Review other pressor or dopaminergic medicines carefully.
monitoring: Control blood pressure before treatment and follow pressure, pulse, wakefulness and psychiatric symptoms, adjusting for renal function.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Mean apparent terminal elimination

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally once on awakening

zh-CN.summary: 所引产品为伐尼克兰普通片。

indications: 辅助戒烟。
contraindications: 既往严重过敏或与本药相关的严重皮肤反应。
majorWarnings: 可出现恶心、异常梦境、情绪行为变化及少见惊厥。
majorInteractions: 酒精反应可能改变，戒烟本身可改变某些合用药物需要量。
monitoring: 随访戒烟反应、情绪和耐受，按肾功能核对剂量。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 约值

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 随餐后用水口服，之后按标签滴定

en.summary: The cited product is standard varenicline tablets.

indications: Aid to smoking cessation.
contraindications: Prior serious hypersensitivity or serious drug-related skin reactions.
majorWarnings: Nausea, abnormal dreams, mood or behavioral changes and rare seizures can occur.
majorInteractions: Alcohol responses may change. Smoking cessation itself can alter requirements for other medicines.
monitoring: Follow cessation response, mood and tolerance, checking dose against renal function.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Approximate value

doseUseReferences.amountText: 0.5 mg daily on days one through three
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally with water after food, then titrate per label

zh-CN.summary: 所引资料为舒必利普通口服片。

drugClass: 苯甲酰胺类抗精神病药
indications: 急性和慢性精神分裂症。
contraindications: 过敏、嗜铬细胞瘤、急性卟啉病、泌乳素依赖性肿瘤或合用左旋多巴等抗帕金森药。
majorWarnings: 关注泌乳素升高、异常运动、QT 延长及恶性综合征。
majorInteractions: 多巴胺激动药可相互拮抗，其他延长 QT 药物增加风险。
monitoring: 按肾功能核对剂量，随访心律、运动及泌乳素症状。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 约值

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 早晨及傍晚分两次口服

en.summary: These details concern standard sulpiride oral tablets.

indications: Acute and chronic schizophrenia.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity, pheochromocytoma, acute porphyria, prolactin-dependent tumors or concomitant levodopa and specified antiparkinsonian drugs.
majorWarnings: Watch for elevated prolactin, abnormal movements, QT prolongation and neuroleptic malignant syndrome.
majorInteractions: Dopamine agonists can oppose effects. Other QT-prolonging medicines add risk.
monitoring: Check dosing against renal function and follow cardiac, movement and prolactin symptoms.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Approximate value

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally in two doses, morning and early evening

sourceRefs.title: Trifluoperazine 5 mg/5 mL oral solution SmPC

zh-CN.summary: 所引制剂为三氟拉嗪口服液。

indications: 精神分裂症等精神病性症状，以及标签所列低剂量短期用途。
contraindications: 过敏、昏迷、血液病、肝损害或未控制的心功能失代偿。
majorWarnings: 可发生异常运动、迟发性运动障碍、低血压及恶性综合征。
majorInteractions: 其他中枢抑制剂可增强镇静，核对延长 QT 用药。
monitoring: 随访疗效、运动、血压及必要的血液和心脏检查。

sourceRefs.title: Trifluoperazine 5 mg/5 mL oral solution SmPC

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

sourceRefs.title: Trifluoperazine 5 mg/5 mL oral solution SmPC

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 终末相约值，区别于早期相

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日两次口服

sourceRefs.title: Trifluoperazine 5 mg/5 mL oral solution SmPC

en.summary: The cited product is trifluoperazine oral solution.

indications: Schizophrenia and other psychotic symptoms, plus labeled low-dose short-term uses.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity, coma, blood disorders, hepatic damage or uncontrolled cardiac decompensation.
majorWarnings: Abnormal movements, tardive dyskinesia, hypotension and neuroleptic malignant syndrome may occur.
majorInteractions: Other CNS depressants intensify sedation. Check QT-prolonging medicines.
monitoring: Follow response, movement, blood pressure and indicated blood or cardiac tests.

sourceRefs.title: Trifluoperazine 5 mg/5 mL oral solution SmPC

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

sourceRefs.title: Trifluoperazine 5 mg/5 mL oral solution SmPC

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Approximate terminal-phase value, distinct from the early phase

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally twice daily

sourceRefs.title: Trifluoperazine 5 mg/5 mL oral solution SmPC

zh-CN.summary: 心律风险限制使用的口服抗精神病药。

indications: 其他抗精神病药反应不足的精神分裂症。
contraindications: 长 QT、心律失常病史、低 CYP2D6 活性或相关抑制剂、其他延长 QT 药物及标签禁忌。
majorWarnings: 可发生严重 QT 延长、尖端扭转型室速和异常运动。
majorInteractions: 氟西汀等 CYP2D6 抑制剂及其他延长 QT 药物可造成严重心律风险。
monitoring: 开始前及调量时按标签评估心电图、电解质及合用药。

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日三次口服，按反应及心律监测调整

en.summary: Oral antipsychotic whose use is limited by cardiac risk.

indications: Schizophrenia inadequately responsive to other antipsychotics.
contraindications: Long QT, prior arrhythmia, reduced CYP2D6 activity or relevant inhibitors, other QT-prolonging drugs and labeled restrictions.
majorWarnings: Serious QT prolongation, torsades and abnormal movements can occur.
majorInteractions: CYP2D6 inhibitors such as fluoxetine and other QT-prolonging medicines can cause serious cardiac risk.
monitoring: Assess ECG, electrolytes and combinations before treatment and during titration per label.

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally three times daily, adjusted to response and cardiac monitoring

zh-CN.summary: 所引胶囊含马来酸曲米帕明，强度以曲米帕明计。

indications: 抑郁症状。
contraindications: 相关过敏、MAOI 合用及规定停药间隔、急性心肌梗死恢复期。
majorWarnings: 关注镇静、抗胆碱反应、心律异常及过量毒性。
majorInteractions: 中枢抑制剂、抗胆碱药及 CYP2D6 抑制剂增加相关风险。
monitoring: 随访情绪、血压和心脏及抗胆碱症状。

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 分次口服，之后按反应调整

en.summary: Cited capsules contain trimipramine maleate with strength expressed as trimipramine.

indications: Depressive symptoms.
contraindications: Related hypersensitivity, MAOI combinations or specified washouts, and acute recovery after myocardial infarction.
majorWarnings: Watch for sedation, anticholinergic effects, arrhythmias and overdose toxicity.
majorInteractions: CNS depressants, anticholinergics and CYP2D6 inhibitors add related risks.
monitoring: Follow mood, blood pressure, cardiac and anticholinergic symptoms.

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally in divided doses, then adjust to response

zh-CN.summary: 此处为用于抑郁症的司来吉兰透皮贴剂。口服抗帕金森产品另查。

indications: 成人重性抑郁障碍。
contraindications: 嗜铬细胞瘤、12 岁以下及多种禁忌合用药或换药间隔。
majorWarnings: 关注血清素综合征、高血压危象、低血压及贴敷反应。
majorInteractions: 其他抗抑郁药及特定阿片等禁忌合用，较高规格贴剂需按标签限制酪胺。
monitoring: 随访血压、情绪、皮肤反应及相互作用，避免外部热源。

notes: 透皮给药减少首过代谢。标签将静脉给药后母药及三种代谢物的平均半衰期合并报告为 18–25 小时。

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日更换一片，移除旧贴片并轮换部位

en.summary: These details concern selegiline transdermal patches for depression. Oral Parkinson products have separate labeling.

indications: Major depressive disorder in adults.
contraindications: Pheochromocytoma, age under 12, and numerous interacting medicines or switching periods.
majorWarnings: Watch for serotonin syndrome, hypertensive crisis, hypotension and application-site reactions.
majorInteractions: Other antidepressants and specified opioids are contraindicated. Higher-strength patches require label tyramine restrictions.
monitoring: Follow blood pressure, mood, skin reactions and interactions. Avoid external heat.

notes: Transdermal delivery reduces first-pass metabolism. The label reports the means for parent and three metabolites after intravenous dosing collectively as 18–25 hours.

doseUseReferences.amountText: Initial delivery of 6 mg per 24 hours
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Replace daily, removing the old patch and rotating sites

zh-CN.summary: 所引口服液含丙戊酸钠，强度按丙戊酸当量。

indications: 标签所列局灶和失神等癫痫发作。
contraindications: 显著肝病、规定的 POLG 线粒体病、尿素循环障碍或相关过敏。
majorWarnings: 有肝毒性、胰腺炎、胎儿损伤、高氨及血小板减少风险。
majorInteractions: 可升高拉莫三嗪暴露，碳青霉烯类可降低丙戊酸浓度。
monitoring: 监测肝功能、血象及临床反应，必要时测血药及血氨。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 口服丙戊酸单药范围

doseUseReferences.population: 成人及 10 岁以上患者
doseUseReferences.amountText: 起始每日 10–15 mg/kg（丙戊酸当量）
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 口服，日总量超过 250 mg 时分次，按标签滴定

en.summary: The cited solution contains sodium valproate with strength expressed as valproic acid equivalent.

indications: Labeled partial, absence and selected other seizures.
contraindications: Significant hepatic disease, specified POLG-related mitochondrial disease, urea-cycle disorders or related hypersensitivity.
majorWarnings: Risks include hepatotoxicity, pancreatitis, fetal harm, hyperammonemia and thrombocytopenia.
majorInteractions: Can raise lamotrigine exposure. Carbapenems can lower valproate concentrations.
monitoring: Monitor hepatic function, blood counts and response, measuring drug or ammonia levels when indicated.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Range during oral valproate monotherapy

doseUseReferences.population: Adults and patients aged ten or older
doseUseReferences.amountText: Initial 10–15 mg/kg/day, as valproic acid equivalent
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally in divided doses above 250 mg/day, titrating per label

zh-CN.summary: 所引片剂含噻奈普汀钠。

indications: 重性抑郁发作。
contraindications: 过敏及 15 岁以下，MAOI 合用需遵守标签停药间隔。
majorWarnings: 有滥用、依赖及戒断风险，关注自杀意念和低钠。
majorInteractions: 非选择性 MAOI 可造成严重反应，避免酒精。
monitoring: 随访情绪、剂量使用及依赖，特殊人群按标签减量。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 母药终末约值，活性代谢物另计

doseUseReferences.population: 成人，特殊人群另有减量
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 三餐开始时各口服一次

en.summary: The cited tablets contain tianeptine sodium.

indications: Major depressive episodes.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity or age below 15. MAOI combinations require label washout precautions.
majorWarnings: Misuse, dependence and withdrawal are risks. Watch for suicidal thoughts and hyponatremia.
majorInteractions: Nonselective MAOIs can cause serious reactions. Avoid alcohol.
monitoring: Follow mood, dose use and dependence, reducing doses for specified populations.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Approximate terminal parent-drug value, distinct from active metabolite

doseUseReferences.population: Adults, with reduction for specified populations
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally at the start of each main meal

zh-CN.summary: 口服抗精神病药，使用受心血管安全要求限制。

indications: 至少一种其他抗精神病药不耐受患者的精神分裂症。
contraindications: QT 延长、特定心脏病、未纠正低钾低镁、严重肝损害及禁忌合用药等。
majorWarnings: 可能延长 QT 和引起体位性低血压。
majorInteractions: 其他延长 QT 或强 CYP3A 抑制剂等禁忌合用。
monitoring: 按标签在治疗前及治疗中监测心电图、电解质和血压。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 平均约 3 天

doseUseReferences.population: 符合心脏安全条件的成人
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日一次口服，每 4–5 天按标签逐步加量

en.summary: Oral antipsychotic with cardiovascular safety restrictions.

indications: Schizophrenia in patients intolerant of at least one other antipsychotic.
contraindications: Contraindications include QT prolongation, specified cardiac disease, uncorrected low potassium or magnesium, severe hepatic impairment and interacting drugs.
majorWarnings: May prolong QT and cause orthostatic hypotension.
majorInteractions: Other QT-prolonging drugs or strong CYP3A inhibitors are among contraindicated combinations.
monitoring: Monitor ECG, electrolytes and blood pressure before and during treatment per label.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Mean about three days

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally once daily, with label titration every four to five days

zh-CN.summary: 所引片剂含盐酸硫必利，强度按硫必利计。

indications: 酒精相关患者激越攻击性的短期治疗及重度亨廷顿舞蹈病。
contraindications: 过敏、泌乳素依赖性肿瘤、嗜铬细胞瘤或合用左旋多巴等多巴胺药。
majorWarnings: 关注 QT 延长、异常运动、泌乳素升高及恶性综合征。
majorInteractions: 延长 QT 或影响电解质的药物可增加心律风险，酒精增加镇静。
monitoring: 按肾功能减量，随访心律、运动及疗效。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 健康年轻志愿者口服资料

doseUseReferences.indication: 标签所列激越或攻击性
doseUseReferences.population: 老年患者，按肾功能另行调整
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 口服，按反应逐步调整及限制疗程

en.summary: Cited tablets contain tiapride hydrochloride with strength expressed as tiapride.

indications: Short-term agitation or aggression in alcoholic patients and severe Huntington chorea.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity, prolactin-dependent tumors, pheochromocytoma or concomitant levodopa and specified dopamine drugs.
majorWarnings: Watch for QT prolongation, abnormal movements, elevated prolactin and neuroleptic malignant syndrome.
majorInteractions: QT-prolonging or electrolyte-altering drugs add cardiac risk. Alcohol adds sedation.
monitoring: Reduce doses for renal impairment and follow cardiac risk, movement and response.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Oral data in healthy young volunteers

doseUseReferences.population: Older patients, with further renal adjustment
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally, titrating to response and observing duration limits

zh-CN.summary: 所引制剂为托非索泮 50 mg 口服片。

drugClass: 苯二氮䓬类相关抗焦虑药
indications: 伴紧张、焦虑、自主神经症状的心理或躯体疾病，以及酒精戒断相关自主神经症状。
contraindications: 相关过敏、失代偿性呼吸功能不全、睡眠呼吸暂停或昏迷病史，以及合用他克莫司、西罗莫司或环孢素。
majorWarnings: 可出现激越、失眠、胃肠不适及呼吸抑制，癫痫者可能诱发发作。
majorInteractions: 上述免疫抑制剂禁忌合用，阿片及其他中枢抑制剂可增加呼吸风险。
monitoring: 随访焦虑、激越及呼吸，核对肝肾功能和合用药。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 生物半衰期

doseUseReferences.indication: 标签所列焦虑相关状态
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日口服 1–3 次，按临床反应调整

en.summary: The cited product is tofisopam 50 mg oral tablets.

indications: Psychological or somatic conditions with tension, anxiety or autonomic symptoms, and autonomic symptoms of alcohol withdrawal.
contraindications: Related hypersensitivity, decompensated respiratory insufficiency, sleep-apnea or coma history, or concomitant tacrolimus, sirolimus or cyclosporine.
majorWarnings: Agitation, insomnia, gastrointestinal symptoms or respiratory depression may occur. Seizures can be provoked in epilepsy.
majorInteractions: The listed immunosuppressants are contraindicated. Opioids and other CNS depressants add respiratory risk.
monitoring: Follow anxiety, agitation and breathing, checking hepatic or renal status and concurrent medicines.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Biological half-life

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally one to three times daily, individualized to response

zh-CN.summary: 所引制剂为酒石酸唑吡坦即释片。

indications: 短期治疗入睡困难。
contraindications: 既往用药后发生复杂睡眠行为，或对唑吡坦过敏。
majorWarnings: 可能出现睡眠驾驶等复杂睡眠行为、次日警觉性下降、依赖及戒断。
majorInteractions: 酒精及其他中枢抑制剂可增加镇静。
monitoring: 随访睡眠、异常行为及次日警觉性，持续失眠需复评。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 5 mg 即释片研究范围，均值 2.6 小时

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 临睡前单次口服，保证至少 7–8 小时睡眠

en.summary: The cited product is immediate-release zolpidem tartrate tablets.

indications: Short-term treatment of difficulty initiating sleep.
contraindications: Prior complex sleep behavior after use or hypersensitivity to zolpidem.
majorWarnings: Complex sleep behaviors such as sleep-driving, next-day impairment, dependence and withdrawal can occur.
majorInteractions: Alcohol and other CNS depressants can intensify sedation.
monitoring: Follow sleep, abnormal behavior and next-day alertness, reassessing persistent insomnia.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Range for 5 mg immediate-release tablets, mean 2.6 hours

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Single oral dose immediately before bed with at least 7–8 hours available for sleep

zh-CN.summary: 所引英国制剂为佐匹克隆口服片。

indications: 成人失眠短期治疗。
contraindications: 重症肌无力、呼吸衰竭、严重睡眠呼吸暂停或肝功能不全、相关过敏及既往复杂睡眠行为。
majorWarnings: 可出现嗜睡、记忆损害、复杂睡眠行为、依赖及戒断。
majorInteractions: 酒精、阿片及其他中枢抑制剂增加镇静与呼吸风险。
monitoring: 随访睡眠、次日警觉性、呼吸及依赖，治疗前安排停药方案。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 平均约值

doseUseReferences.population: 成人，老年及肝肾呼吸功能异常另有减量
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 睡前单次口服，当晚不再重复

en.summary: The cited UK product is zopiclone oral tablets.

indications: Short-term treatment of insomnia in adults.
contraindications: Myasthenia gravis, respiratory failure, severe sleep apnea or hepatic insufficiency, related hypersensitivity and prior complex sleep behavior.
majorWarnings: Somnolence, memory impairment, complex sleep behavior, dependence and withdrawal may occur.
majorInteractions: Alcohol, opioids and other CNS depressants increase sedation and respiratory risk.
monitoring: Follow sleep, next-day alertness, breathing and dependence, with a discontinuation plan before treatment.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Approximate mean

doseUseReferences.population: Adults, with separate reductions for older patients and organ impairment
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: One oral dose before bed, without repeat dosing that night

zh-CN.summary: 所引胶囊含盐酸齐拉西酮，强度按齐拉西酮计。

indications: 精神分裂症及双相躁狂或混合发作等标签用途。
contraindications: 已知 QT 延长、近期心肌梗死、未代偿心衰、相关过敏及合用延长 QT 的药物。
majorWarnings: 可延长 QT，引起低血压、异常运动及恶性综合征。
majorInteractions: 其他延长 QT 药物增加心律风险。
monitoring: 评估心电图和电解质，随访体重、代谢及运动症状。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 平均终末值

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日两次随餐口服

en.summary: The cited capsules contain ziprasidone hydrochloride, with strength expressed as ziprasidone.

indications: Schizophrenia and labeled uses in bipolar manic or mixed episodes.
contraindications: Known QT prolongation, recent myocardial infarction, uncompensated heart failure, related hypersensitivity or concomitant QT-prolonging drugs.
majorWarnings: Can prolong QT and cause hypotension, abnormal movements or neuroleptic malignant syndrome.
majorInteractions: Other QT-prolonging drugs increase cardiac risk.
monitoring: Assess ECG and electrolytes, and follow weight, metabolism and movement symptoms.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Mean terminal value

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally twice daily with food

zh-CN.summary: 此处资料针对口服片，长效注射产品另查。

indications: 精神病性障碍，尤其精神分裂症。
contraindications: 相关过敏、循环衰竭、意识抑制或昏迷。
majorWarnings: 关注镇静、体位性低血压、异常运动和恶性综合征。
majorInteractions: 酒精及中枢抑制剂增加镇静，延长 QT 的药物增加心律风险。
monitoring: 随访血压、运动和心脏风险，按说明书评估疗效。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 口服后生物半衰期约 1 天

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 分次口服

en.summary: These details concern oral tablets. Depot injections have separate labeling.

indications: Psychoses, especially schizophrenia.
contraindications: Related hypersensitivity, circulatory collapse, depressed consciousness or coma.
majorWarnings: Watch for sedation, orthostatic hypotension, abnormal movements and neuroleptic malignant syndrome.
majorInteractions: Alcohol and CNS depressants add sedation. QT-prolonging medicines add cardiac risk.
monitoring: Follow blood pressure, movement and cardiac risk, assessing response per label.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Oral biological half-life about one day

doseUseReferences.population: Adults, with lower doses for older patients
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally in divided doses

zh-CN.summary: 所引片剂含氢溴酸伏硫西汀，强度按伏硫西汀计。

drugClass: 血清素调节型抗抑郁药
indications: 成人重性抑郁障碍。
contraindications: 相关过敏或规定的 MAOI 禁用期。
majorWarnings: 关注血清素综合征、出血、低钠、情绪变化及性功能不良。
majorInteractions: 强 CYP2D6 抑制剂可升高暴露，其他促血清素药增加血清素综合征风险。
monitoring: 随访情绪、疗效和耐受，核对换药间隔及相互作用。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 平均终末值

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日一次口服

en.summary: Cited tablets contain vortioxetine hydrobromide with strength expressed as vortioxetine.

indications: Major depressive disorder in adults.
contraindications: Related hypersensitivity or a specified MAOI period.
majorWarnings: Watch for serotonin syndrome, bleeding, hyponatremia, mood changes and sexual dysfunction.
majorInteractions: Strong CYP2D6 inhibitors increase exposure. Other serotonergic drugs add serotonin syndrome risk.
monitoring: Follow mood, response and tolerance, checking switching intervals and interactions.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Mean terminal value

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally once daily

zh-CN.summary: 所引口服片含盐酸维拉佐酮，需随餐服用。

drugClass: 血清素调节型抗抑郁药
indications: 成人重性抑郁障碍。
contraindications: 规定的 MAOI 禁用期。
majorWarnings: 可出现腹泻、恶心、出血、低钠、血清素综合征及停药症状。
majorInteractions: 促血清素药增加血清素综合征风险，CYP3A4 调节剂可改变暴露。
monitoring: 随访情绪、胃肠耐受和停药症状，核对合用药。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 平均终末值

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 随餐每日一次口服，之后按标签滴定

en.summary: The cited vilazodone hydrochloride tablets are taken with food.

indications: Major depressive disorder in adults.
contraindications: A specified MAOI washout.
majorWarnings: Diarrhea, nausea, bleeding, hyponatremia, serotonin syndrome and discontinuation symptoms can occur.
majorInteractions: Serotonergic medicines add serotonin syndrome risk. CYP3A4 modulators alter exposure.
monitoring: Follow mood, gastrointestinal tolerance and discontinuation effects, checking concurrent drugs.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Mean terminal value

doseUseReferences.amountText: 10 mg daily for the first seven days
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally once daily with food, then titrate per label

zh-CN.summary: 所引产品为扎来普隆口服胶囊。

indications: 失眠短期治疗，主要研究入睡时间。
contraindications: 既往本药引起复杂睡眠行为或相关过敏。
majorWarnings: 可能发生嗜睡、异常睡眠行为、依赖和戒断。
majorInteractions: 酒精及其他中枢抑制剂增加镇静与呼吸风险。
monitoring: 随访睡眠及异常行为，持续失眠需复评。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 终末相约值

doseUseReferences.population: 成人，老年或肝功能异常另有减量
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 临睡前口服单次

en.summary: The cited product is zaleplon oral capsules.

indications: Short-term insomnia treatment, studied primarily for sleep onset.
contraindications: Prior drug-related complex sleep behavior or related hypersensitivity.
majorWarnings: Somnolence, abnormal sleep behaviors, dependence and withdrawal may occur.
majorInteractions: Alcohol and other CNS depressants increase sedation and respiratory risk.
monitoring: Follow sleep and abnormal behavior, reassessing persistent insomnia.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Approximate terminal-phase value

doseUseReferences.population: Adults, with lower dosing for older patients or hepatic impairment
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: One oral dose immediately before bed

zh-CN.summary: 所引美国制剂为盐酸维洛沙嗪缓释胶囊。

drugClass: 非兴奋剂类 ADHD 药
indications: 成人及 6 岁以上儿童 ADHD。
contraindications: MAOI 合用或规定停药期，以及敏感或治疗范围窄的 CYP1A2 底物合用。
majorWarnings: 关注自杀意念、心率血压升高、嗜睡和躁狂激活。
majorInteractions: 抑制 CYP1A2，禁忌合用规定底物，其他药物需核对。
monitoring: 治疗前后检查血压心率，随访情绪、睡眠和疗效。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 母药平均值

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日一次口服，按标签每周调整

en.summary: The cited US product is viloxazine hydrochloride extended-release capsules.

indications: ADHD in adults and children aged six or older.
contraindications: MAOI combinations or specified washouts, and concomitant sensitive or narrow-therapeutic-range CYP1A2 substrates.
majorWarnings: Watch for suicidal thoughts, increased pulse or blood pressure, somnolence and activation of mania.
majorInteractions: Inhibits CYP1A2. Specified substrates are contraindicated and other medicines require review.
monitoring: Check blood pressure and pulse before and during treatment, and follow mood, sleep and response.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Mean parent-drug value

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally once daily, with weekly adjustment per label

zh-CN.summary: 所引日本制剂为佐替平片剂及细粒。

indications: 精神分裂症。
contraindications: 昏迷或循环衰竭、处于强中枢抑制剂影响下、相关过敏，以及标签规定的肾上腺素合用禁忌。
majorWarnings: 关注镇静、异常运动、低血压、心电图异常及恶性综合征。
majorInteractions: 中枢抑制剂和酒精可增强镇静。肾上腺素合用有标签所列紧急抢救及牙科例外。
monitoring: 随访运动症状、警觉性、血压、心脏及血液异常。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

tmax.basis: 5 名精神分裂症患者单次口服 100 mg

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 同一小样本研究约值

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 分次口服，按反应调整

en.summary: The cited Japanese products are zotepine tablets and fine granules.

indications: Schizophrenia.
contraindications: Coma or circulatory collapse, strong CNS-depressant effects, related hypersensitivity and label-specific epinephrine contraindications.
majorWarnings: Watch for sedation, abnormal movements, hypotension, ECG abnormalities and neuroleptic malignant syndrome.
majorInteractions: CNS depressants and alcohol can add sedation. The epinephrine interaction has label exceptions for emergency anaphylaxis treatment and specified dental anesthesia.
monitoring: Follow movements, alertness, blood pressure, cardiac and hematologic abnormalities.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

tmax.basis: Five patients with schizophrenia after one oral 100 mg dose

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Approximate value in the same small study

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally in divided doses, adjusted to response

zh-CN.summary: 所引产品为盐酸胺碘酮口服片。

indications: 其他治疗无效或不耐受时，治疗危及生命的复发性室颤或血流动力学不稳定室速。
contraindications: 心源性休克、无起搏器的病态窦房结或高级房室传导阻滞、导致晕厥的心动过缓及相关过敏。
majorWarnings: 可发生肺毒性、肝损伤、甲状腺异常、心动过缓及心律失常。
majorInteractions: 与华法林、地高辛及多种影响心律或代谢的药物相互作用可持续至停药后。
monitoring: 按标签监测肺、肝、甲状腺及心电图，核对合并用药。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 母药跨个体范围，单位天

timeCourse.effectTimelineNote: 胺碘酮终末半衰期为 15–142 天，且负荷剂量与组织蓄积使单次给药曲线失真，因此不绘制时间轴。

doseUseReferences.indication: 危及生命的室性心律失常
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 口服 1–3 周，按反应及专科监测调整

en.summary: The cited product is amiodarone hydrochloride oral tablets.

indications: Life-threatening recurrent ventricular fibrillation or hemodynamically unstable ventricular tachycardia when alternatives fail or are not tolerated.
contraindications: Cardiogenic shock, sick sinus or high-grade AV block without a pacemaker, bradycardia causing syncope, or related hypersensitivity.
majorWarnings: Pulmonary toxicity, hepatic injury, thyroid abnormalities, bradycardia and arrhythmias can occur.
majorInteractions: Interactions with warfarin, digoxin and many cardiac or metabolic drugs can persist after discontinuation.
monitoring: Monitor pulmonary, hepatic, thyroid and ECG status per label, reviewing concurrent medicines.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Parent-drug range across patients, in days

timeCourse.effectTimelineNote: Amiodarone's terminal half-life is 15–142 days, and loading-dose tissue accumulation makes a single-dose curve misleading, so no timeline is drawn.

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally for one to three weeks, adjusted to response under specialist monitoring

zh-CN.summary: 所引资料针对口服阿哌沙班片。

drugClass: 直接 Xa 因子抑制剂
indications: 降低非瓣膜性房颤患者卒中及全身栓塞风险，并用于标签所列静脉血栓预防与治疗。
contraindications: 活动性病理性出血或严重过敏。
majorWarnings: 可发生严重出血，脊髓或硬膜外操作时有血肿风险。
majorInteractions: 其他抗凝药、抗血小板药或 NSAID 可增加出血。强双重 CYP3A4/P-gp 抑制剂和诱导剂影响暴露。
monitoring: 随访出血及肾肝功能，按年龄、体重、肌酐及适应证核对剂量。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 表观约值

doseUseReferences.indication: 非瓣膜性房颤卒中预防
doseUseReferences.population: 成人，不符合标签减量条件
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日两次口服

en.summary: These details concern oral apixaban tablets.

indications: Reduces stroke and systemic embolism in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation and treats or prevents labeled venous thromboembolism.
contraindications: Active pathological bleeding or severe hypersensitivity.
majorWarnings: Serious bleeding can occur, with spinal or epidural hematoma risk around neuraxial procedures.
majorInteractions: Anticoagulants, antiplatelets or NSAIDs add bleeding risk. Strong dual CYP3A4/P-gp inhibitors or inducers alter exposure.
monitoring: Follow bleeding and renal or hepatic function, checking dosing against age, weight, creatinine and indication.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Approximate apparent value

doseUseReferences.indication: Stroke prevention in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation
doseUseReferences.population: Adults who do not meet label dose-reduction criteria
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally twice daily

zh-CN.summary: 所引片剂为苯磺酸氨氯地平，强度按氨氯地平计。

drugClass: 二氢吡啶类钙通道阻滞剂
indications: 高血压及标签所列慢性稳定性或血管痉挛性心绞痛等冠心病用途。
contraindications: 对氨氯地平过敏。
majorWarnings: 可能出现外周水肿、头晕、低血压或心悸。
majorInteractions: CYP3A4 抑制剂可增加暴露，与辛伐他汀合用需遵守标签剂量限制。
monitoring: 随访血压、水肿及心绞痛症状，肝功能损害时谨慎滴定。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 终末消除范围

doseUseReferences.population: 成人，体弱老年及肝损害者另有较低起始量
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日一次口服

en.summary: The cited tablets contain amlodipine besylate with strength expressed as amlodipine.

indications: Hypertension and labeled coronary disease uses including chronic stable or vasospastic angina.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to amlodipine.
majorWarnings: Peripheral edema, dizziness, hypotension or palpitations can occur.
majorInteractions: CYP3A4 inhibitors can increase exposure. Observe the label simvastatin limit when combined.
monitoring: Follow blood pressure, edema and angina, titrating cautiously in hepatic impairment.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Terminal elimination range

doseUseReferences.population: Adults, with lower initiation in frail older adults or hepatic impairment
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally once daily

zh-CN.summary: 所引产品为阿替洛尔口服片。

indications: 高血压、心绞痛及特定心肌梗死患者的治疗。
contraindications: 窦性心动过缓、一度以上房室传导阻滞、心源性休克、明显心衰或过敏。
majorWarnings: 可发生心动过缓、低血压或心衰恶化，突然停药可加重缺血。
majorInteractions: 与维拉帕米、地尔硫䓬或其他减慢心率药物合用可叠加传导抑制。
monitoring: 随访血压、心率及心衰症状，按肾功能核对剂量。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 口服后消除范围

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日一次口服

en.summary: The cited product is atenolol oral tablets.

indications: Hypertension, angina and treatment in selected myocardial infarction patients.
contraindications: Sinus bradycardia, greater than first-degree heart block, cardiogenic shock, overt heart failure or hypersensitivity.
majorWarnings: Bradycardia, hypotension or worsening heart failure can occur. Abrupt withdrawal can worsen ischemia.
majorInteractions: Verapamil, diltiazem or other heart-rate-lowering drugs can add conduction suppression.
monitoring: Follow blood pressure, pulse and heart-failure symptoms, checking dose against renal function.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Oral elimination range

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally once daily

zh-CN.summary: 所引片剂含阿托伐他汀钙，强度按阿托伐他汀计。

indications: 降低 LDL 胆固醇及标签所列高风险人群的心血管事件。
contraindications: 急性肝衰竭、失代偿性肝硬化或严重过敏。
majorWarnings: 可发生肌病、横纹肌溶解和肝损伤。
majorInteractions: 部分 CYP3A4 或转运蛋白抑制剂可升高暴露，某些合用药需限制剂量。
monitoring: 按疗效检查 LDL-C，并评估肌痛、无力和肝损伤症状。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 母药平均消除约值，抑制活性持续更久

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日一次口服

en.summary: Cited tablets contain atorvastatin calcium with strength expressed as atorvastatin.

indications: Reduces LDL cholesterol and cardiovascular events in labeled high-risk populations.
contraindications: Acute liver failure, decompensated cirrhosis or serious hypersensitivity.
majorWarnings: Myopathy, rhabdomyolysis and hepatic injury can occur.
majorInteractions: Some CYP3A4 or transporter inhibitors increase exposure. Certain combinations require dose limits.
monitoring: Check LDL-C for response and assess muscle pain, weakness and hepatic symptoms.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Approximate mean parent-drug elimination; inhibitory activity persists longer

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally once daily

zh-CN.summary: 所引制剂为安立生坦口服片。

indications: 成人 WHO 第 1 组肺动脉高压，可单用或按标签与他达拉非合用。
contraindications: 妊娠及特发性肺纤维化。
majorWarnings: 可造成胎儿损害、体液潴留和血红蛋白下降。
majorInteractions: 环孢素可增加暴露，合用需按标签限制剂量。
monitoring: 遵循当地妊娠预防及检测要求，随访水肿和血红蛋白。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 终末消除约值，有效半衰期另计

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日一次口服

en.summary: The cited product is oral ambrisentan tablets.

indications: Adult WHO group 1 pulmonary arterial hypertension, alone or with tadalafil per label.
contraindications: Pregnancy and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.
majorWarnings: Can cause fetal harm, fluid retention and decreased hemoglobin.
majorInteractions: Cyclosporine increases exposure and requires a label dose limit.
monitoring: Follow local pregnancy-prevention and testing requirements and monitor edema and hemoglobin.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Approximate terminal elimination, distinct from effective half-life

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally once daily

zh-CN.summary: 所引片剂含盐酸阿米洛利。

indications: 与排钾利尿药合用，帮助治疗高血压或充血性心衰并预防低钾。
contraindications: 高钾、显著肾功能障碍、尿闭或与其他保钾药及补钾剂的标签禁忌合用。
majorWarnings: 可发生危及生命的高钾血症，肾功能受损或糖尿病患者风险增加。
majorInteractions: ACE 抑制剂、ARB 等可增加高钾风险。
monitoring: 开始及调整治疗时监测血钾和肾功能。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 血清约范围

doseUseReferences.indication: 合用利尿药治疗高血压或心衰
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 随餐每日一次口服

en.summary: The cited tablets contain amiloride hydrochloride.

indications: Added to potassium-wasting diuretics for hypertension or congestive heart failure and prevention of hypokalemia.
contraindications: Hyperkalemia, significant renal impairment, anuria or contraindicated use with other potassium-sparing drugs or potassium supplements.
majorWarnings: Life-threatening hyperkalemia can occur, with greater risk in renal impairment or diabetes.
majorInteractions: ACE inhibitors, ARBs and related drugs increase hyperkalemia risk.
monitoring: Monitor potassium and renal function at initiation and adjustment.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Approximate serum range

doseUseReferences.indication: Adjunctive diuresis for hypertension or heart failure
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally once daily with food

zh-CN.summary: 所引制剂含阿齐沙坦酯，剂量按阿齐沙坦酯钾计。

drugClass: 血管紧张素 II 受体拮抗剂
indications: 治疗成人高血压。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 血浆估计值，生物效应更持久

doseUseReferences.amountText: 每日 2.5–10 mg，较高剂量少有必要
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日一次口服

en.summary: The cited New Zealand product is also called bendrofluazide.

indications: Essential hypertension and edema associated with selected cardiac, hepatic or renal disease.
contraindications: Severe hepatic or renal impairment, specified electrolyte abnormalities, Addison disease, diabetic ketoacidosis, lithium treatment or related hypersensitivity.
majorWarnings: Hypokalemia, hyponatremia, hyperuricemia and dehydration can occur.
majorInteractions: The New Zealand label contraindicates lithium coadministration. Other antihypertensives add hypotension.
monitoring: Monitor blood pressure, electrolytes and renal function, checking uric acid by risk.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Estimated plasma value, with a longer biological effect

doseUseReferences.amountText: 2.5–10 mg daily, with doses above 2.5 mg rarely needed
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally once daily

zh-CN.summary: 所引胶囊含羟苯磺酸钙一水合物。

indications: 西班牙标签用于非增殖性糖尿病视网膜病变。
contraindications: 对成分或辅料过敏。
majorWarnings: 罕见粒细胞缺乏及严重过敏。
majorInteractions: 可干扰酶法肌酐检测，使结果偏低。
monitoring: 发热或口咽部感染症状时按标签检查血象，肾功能减退需评估剂量。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

tmax.basis: 健康受试者单次口服 500 mg

doseUseReferences.indication: 非增殖性糖尿病视网膜病变
doseUseReferences.amountText: 每日 1500–2000 mg 一水合物
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 分两次口服，宜餐后

en.summary: The cited capsules contain calcium dobesilate monohydrate.

indications: The Spanish label covers nonproliferative diabetic retinopathy.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to the active substance or ingredients.
majorWarnings: Rare agranulocytosis and serious hypersensitivity can occur.
majorInteractions: Can interfere with enzymatic creatinine assays and cause falsely low results.
monitoring: Check blood counts with fever or oropharyngeal infection symptoms per label. Assess dosing in renal impairment.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

tmax.basis: Healthy volunteers after one oral 500 mg dose

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally in two doses, preferably after meals

zh-CN.summary: 所引资料为 2020 年美国贝曲沙班胶囊说明书。

drugClass: 直接 Xa 因子抑制剂
indications: 预防符合标签条件、活动受限的急性内科住院患者静脉血栓。
contraindications: 活动性病理性出血或严重过敏。
majorWarnings: 可发生严重出血，脊髓或硬膜外操作存在血肿风险。
majorInteractions: P-gp 抑制剂增加暴露并需按标签减量，其他抗栓药增加出血。
monitoring: 监测出血、肾肝功能及合并用药。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 有效半衰期范围

doseUseReferences.indication: 住院急性内科患者静脉血栓预防
doseUseReferences.population: 成人，无严重肾损害或合用 P-gp 抑制剂
doseUseReferences.amountText: 首剂 160 mg，随后每日 80 mg
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 随餐口服，疗程 35–42 天

en.summary: The cited information is the 2020 US betrixaban capsule label.

indications: Venous-thromboembolism prophylaxis in eligible acutely ill hospitalized adults with restricted mobility.
contraindications: Active pathological bleeding or serious hypersensitivity.
majorWarnings: Serious bleeding and spinal or epidural hematoma around neuraxial procedures can occur.
majorInteractions: P-gp inhibitors increase exposure and require label dose reduction. Other antithrombotics add bleeding.
monitoring: Monitor bleeding, renal and hepatic function and concurrent medicines.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Effective half-life range

doseUseReferences.indication: Venous-thromboembolism prophylaxis in acutely ill hospitalized patients
doseUseReferences.population: Adults without severe renal impairment or concomitant P-gp inhibitors
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally with food for 35–42 days

sourceRefs.title: Italian Official Gazette · Luvion authorization amendment

zh-CN.summary: 所引意大利口服片含坎利酮。该产品的注射制剂含坎利酸钾，剂量不可直接等同。

indications: 原发性醛固酮增多症、继发性醛固酮增多相关水肿及特定难治性高血压。
contraindications: 严重高钾或低钠、无尿、急性肾衰竭、严重慢性肾功能不全或过敏。
majorWarnings: 可发生高钾、低钠、氮质血症及代谢性酸中毒。
majorInteractions: ACE 抑制剂及其他增加血钾的药物可增加高钾风险。
monitoring: 定期检查血钾、血钠及肾功能。

sourceRefs.title: Italian Official Gazette · Luvion authorization amendment

doseUseReferences.amountText: 多数情况每日 50–200 mg 坎利酮
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 一次或分次口服，依病情调整

en.summary: The cited Italian oral tablets contain canrenone. The product’s injectable formulation contains potassium canrenoate and doses are not directly equivalent.

indications: Primary hyperaldosteronism, edema with secondary hyperaldosteronism and selected refractory hypertension.
contraindications: Severe hyperkalemia or hyponatremia, anuria, acute renal failure, severe chronic renal impairment or hypersensitivity.
majorWarnings: Hyperkalemia, hyponatremia, azotemia and metabolic acidosis can occur.
majorInteractions: ACE inhibitors and other potassium-raising drugs increase hyperkalemia risk.
monitoring: Check potassium, sodium and renal function regularly.

sourceRefs.title: Italian Official Gazette · Luvion authorization amendment

doseUseReferences.amountText: 50–200 mg canrenone per day in most cases
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally once daily or in divided doses, adjusted to condition

zh-CN.summary: 所引胶囊含磷酸丙吡胺。

indications: 仅用于医生判断危及生命、如持续性室速等已记录室性心律失常，并须权衡促心律失常风险。
contraindications: 心源性休克、无起搏器的二或三度房室阻滞、先天性 QT 延长或相关过敏。
majorWarnings: 可发生 QT 延长、严重心律失常、低血糖及抗胆碱反应。
majorInteractions: 其他延长 QT 或抑制传导药物可叠加效应。
monitoring: 开始及调整时监测心电图、电解质和血糖，按肾功能调整维持量。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 健康成人范围，均值约 6.7 小时

doseUseReferences.indication: 危及生命的室性心律失常
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每 6 小时口服；负荷及调整依标签和心脏监测执行

en.summary: The cited capsules contain disopyramide phosphate.

indications: Only for documented life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias such as sustained ventricular tachycardia, weighing proarrhythmic risk.
contraindications: Cardiogenic shock, second- or third-degree AV block without a pacemaker, congenital QT prolongation or hypersensitivity.
majorWarnings: QT prolongation, serious arrhythmias, hypoglycemia and anticholinergic effects can occur.
majorInteractions: Other QT-prolonging or conduction-suppressing drugs can add effects.
monitoring: Monitor ECG, electrolytes and glucose at initiation and adjustment, reducing maintenance dosing in renal impairment.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Healthy-adult range, mean about 6.7 hours

doseUseReferences.amountText: Usual maintenance dose 100–150 mg per dose
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally every six hours, with loading and adjustment guided by label and cardiac monitoring

zh-CN.summary: 所引胶囊为多非利特口服制剂。

indications: 将房颤或心房扑动转复为窦性心律后的窦律维持。
contraindications: 先天性或获得性长 QT，基线 QTc 超过阈值，或相关过敏。
majorWarnings: 可导致 QT 延长和尖端扭转型室速，首剂通常需住院监测。
majorInteractions: 禁忌合用某些延长 QT 或影响排泄的药物，需要逐项核对。
monitoring: 按肌酐清除率选量，治疗前及首剂后监测心电图，随访肾功能和电解质。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 终末消除约值

doseUseReferences.indication: 房颤或心房扑动转复后的窦律维持
doseUseReferences.population: 肌酐清除率超过 60 mL/min 的成人
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每 12 小时口服，按 QTc 和肾功能调整

en.summary: The cited capsules are oral dofetilide.

indications: Maintenance of sinus rhythm after conversion of atrial fibrillation or atrial flutter.
contraindications: Congenital or acquired long QT, baseline QTc above the specified threshold or hypersensitivity.
majorWarnings: Can cause QT prolongation and torsades, generally requiring inpatient monitoring for initiation.
majorInteractions: Certain QT-prolonging or elimination-altering drugs are contraindicated and require individual review.
monitoring: Select dose by creatinine clearance, monitor ECG before and after the initial dose, and follow renal function and electrolytes.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Approximate terminal elimination

doseUseReferences.indication: Sinus-rhythm maintenance after atrial fibrillation or flutter conversion
doseUseReferences.population: Adults with creatinine clearance over 60 mL/min
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally every 12 hours, adjusted for QTc and renal function

zh-CN.summary: 此处资料对应盐酸地尔硫䓬缓释胶囊，即释片及其他制剂另查。

drugClass: 非二氢吡啶类钙通道阻滞剂
indications: 高血压及标签所列心绞痛用途。
contraindications: 无起搏器的病态窦房结或高级房室阻滞、特定低血压或急性心梗伴肺淤血等情况。
majorWarnings: 可发生心动过缓、传导阻滞、低血压和心衰恶化。
majorInteractions: β 阻滞剂和其他影响心脏传导的药物可叠加效应。
monitoring: 随访血压、心率和传导症状，按肝肾功能核对剂量。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 普通药代研究中血浆消除范围

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日一次口服，按标签调整

en.summary: These details concern extended-release diltiazem capsules. Immediate-release and other formulations have separate labeling.

indications: Hypertension and labeled angina indications.
contraindications: Sick sinus syndrome or high-grade AV block without a pacemaker, specified hypotension or acute MI with pulmonary congestion, and other label restrictions.
majorWarnings: Bradycardia, conduction block, hypotension and worsening heart failure may occur.
majorInteractions: Beta-blockers and other drugs affecting cardiac conduction add effects.
monitoring: Follow blood pressure, pulse and conduction symptoms, checking dose against hepatic and renal function.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Plasma elimination range in conventional pharmacokinetic studies

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally once daily, titrated per label

zh-CN.summary: 此处剂量资料对应地高辛口服片。

indications: 心衰及标签所列房颤心室率控制。
contraindications: 心室颤动或对地高辛过敏。
majorWarnings: 治疗窗窄，低钾、低镁、肾功能下降或药物相互作用可诱发毒性。
majorInteractions: 胺碘酮、维拉帕米及部分抗生素可升高地高辛暴露。
monitoring: 按年龄、体重、肾功能和合用药选量，监测血药浓度及电解质。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 正常肾功能成人约 1.5–2 天

doseUseReferences.amountText: 维持量常用每日 125 微克
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日一次口服，负荷与调整需按标签及监测结果

en.summary: The dosing here applies to digoxin oral tablets.

indications: Heart failure and labeled ventricular-rate control in atrial fibrillation.
contraindications: Ventricular fibrillation or hypersensitivity to digoxin.
majorWarnings: The therapeutic window is narrow. Hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, renal impairment or interactions can cause toxicity.
majorInteractions: Amiodarone, verapamil and certain antibiotics can increase digoxin exposure.
monitoring: Select dose according to age, weight, renal function and interacting drugs, and monitor levels and electrolytes.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: About 1.5–2 days in adults with normal renal function

doseUseReferences.amountText: Common maintenance dose 125 micrograms per day
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally once daily, with loading and adjustment guided by label and monitoring

zh-CN.summary: 所引片剂含马来酸依那普利。

drugClass: 血管紧张素转换酶抑制剂
indications: 高血压、心衰及标签所列无症状左室功能障碍。
contraindications: ACE 抑制剂相关或遗传性血管性水肿、糖尿病患者合用阿利吉仑及规定沙库巴曲缬沙坦换药间隔。
majorWarnings: 妊娠可造成胎儿损害，也可发生血管性水肿、肾损伤、高钾和低血压。
majorInteractions: 其他肾素–血管紧张素系统抑制剂、NSAID 和补钾药增加相关风险。
monitoring: 随访血压、血钾和肾功能，核对妊娠及面唇肿胀。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 活性依那普利拉重复给药后的累积有效半衰期

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日一次口服

en.summary: The cited tablets contain enalapril maleate.

indications: Hypertension, heart failure and labeled asymptomatic left ventricular dysfunction.
contraindications: ACE-inhibitor-related or hereditary angioedema, aliskiren coadministration in diabetes and specified sacubitril/valsartan washouts.
majorWarnings: Can cause fetal harm during pregnancy, angioedema, renal injury, hyperkalemia and hypotension.
majorInteractions: Other renin–angiotensin inhibitors, NSAIDs and potassium supplements add related risks.
monitoring: Follow blood pressure, potassium and renal function, checking pregnancy and facial or lip swelling.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Effective accumulation half-life of active enalaprilat after repeated dosing

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally once daily

zh-CN.summary: 所引制剂为达格列净口服片。

indications: 用于标签所列心衰、慢性肾病、2 型糖尿病及心血管风险降低。
contraindications: 既往对达格列净或辅料严重过敏。
majorWarnings: 可发生容量不足、酮症酸中毒、生殖道真菌感染和血糖下降。
majorInteractions: 利尿剂或其他降糖药可增加相关风险。
monitoring: 开始前评估容量、肾功能及酮症风险，随访血压和血糖。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 单次口服后的平均血浆终末半衰期

doseUseReferences.indication: 射血分数降低或保留型心衰
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日一次口服

en.summary: The cited product is oral dapagliflozin tablets.

indications: Labeled heart failure, chronic kidney disease, type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular-risk reduction.
contraindications: Prior serious hypersensitivity to dapagliflozin or ingredients.
majorWarnings: Volume depletion, ketoacidosis, genital mycotic infection and hypoglycemia can occur.
majorInteractions: Diuretics or other glucose-lowering drugs can add related risks.
monitoring: Assess volume status, renal function and ketosis risk before treatment, and follow blood pressure and glucose.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Mean terminal plasma half-life after one oral dose

doseUseReferences.indication: Heart failure with reduced or preserved ejection fraction
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally once daily

zh-CN.summary: 所引制剂为恩格列净口服片。

indications: 心衰、2 型糖尿病及标签所列心血管风险降低。
contraindications: 对恩格列净或辅料过敏，或正在透析。
majorWarnings: 可发生容量不足、酮症酸中毒和生殖道感染。
majorInteractions: 利尿剂和胰岛素等降糖药可增加对应风险。
monitoring: 开始前评估肾功能及容量，随访血糖、血压和酮症风险。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 终末消除估计值

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日早晨口服

en.summary: The cited product is oral empagliflozin tablets.

indications: Heart failure, type 2 diabetes and labeled cardiovascular-risk reduction.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to empagliflozin or ingredients, or dialysis.
majorWarnings: Volume depletion, ketoacidosis and genital infection can occur.
majorInteractions: Diuretics and glucose-lowering drugs such as insulin can add related risks.
monitoring: Assess renal function and volume status before treatment, and follow glucose, blood pressure and ketosis risk.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Estimated terminal elimination

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally each morning

zh-CN.summary: 所引制剂为屈昔多巴口服胶囊。

indications: 原发性自主神经衰竭导致的有症状神经源性直立性低血压。
contraindications: 对屈昔多巴或辅料过敏。
majorWarnings: 仰卧位高血压是主要风险，也可能出现头痛、恶心和头晕。
majorInteractions: 影响血压的药物及拟交感药可增加血压风险。
monitoring: 监测坐位及仰卧血压，最后一日剂量距睡前至少 3 小时。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 人体平均消除约值

doseUseReferences.indication: 神经源性直立性低血压
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日三次口服

en.summary: The cited product is oral droxidopa capsules.

indications: Symptomatic neurogenic orthostatic hypotension caused by primary autonomic failure.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to droxidopa or ingredients.
majorWarnings: Supine hypertension is a major risk. Headache, nausea and dizziness can occur.
majorInteractions: Blood-pressure-affecting and sympathomimetic drugs can increase pressure risk.
monitoring: Monitor seated and supine blood pressure, with the last dose at least three hours before bedtime.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Approximate human mean elimination

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally three times daily

zh-CN.summary: 所引制剂为达比加群酯口服胶囊。

indications: 降低非瓣膜性房颤卒中风险，并用于标签所列静脉血栓治疗或预防。
contraindications: 活动性病理性出血、严重过敏或机械心脏瓣膜。
majorWarnings: 可发生严重出血，肾功能下降会延长暴露。
majorInteractions: P-gp 抑制剂、抗凝药、抗血小板药及 NSAID 可增加暴露或出血。
monitoring: 按肾功能和年龄核对剂量，随访出血、肾功能及合并用药。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 健康受试者范围

doseUseReferences.indication: 非瓣膜性房颤卒中预防
doseUseReferences.population: 肾功能正常且无相互作用的成人
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日两次口服，整粒吞服

en.summary: The cited product is oral dabigatran etexilate capsules.

indications: Reduces stroke risk in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation and treats or prevents labeled venous thromboembolism.
contraindications: Active pathological bleeding, serious hypersensitivity or mechanical heart valves.
majorWarnings: Serious bleeding can occur, and renal impairment prolongs exposure.
majorInteractions: P-gp inhibitors, anticoagulants, antiplatelets and NSAIDs can increase exposure or bleeding.
monitoring: Check dose against renal function and age, following bleeding, renal function and interactions.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: Healthy-subject range

doseUseReferences.indication: Stroke prevention in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation
doseUseReferences.population: Adults with normal renal function and no interacting drugs
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Orally twice daily, swallowed whole

zh-CN.summary: 所引制剂为依诺肝素钠注射液。

indications: 静脉血栓预防与治疗，以及标签所列急性冠脉综合征用途。
contraindications: 活动性大出血、肝素诱导血小板减少病史或相关过敏等。
majorWarnings: 可发生严重出血、血细胞减少和脊髓或硬膜外血肿。
majorInteractions: 其他抗栓药增加出血。
monitoring: 按适应证及肾功能选量，监测出血、血小板和必要的抗 Xa 活性。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 抗 Xa 活性基础消除半衰期约 4.5 小时，预防剂量约 7 小时

doseUseReferences.indication: 腹部手术静脉血栓预防
doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 皮下注射，通常术前 2 小时开始

en.summary: The cited product is enoxaparin sodium injection.

indications: Venous-thromboembolism prevention and treatment, plus labeled acute coronary syndrome uses.
contraindications: Active major bleeding, prior heparin-induced thrombocytopenia or related hypersensitivity, among other restrictions.
majorWarnings: Serious bleeding, cytopenias and spinal or epidural hematoma can occur.
majorInteractions: Other antithrombotic drugs add bleeding risk.
monitoring: Select dose by indication and renal function, monitoring bleeding, platelets and anti-Xa activity when indicated.

notes: Pharmacokinetics from the cited label.

eliminationHalfLife.basis: About 4.5 h for anti-Xa basal clearance, about 7 h at prevention doses

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: Subcutaneously, usually beginning two hours before surgery

zh-CN.summary: 所引制剂为盐酸决奈达隆口服片，强度按决奈达隆计。

indications: 在窦性心律的阵发性或持续性房颤患者中降低住院风险。
contraindications: 永久性房颤、近期失代偿或症状性心衰、特定心动过缓、QT 延长、严重肝病或相关过敏等。
majorWarnings: 可发生严重肝损伤、心衰恶化、心动过缓、QT 延长和肺毒性。
majorInteractions: 强 CYP3A4 抑制剂可升高暴露，部分 CYP 底物和其他 QT 延长药需核对。
monitoring: 开始前及心衰恶化时评估肝功能，随访心电图、心衰症状和肺症状。

notes: 所引说明书的药代资料。

eliminationHalfLife.basis: 终末消除约一天，活性代谢物存在更久

doseUseReferences.scheduleText: 每日两次随餐口服

en.summary: The cited tablets contain dronedarone hydrochloride, with strength expressed as dronedarone.

indications: Reduces hospitalization risk in patients with paroxysmal or persistent atrial fibrillation in sinus rhythm.
contraindications: Permanent AF, recent decompensated or symptomatic heart failure, specified bradycardia, QT prolongation, severe liver disease or hypersensitivity.
majorWarnings: Serious liver injury, worsening heart failure, bradycardia, QT prolongation and pulmonary toxicity can occur.
