zh-CN.summary: 适应症和用途 房颤/扑动的转换 对于有症状的房颤/扑动患者，如果通过降低心室反应率的措施无法充分控制其症状，硫酸奎尼丁可作为恢复正常窦性心律的一种方法。如果使用硫酸奎尼丁不能在合理的时间内恢复窦性心律（参见剂量和给药方法），则应停用硫酸奎尼丁。

indications: 适应症和用途 房颤/扑动的转换 对于有症状的房颤/扑动患者，如果通过降低心室反应率的措施无法充分控制其症状，硫酸奎尼丁可作为恢复正常窦性心律的一种方法。如果使用硫酸奎尼丁不能在合理的时间内恢复窦性心律（参见剂量和给药方法），则应停用硫酸奎尼丁。
contraindications: 禁忌症 已知对奎尼丁过敏或在先前使用奎尼丁或奎宁治疗期间出现血小板减少性紫癜的患者禁用奎尼丁。在没有功能正常的人工起搏器的情况下，奎尼丁也禁忌用于任何心律依赖于交界或心室起搏器的患者，包括完全性房室传导阻滞的患者。
majorWarnings: 警告 死亡率 在许多针对非危及生命的心律失常的抗心律失常治疗试验中，积极的抗心律失常治疗导致死亡率增加。结构性心脏病患者接受积极治疗的风险可能最大。对于奎尼丁用于预防或推迟心房扑动/颤动复发的情况，最佳可用数据来自上述临床药理学/临床效果荟萃分析。在所分析的试验中研究的患者中，与使用奎尼丁相关的死亡率是与使用安慰剂相关的死亡率的三倍多。
majorInteractions: 药物相互作用改变奎尼丁的药代动力学碱化尿液的药物（碳酸酐酶抑制剂、碳酸氢钠、噻嗪类利尿剂）会减少奎尼丁的肾脏消除。通过尚不清楚的药代动力学机制，同时服用胺碘酮或西咪替丁会增加奎尼丁的水平。

en.summary: INDICATIONS AND USAGE Conversion of Atrial Fibrillation/Flutter In patients with symptomatic atrial fibrillation/flutter whose symptoms are not adequately controlled by measures that reduce the rate of ventricular response, quinidine sulfate is indicated as a means of restoring normal sinus rhythm. If this use of quinidine sulfate does not restore sinus rhythm within a reasonable time (see DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION ), then quinidine sulfate should be discontinued.

indications: INDICATIONS AND USAGE Conversion of Atrial Fibrillation/Flutter In patients with symptomatic atrial fibrillation/flutter whose symptoms are not adequately controlled by measures that reduce the rate of ventricular response, quinidine sulfate is indicated as a means of restoring normal sinus rhythm. If this use of quinidine sulfate does not restore sinus rhythm within a reasonable time (see DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION ), then quinidine sulfate should be discontinued.
contraindications: CONTRAINDICATIONS Quinidine is contraindicated in patients who are known to be allergic to it, or who have developed thrombocytopenic purpura during prior therapy with quinidine or quinine. In the absence of a functioning artificial pacemaker, quinidine is also contraindicated in any patient whose cardiac rhythm is dependent upon a junctional or idioventricular pacemaker, including patients in complete atrioventricular block.
majorWarnings: WARNINGS Mortality In many trials of antiarrhythmic therapy for non-life-threatening arrhythmias, active antiarrhythmic therapy has resulted in increased mortality; the risk of active therapy is probably greatest in patients with structural heart disease. In the case of quinidine used to prevent or defer recurrence of atrial flutter/fibrillation, the best available data come from a metaanalysis CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY/Clinical Effects above. In the patients studied in the trials there analyzed, the mortality associated with the use of quinidine was more than three times as great as the mortality associated with the use of placebo.
majorInteractions: Drug Interactions Altered Pharmacokinetics of Quinidine Drugs that alkalinize the urine ( carbonic-anhydrase inhibitors, sodium bicarbonate, thiazide diuretics ) reduce renal elimination of quinidine. By pharmacokinetic mechanisms that are not well understood, quinidine levels are increased by coadministration of amiodarone or cimetidine .

drugClass: 血管紧张素转换酶抑制剂
indications: 雷米普利胶囊是一种血管紧张素转换酶 (ACE) 抑制剂，用于治疗高血压、降低血压。降低血压可以降低致命和非致命心血管事件的风险，主要是中风和心肌梗塞。
contraindications: 雷米普利胶囊禁用于对该产品或任何其他 ACE 抑制剂过敏的患者（例如，在使用任何其他 ACE 抑制剂治疗期间出现血管性水肿的患者）。雷米普利胶囊禁忌与脑啡肽酶抑制剂（例如沙库巴曲）合用。
majorWarnings: 胎儿毒性 当检测到怀孕时，尽快停用雷米普利。直接作用于肾素-血管紧张素系统的药物可能会导致发育中的胎儿受伤和死亡。警告：胎儿毒性 当检测到怀孕时，请尽快停用雷米普利。
majorInteractions: 利尿剂：过度低血压的可能性。锂：谨慎使用。

indications: Adempas 是一种可溶性鸟苷酸环化酶 (sGC) 刺激剂，适用于治疗患有以下疾病的成人： • 手术治疗或无法手术的 CTEPH 后持续/复发性慢性血栓栓塞性肺动脉高压 (CTEPH)（WHO 第 4 组），以提高运动能力和 WHO 功能等级。 • 肺动脉高压(PAH)（WHO 第1 组），以提高运动能力、改善WHO 功能分级并延缓临床恶化。

en.summary: Adempas is a soluble guanylate cyclase (sGC) stimulator indicated for the treatment of adults with: • Persistent/recurrent Chronic Thromboembolic Pulmonary Hypertension (CTEPH) (WHO Group 4) after surgical treatment or inoperable CTEPH to improve exercise capacity and WHO functional class. • Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension (PAH) (WHO Group 1) to improve exercise capacity, improve WHO functional class and to delay clinical worsening.

indications: Adempas is a soluble guanylate cyclase (sGC) stimulator indicated for the treatment of adults with: • Persistent/recurrent Chronic Thromboembolic Pulmonary Hypertension (CTEPH) (WHO Group 4) after surgical treatment or inoperable CTEPH to improve exercise capacity and WHO functional class. • Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension (PAH) (WHO Group 1) to improve exercise capacity, improve WHO functional class and to delay clinical worsening.
contraindications: • Pregnancy • Use with nitrates or nitric oxide donors in any form • Use with PDE inhibitors • Patients with concomitant use of other soluble guanylate cyclase (sGC) stimulators. • Pulmonary hypertension associated with idiopathic interstitial pneumonias (PH-IIP) 4.1 Pregnancy Use of Adempas is contraindicated in patients who are pregnant .
majorWarnings: EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY Adempas is contraindicated for use during pregnancy because it may cause fetal harm based on animal data . Exclude pregnancy prior to the start of treatment with Adempas. Advise use of effective contraception prior to initiation of treatment, during treatment, and for one month after treatment with Adempas .
majorInteractions: • Strong CYP and P-gp/BCRP inhibitors: For patients receiving strong CYP and P-gp/BCRP inhibitors, consider a starting dose of 0.5 mg three times a day. Monitor for hypotension.

zh-CN.summary: 瑞舒伐他汀片适用于： • 对于未确诊冠心病且因年龄、高敏 C 反应蛋白 (hsCRP) ≥2 mg/L 和至少一种其他 CV 危险因素而面临 CV 疾病风险增加的成人，降低主要不良心血管 (CV) 事件（CV 死亡、非致命性心肌梗死、非致命性卒中或动脉血运重建手术）的风险。 • 作为饮食的辅助手段： o 降低原发性高脂血症成人的低密度脂蛋白胆固醇(LDL-C)。

indications: 瑞舒伐他汀片适用于： • 对于未确诊冠心病且因年龄、高敏 C 反应蛋白 (hsCRP) ≥2 mg/L 和至少一种其他 CV 危险因素而面临 CV 疾病风险增加的成人，降低主要不良心血管 (CV) 事件（CV 死亡、非致命性心肌梗死、非致命性卒中或动脉血运重建手术）的风险。 • 作为饮食的辅助手段： o 降低原发性高脂血症成人的低密度脂蛋白胆固醇(LDL-C)。
contraindications: 瑞舒伐他汀在下列情况下禁用： • 急性肝功能衰竭或失代偿性肝硬化。 • 对瑞舒伐他汀或瑞舒伐他汀中的任何赋形剂过敏。
majorWarnings: • 肌病和横纹肌溶解症：危险因素包括年龄65 岁或以上、不受控制的甲状腺功能减退症、肾功能损害、与某些其他药物同时使用以及较高的瑞舒伐他汀剂量。亚洲患者患肌病的风险可能更高。如果出现 CK 水平显着升高或诊断或怀疑肌病，则停用瑞舒伐他汀。
majorInteractions: 有关瑞舒伐他汀与其他会增加肌病和横纹肌溶解症风险的药物同时使用的详细信息，请参阅完整的处方信息。 ( ) 铝镁复合抗酸剂：在抗酸剂前至少 2 小时给予瑞舒伐他汀。

en.summary: Rosuvastatin tablets are indicated: • To reduce the risk of major adverse cardiovascular (CV) events (CV death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, nonfatal stroke, or an arterial revascularization procedure) in adults without established coronary heart disease who are at increased risk of CV disease based on age, high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hsCRP) ≥2 mg/L, and at least one additional CV risk factor. • As an adjunct to diet to: o Reduce low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) in adults with primary hyperlipidemia.

indications: Rosuvastatin tablets are indicated: • To reduce the risk of major adverse cardiovascular (CV) events (CV death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, nonfatal stroke, or an arterial revascularization procedure) in adults without established coronary heart disease who are at increased risk of CV disease based on age, high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hsCRP) ≥2 mg/L, and at least one additional CV risk factor. • As an adjunct to diet to: o Reduce low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) in adults with primary hyperlipidemia.
contraindications: Rosuvastatin is contraindicated in the following conditions: • Acute liver failure or decompensated cirrhosis . • Hypersensitivity to rosuvastatin or any excipients in rosuvastatin.
majorWarnings: • Myopathy and Rhabdomyolysis: Risk factors include age 65 years or greater, uncontrolled hypothyroidism, renal impairment, concomitant use with certain other drugs, and higher rosuvastatin dosage. Asian patients may be at higher risk for myopathy. Discontinue rosuvastatin if markedly elevated CK levels occur or myopathy is diagnosed or suspected.
majorInteractions: See full prescribing information for details regarding concomitant use of rosuvastatin with other drugs that increase the risk of myopathy and rhabdomyolysis. ( ) Aluminum and Magnesium Hydroxide Combination Antacids: Administer rosuvastatin at least 2 hours before the antacid.

indications: 是一种前列环素受体激动剂，适用于治疗肺动脉高压（PAH，WHO I 组）：在成人中可延缓疾病进展并降低因 PAH 住院的风险。 2 岁及以上儿童患者。

majorInteractions: 中度 CYP2C8 抑制剂（例如氯吡格雷、地拉罗司和特立氟胺）会增加 UPTRAVI 活性代谢物的暴露。将 UPTRAVI 的剂量减少至每天一次。

contraindications: • 使用一氧化氮供体（例如任何形式的有机硝酸盐或有机亚硝酸盐）的患者服用西地那非片。西地那非片剂可增强硝酸盐的降血压作用 • 已知对西地那非或片剂任何成分过敏 • 服用鸟苷酸环化酶 (GC) 刺激剂，如利奥西呱 4.1 硝酸盐 与已知的一氧化氮/cGMP 途径效应一致，西地那非片剂可增强硝酸盐的降血压作用，以及对正在使用西地那非的患者进行给药因此，禁止定期和/或间歇地使用任何形式的一氧化氮供体，例如有机硝酸盐或有机亚硝酸盐。
majorWarnings: • 如果由于心血管状况而不宜进行性活动，患者不应使用西地那非片。 • 如果勃起持续> 4 小时，患者应寻求紧急治疗。对于有阴茎异常勃起倾向的患者，谨慎使用西地那非片 • 如果一只或双眼突然失明，患者应停止使用西地那非片并就医，这可能是非动脉炎性前部缺血性视神经病变 (NAION) 的征兆。对于有 NAION 病史的患者，应谨慎使用西地那非片，且仅当预期益处大于风险时才使用。

indications: Simvastatin tablets USP are indicated: • To reduce the risk of total mortality by reducing risk of coronary heart disease death, non-fatal myocardial infarction and stroke, and the need for coronary and non-coronary revascularization procedures in adults with established coronary heart disease, cerebrovascular disease, peripheral vascular disease, and/or diabetes, who are at high risk of coronary heart disease events. • As an adjunct to diet to reduce low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C): o In adults with primary hyperlipidemia.
contraindications: Simvastatin is contraindicated in the following conditions: • Concomitant use of strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (select azole anti-fungals, macrolide antibiotics, anti-viral medications, and nefazodone) . • Concomitant use of cyclosporine, danazol or gemfibrozil .
majorWarnings: • Myopathy and Rhabdomyolysis: Risk factors include age 65 years or greater, uncontrolled hypothyroidism, renal impairment, concomitant use with certain other drugs, and higher simvastatin dosage. Chinese patients may be at higher risk for myopathy. Discontinue simvastatin if markedly elevated CK levels occur or myopathy is diagnosed or suspected.
majorInteractions: • See full prescribing information for details regarding concomitant use of simvastatin with other drugs or grapefruit juice that increase the risk of myopathy and rhabdomyolysis. • Coumarin Anticoagulants: Obtain INR before simvastatin initiation and monitor INR during simvastatin dosage initiation or adjustment.

en.summary: Sotalol hydrochloride/Sotalol hydrochloride AF tablets are an antiarrhythmic indicated for: the treatment of life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias the maintenance of normal sinus rhythm in patients with atrial fibrillation or flutter (AFIB/AFL) Limitations of Use Sotalol hydrochloride has not been shown to enhance survival in patients with life threatening ventricular arrhythmias Avoid use in patients with minimally symptomatic or easily reversible AFIB/AFL 1.1 Life-Threatening Ventricular Arrhythmias Sotalol hydrochloride/Sotalol hydrochloride AF tablets are indicated for the treatment of documented, life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias, such as sustained ventricular tachycardia (VT). Limitation of Use: Sotalol hydrochloride/Sotalol hydrochloride AF has not been shown to enhance survival in patients with life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias.

indications: Sotalol hydrochloride/Sotalol hydrochloride AF tablets are an antiarrhythmic indicated for: the treatment of life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias the maintenance of normal sinus rhythm in patients with atrial fibrillation or flutter (AFIB/AFL) Limitations of Use Sotalol hydrochloride has not been shown to enhance survival in patients with life threatening ventricular arrhythmias Avoid use in patients with minimally symptomatic or easily reversible AFIB/AFL 1.1 Life-Threatening Ventricular Arrhythmias Sotalol hydrochloride/Sotalol hydrochloride AF tablets are indicated for the treatment of documented, life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias, such as sustained ventricular tachycardia (VT). Limitation of Use: Sotalol hydrochloride/Sotalol hydrochloride AF has not been shown to enhance survival in patients with life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias.
contraindications: Sotalol hydrochloride/Sotalol hydrochloride (AF) tablets are contraindicated in patients with: Sinus bradycardia, sick sinus syndrome, second and third degree AV block, unless a functioning pacemaker is present Congenital or acquired long QT syndromes Cardiogenic shock or decompensated heart failure Serum potassium <4 mEq/L Bronchial asthma or related bronchospastic conditions Hypersensitivity to sotalol For the treatment of AFIB/AFL, sotalol hydrochloride/sotalol hydrochloride AF tablets are also contraindicated in patients with: Baseline QT interval >450 msec For the treatment of AFIB/AFL or ventricular arrythmias Sinus bradycardia, 2 nd or 3 rd degree AV block, sick sinus syndrome Congenital or acquired long QT syndrome Serum potassium <4 mEq/L Cardiogenic shock, decompensated heart
majorWarnings: LIFE-THREATENING PROARRHYTHMIA To minimize the risk of drug-induced arrhythmia, initiate or reinitiate oral sotalol in a facility that can provide cardiac resuscitation and continuous electrocardiographic monitoring. Sotalol can cause life-threatening ventricular tachycardia associated with QT interval prolongation. If the QT interval prolongs to 500 msec or greater, reduce the dose, lengthen the dosing interval, or discontinue the drug.
majorInteractions: Class I or III Antiarrhythmics or other drugs that prolong the QT interval: Avoid concomitant use Digoxin, calcium channel blocker: increased risk of bradycardia, hypotension, heart failure Dosage of insulin or antidiabetic drugs may need adjustment Aluminum- or magnesium-based antacids reduce sotalol exposure 7.1 Antiarrhythmics and Other QT Prolonging Drugs Discontinue Class I or Class III antiarrhythmic agents for at least three half-lives prior to dosing with sotalol. Class Ia antiarrhythmic drugs, such as disopyramide, quinidine, and procainamide, and other Class III drugs (for example, amiodarone) are not recommended as concomitant therapy with sotalol hydrochloride/sotalol hydrochloride AF, because of their potential to prolong refractoriness .

en.summary: Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) indicated for: Treatment of hypertension, to lower blood pressure. Lowering blood pressure reduces the risk of fatal and nonfatal cardiovascular events, primarily strokes and myocardial infarctions.

majorWarnings: FETAL TOXICITY When pregnancy is detected, discontinue telmisartan tablets as soon as possible . Drugs that act directly on the renin-angiotensin system can cause injury and death to the developing fetus . majorInteractions: 药物相互作用 在对照试验中，特拉唑嗪已被添加到利尿剂和几种 β-肾上腺素能阻滞剂中。没有观察到意外的相互作用。特拉唑嗪还被用于接受多种联合治疗的患者。虽然这些不是正式的相互作用研究，但没有观察到相互作用。

en.summary: INDICATIONS AND USAGE Terazosin capsules are indicated for the treatment of symptomatic benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH). There is a rapid response, with approximately 70% of patients experiencing an increase in urinary flow and improvement in symptoms of BPH when treated with terazosin.

indications: INDICATIONS AND USAGE Terazosin capsules are indicated for the treatment of symptomatic benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH). There is a rapid response, with approximately 70% of patients experiencing an increase in urinary flow and improvement in symptoms of BPH when treated with terazosin.
contraindications: CONTRAINDICATIONS Terazosin capsules are contraindicated in patients known to be hypersensitive to terazosin hydrochloride.
majorWarnings: WARNINGS Syncope and "First-dose" Effect Terazosin capsules, like other alpha-adrenergic blocking agents, can cause marked lowering of blood pressure, especially postural hypotension, and syncope in association with the first dose or first few days of therapy. A similar effect can be anticipated if therapy is interrupted for several days and then restarted. Syncope has also been reported with other alpha-adrenergic blocking agents in association with rapid dosage increases or the introduction of another antihypertensive drug.
majorInteractions: Drug Interactions In controlled trials, terazosin has been added to diuretics, and several beta-adrenergic blockers; no unexpected interactions were observed. Terazosin has also been used in patients on a variety of concomitant therapies; while these were not formal interaction studies, no interactions were observed.

zh-CN.summary: 噻氯匹定是抗血小板药，用于特定患者复发卒中的二级预防；存在严重血液系统风险，需要规律血细胞监测。

indications: 用于降低有完整血栓栓塞性卒中、轻微卒中、可逆性缺血性神经功能缺损（RIND）或短暂性脑缺血发作（TIA，包括短暂性单眼盲）病史患者复发卒中的风险；应保留给对阿司匹林不耐受或过敏、阿司匹林治疗失败且不适合其他抗血小板治疗的患者。
contraindications: 对药物或辅料过敏；血液系统疾病（如中性粒细胞减少和/或血小板减少）；止血障碍；活动性出血（如消化性溃疡出血或颅内出血）；严重肝功能损害。
majorWarnings: 可导致危及生命的血栓性血小板减少性紫癜（TTP）、中性粒细胞减少/粒细胞缺乏和再生障碍性贫血；治疗前及治疗前3个月每周监测全血细胞计数（含分类）和血小板计数，出现TTP或中性粒细胞减少征象应立即停药。
majorInteractions: 与阿司匹林、NSAIDs 合用增加出血风险；噻氯匹定经肝代谢，合用其他经肝代谢药物时可能需要调整剂量；与抗凝药和其他抗血小板药合用需谨慎。
monitoring: 基线及治疗前3个月每周监测全血细胞计数（含分类）和血小板计数；监测出血、TTP/中性粒细胞减少征象及肝功能。

notes: 产品专论报告血浆峰值浓度约在给药后 2 小时出现，终末消除半衰期为 4-5 天。
抗血小板作用不可逆；停药后多数患者出血时间和血小板功能约在 1 周内恢复。
未绘制时间轴：抗血小板作用需按重复给药和停药后的恢复过程解释。

en.summary: Ticlopidine is an antiplatelet medicine used to reduce recurrent stroke risk in selected patients; it carries serious hematologic risks and requires regular blood monitoring.

indications: Reduction of the risk of recurrent stroke in patients who have had a complete thromboembolic stroke, minor stroke, reversible ischemic neurological deficit (RIND), or transient ischemic attack (TIA) including transient monocular blindness; reserve for patients intolerant or allergic to acetylsalicylic acid, who failed acetylsalicylic acid, and who are not suitable for other antiplatelet therapy.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to the drug or excipients; hematopoietic disorders such as neutropenia or thrombocytopenia; hemostatic disorder; active bleeding such as bleeding peptic ulcer or intracranial bleeding; severe liver dysfunction.
majorWarnings: Can cause life-threatening thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura (TTP), neutropenia/agranulocytosis and aplastic anemia. Monitor a white blood cell count with differential and platelet count at baseline and weekly through the first three months; stop immediately for evidence of TTP or neutropenia.
majorInteractions: Acetylsalicylic acid and NSAIDs increase bleeding risk; because ticlopidine is hepatically metabolized, doses of ticlopidine or other hepatically metabolized drugs may require adjustment; review anticoagulants and other antiplatelets.
monitoring: Baseline and weekly complete blood count with differential and platelet count through the first three months; monitor bleeding, TTP or neutropenia and liver function.

notes: The product monograph reports peak plasma concentrations at about 2 hours and a terminal elimination half-life of 4-5 days.
The antiplatelet effect is irreversible; bleeding time and platelet function return to normal within about one week after stopping in most patients.
No timeline is drawn: the antiplatelet effect must be interpreted with repeated dosing and post-discontinuation recovery.

contraindications: CONTRAINDICATIONS Timolol maleate is contraindicated in patients with bronchial asthma or with a history of bronchial asthma, or severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (see WARNINGS); sinus bradycardia; second- and third-degree atrioventricular block; overt cardiac failure (see WARNINGS); cardiogenic shock; hypersensitivity to this product.

Both digitalis and timolol maleate slow AV conduction.

majorInteractions: 避免同时使用： 强 CYP 3A 诱导剂 V 2 -受体激动剂 7.1 CYP 3A 抑制剂和诱导剂 CYP 3A 抑制剂 托伐普坦与 200 mg 酮康唑共同给药后，托伐普坦的 AUC 为 5.4 倍，C max 为 3.5 倍。较大剂量的强 CYP 3A 抑制剂预计会导致托伐普坦暴露量的较大增加。

en.summary: Torsemide is a loop diuretic indicated for: the treatment of edema associated with heart failure, renal disease or hepatic disease. the treatment of hypertension, to lower blood pressure.

indications: Torsemide is a loop diuretic indicated for: the treatment of edema associated with heart failure, renal disease or hepatic disease. the treatment of hypertension, to lower blood pressure.
contraindications: Torsemide is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to torsemide or to povidone. Torsemide is contraindicated in patients who are anuric.
majorWarnings: Hypotension and worsening renal function: monitor volume status and renal function periodically Electrolyte and metabolic abnormalities: monitor serum electrolytes and blood glucose periodically. Ototoxicity 5.1 Hypotension and Worsening Renal Function Excessive diuresis may cause potentially symptomatic dehydration, blood volume reduction and hypotension and worsening renal function, including acute renal failure particularly in salt-depleted patients or those taking renin-angiotensin aldosterone inhibitors. Worsening of renal function can also occur with concomitant use of nephrotoxic drugs (e.g., aminoglycosides, cisplatin, and NSAIDs).
majorInteractions: Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs): Reduced diuretic, natriuretic, and antihypertensive effects; risk of renal impairment. CYP2C9: Concomitant use with CYP2C9 inhibitors can decrease torsemide clearance.

indications: 适应症和用途 高血压 群多普利片适用于治疗高血压。它可以单独使用或与其他抗高血压药物（例如氢氯噻嗪）联合使用。
contraindications: 禁忌症 群多普利片禁用于对本品过敏的患者、遗传性/特发性血管性水肿患者以及有与既往接受 ACE 抑制剂治疗相关的血管性水肿病史的患者。糖尿病患者不要同时服用阿利吉仑和群多普利片（参见注意事项，药物相互作用）。
majorWarnings: 胎儿毒性 当检测到怀孕时，应尽快停用群多普利片。直接作用于肾素-血管紧张素系统的药物可能会导致发育中的胎儿受伤和死亡（参见警告：胎儿毒性）。
majorInteractions: 药物相互作用 群多普利不影响口服地高辛（0.25 mg）的血浆浓度（给药前和给药后 2 小时）。群多普利和西咪替丁联合给药导致群多普利的 C max 增加约 44%，但群多普利拉的药代动力学或 ACE 抑制没有差异。

indications: INDICATIONS AND USAGE Hypertension Trandolapril tablets are indicated for the treatment of hypertension. It may be used alone or in combination with other antihypertensive medication such as hydrochlorothiazide.
contraindications: CONTRAINDICATIONS Trandolapril tablets are contraindicated in patients who are hypersensitive to this product, in patients with hereditary/idiopathic angioedema and in patients with a history of angioedema related to previous treatment with an ACE inhibitor. Do not co-administer aliskiren with trandolapril tablets in patients with diabetes (see PRECAUTIONS , Drug Interactions).
majorWarnings: FETAL TOXICITY When pregnancy is detected, discontinue trandolapril tablets as soon as possible. Drugs that act directly on the renin-angiotensin system can cause injury and death to the developing fetus (See WARNINGS : Fetal Toxicity ) .
majorInteractions: Drug Interactions Trandolapril did not affect the plasma concentration (pre-dose and 2 hours post-dose) of oral digoxin (0.25 mg). Coadministration of trandolapril and cimetidine led to an increase of about 44% in C max for trandolapril, but no difference in the pharmacokinetics of trandolaprilat or in ACE inhibition.

zh-CN.summary: 适应症和用途 Dyrenium（氨苯蝶啶）适用于治疗与充血性心力衰竭、肝硬化和肾病综合征相关的水肿；类固醇引起的水肿、特发性水肿和继发性醛固酮增多症引起的水肿。 Dyrenium 可单独使用或与其他利尿剂一起使用，因为其具有额外的利尿作用或保钾潜力。

indications: 适应症和用途 Dyrenium（氨苯蝶啶）适用于治疗与充血性心力衰竭、肝硬化和肾病综合征相关的水肿；类固醇引起的水肿、特发性水肿和继发性醛固酮增多症引起的水肿。 Dyrenium 可单独使用或与其他利尿剂一起使用，因为其具有额外的利尿作用或保钾潜力。
contraindications: 禁忌症 无尿。严重或进行性肾脏疾病或功能障碍，肾病可能除外。
majorWarnings: 警告 所有保钾药物（包括 Dyrenium）都可能出现血清钾水平异常升高（大于或等于 5.5 mEq/L）。高钾血症更容易发生在肾功能不全和糖尿病患者（即使没有肾功能不全的证据）以及老年人或重症患者中。由于未纠正的高钾血症可能致命，因此必须经常监测血清钾水平，特别是对于接受 Dyrenium 的患者，当剂量改变或患有任何可能影响肾功能的疾病时。
majorInteractions: 药物相互作用 当锂和利尿剂同时使用时应谨慎，因为利尿剂引起的钠丢失可能会降低锂的肾清除率并增加血清锂水平，从而存在锂中毒的风险。接受此类联合治疗的患者应密切监测血清锂水平，并在必要时调整锂剂量。

en.summary: INDICATIONS AND USAGE Dyrenium (triamterene) is indicated in the treatment of edema associated with congestive heart failure, cirrhosis of the liver and the nephrotic syndrome; steroid-induced edema, idiopathic edema and edema due to secondary hyperaldosteronism. Dyrenium may be used alone or with other diuretics, either for its added diuretic effect or its potassium-sparing potential.

indications: INDICATIONS AND USAGE Dyrenium (triamterene) is indicated in the treatment of edema associated with congestive heart failure, cirrhosis of the liver and the nephrotic syndrome; steroid-induced edema, idiopathic edema and edema due to secondary hyperaldosteronism. Dyrenium may be used alone or with other diuretics, either for its added diuretic effect or its potassium-sparing potential.
contraindications: CONTRAINDICATIONS Anuria. Severe or progressive kidney disease or dysfunction, with the possible exception of nephrosis.
majorWarnings: Warnings Abnormal elevation of serum potassium levels (greater than or equal to 5.5 mEq/liter) can occur with all potassium-sparing agents, including Dyrenium. Hyperkalemia is more likely to occur in patients with renal impairment and diabetes (even without evidence of renal impairment), and in the elderly or severely ill. Since uncorrected hyperkalemia may be fatal, serum potassium levels must be monitored at frequent intervals especially in patients receiving Dyrenium, when dosages are changed or with any illness that may influence renal function.
majorInteractions: Drug Interactions Caution should be used when lithium and diuretics are used concomitantly because diuretic-induced sodium loss may reduce the renal clearance of lithium and increase serum lithium levels with risk of lithium toxicity. Patients receiving such combined therapy should have serum lithium levels monitored closely and the lithium dosage adjusted if necessary.

indications: Valsartan tablets are an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) indicated for: Treatment of hypertension , to lower blood pressure. Lowering blood pressure reduces the risk of fatal and nonfatal cardiovascular events, primarily strokes and myocardial infarctions.
contraindications: Do not use in patients with known hypersensitivity to any component. Do not co-administer aliskiren with valsartan tablets in patients with diabetes .
majorWarnings: FETAL TOXICITY When pregnancy is detected, discontinue valsartan tablets as soon as possible. Drugs that act directly on the renin-angiotensin system can cause injury and death to the developing fetus. WARNING: FETAL TOXICITY When pregnancy is detected, discontinue valsartan tablets as soon as possible.
majorInteractions: Potassium-sparing diuretics, potassium supplements or salt substitutes may lead to increases in serum potassium, and in heart failure patients, increases in serum creatinine. NSAID use may lead to increased risk of renal impairment and loss of antihypertensive effect.

drugClass: 非二氢吡啶类钙通道阻滞剂
indications: 适应症和用途 盐酸维拉帕米缓释片用于治疗高血压，以降低血压。降低血压可以降低致命和非致命心血管事件的风险，主要是中风和心肌梗塞。
contraindications: 禁忌症 盐酸维拉帕米缓释片禁忌用于： 1. 严重左心室功能不全（参见“警告”） 2. 低血压（收缩压低于 90 mm Hg）或心源性休克 3. 病态窦房结综合征（具有功能性人工心室起搏器的患者除外） 4. 二度或三度房室传导阻滞（具有功能性人工心室起搏器的患者除外） 5. 患有心房扑动或心房颤动并有辅助旁路的患者（例如，Wolff-Parkinson-White 综合征、Lown-Ganong-Levine 综合征）（参见“警告”） 6. 已知对盐酸维拉帕米过敏的患者
majorWarnings: 警告心力衰竭：维拉帕米具有负性肌力作用，在大多数患者中，这种作用可以通过其后负荷减少（降低全身血管阻力）特性来补偿，而不会损害心室功能。根据 4,954 名患者的临床经验，87 名患者 (1.8%) 出现充血性心力衰竭或肺水肿。对于患有严重左心室功能障碍（例如，射血分数低于 30%）或中度至重度心力衰竭症状的患者，以及患有任何程度的心室功能障碍的患者，如果正在接受 β-肾上腺素能阻滞剂治疗，应避免使用维拉帕米（参见注意事项、药物相互作用）。
majorInteractions: 药物相互作用 细胞色素诱导剂/抑制剂：体外代谢研究表明维拉帕米通过细胞色素 P450 CYP3A4、CYP1A2、CYP2C8、CYP2C9 和 CYP2C18 代谢。据报道，CYP3A4 抑制剂（例如红霉素、利托那韦）与 CYP3A4 抑制剂（例如红霉素、利托那韦）存在临床上显着的相互作用，导致维拉帕米血浆水平升高，而 CYP3A4 诱导剂（例如利福平）则导致维拉帕米血浆水平降低。

en.summary: INDICATIONS AND USAGE Verapamil hydrochloride extended-release tablets is indicated for the treatment of hypertension, to lower blood pressure. Lowering blood pressure reduces the risk of fatal and nonfatal cardiovascular events, primarily strokes and myocardial infarctions.

drugClass: 非二氢吡啶类钙通道阻滞剂
indications: INDICATIONS AND USAGE Verapamil hydrochloride extended-release tablets is indicated for the treatment of hypertension, to lower blood pressure. Lowering blood pressure reduces the risk of fatal and nonfatal cardiovascular events, primarily strokes and myocardial infarctions.
contraindications: CONTRAINDICATIONS Verapamil HCl extended-release tablets are contraindicated in: 1.Severe left ventricular dysfunction (see WARNINGS ) 2.Hypotension (systolic pressure less than 90 mm Hg) or cardiogenic shock 3.Sick sinus syndrome (except in patients with a functioning artificial ventricular pacemaker) 4.Second- or third-degree AV block (except in patients with a functioning artificial ventricular pacemaker) 5.Patients with atrial flutter or atrial fibrillation and an accessory bypass tract (eg, Wolff-Parkinson-White, Lown-Ganong-Levine syndromes) (see WARNINGS ) 6.Patients with known hypersensitivity to verapamil hydrochloride
majorWarnings: WARNINGS Heart failure: Verapamil has a negative inotropic effect, which in most patients is compensated by its afterload reduction (decreased systemic vascular resistance) properties without a net impairment of ventricular performance. In clinical experience with 4,954 patients, 87 (1.8%) developed congestive heart failure or pulmonary edema. Verapamil should be avoided in patients with severe left ventricular dysfunction (eg, ejection fraction less than 30%) or moderate to severe symptoms of cardiac failure and in patients with any degree of ventricular dysfunction if they are receiving a beta-adrenergic blocker (see PRECAUTIONS , Drug interactions ).
majorInteractions: Drug interactions Cytochrome inducers/inhibitors: In vitro metabolic studies indicate that verapamil is metabolized by cytochrome P450 CYP3A4, CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, and CYP2C18. Clinically significant interactions have been reported with inhibitors of CYP3A4 (e.g., erythromycin, ritonavir) causing elevation of plasma levels of verapamil while inducers of CYP3A4 (e.g., rifampin) have caused a lowering of plasma levels of verapamil.

contraindications: No contraindication verified against a regulatory label. Cardiovascular, psychiatric, hepatic, renal, pregnancy and medication factors require professional review.
majorWarnings: Stimulants can increase heart rate, blood pressure and body temperature and may cause anxiety, insomnia, chest pain, seizures or psychotic symptoms. Tolerance and dependence can develop with repeated use.
Community-reported toxicity: toxic dose is unknown.
Dependence and abuse potential: not habit-forming.
Tolerance: full tolerance after ingestion over the couse of multiple days; half tolerance recovery about 3-5 days; full recovery about 7-10 days.
This is community documentation, not a product label or clinical warning. Avoid mixing and using alone; seek emergency care for severe symptoms.
majorInteractions: Community-listed interaction risks — dangerous: Lithium; unsafe: Tramadol; uncertain: Cannabis, Stimulants.
monitoring: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, temperature and hydration; avoid alcohol, other stimulants and MAOIs.
Seek urgent care for chest pain, hyperthermia, altered consciousness, seizures or persistent insomnia.

zh-CN.summary: 2-Fl-2'-Oxo-PCM（也称为 2-氟氯胺酮、2-FDCK，不准确地称为 2-氟氯胺酮、氟氯胺酮和 2-FK，CAS 号：111982-50-4）是芳基环己胺类的一种鲜为人知的新型解离物质。它的化学性质与氯胺酮和去氯氯胺酮 (DCK) 相似。它被认为是一种 NMDA 受体拮抗剂，尽管目前的研究有限。 2F-DCK 的起源没有详细记录。它似乎于 2017 年首次在在线新型精神活性物质市场上销售，作为氯胺酮的合法替代品进行销售。它是在成功推出类似的氯胺酮类似物去氯氯胺酮后发布的。主观效应包括镇静、运动控制丧失、疼痛缓解、内部幻觉、概念性思维、欣快感和解离。解离是一种复杂的心理状态，其特征是知觉扭曲以及与环境和自我的脱离感。据报道，2F-DCK 的作用与氯胺酮相似。与氯胺酮一样，2F-DCK 的作用具有高度剂量依赖性，较低剂量会产生酒精样中毒，较高剂量会产生致幻的体外状态（也称为“k 孔”）。关于 2-FDCK 的药理学、代谢或毒性的数据有限。它的人类使用历史极其短暂。如果使用这种物质，强烈建议采取减少危害的做法。

zh-CN.summary: Alpha-GPC（L-α-甘油磷酸胆碱，甘磷酸胆碱）是一种水溶性营养素，是大脑内胆碱和甘油磷酸盐的前体。对于人类来说，胆碱被认为是一种必需营养素，因为它在降低神经管缺陷、脂肪肝疾病和其他疾病风险方面的作用已得到充分证明。值得注意的是，α-GPC 是可口服补充的三种含胆碱磷脂之一（另外两种是胞二磷胆碱和磷脂酰胆碱），其受欢迎可能是因为它是最有效的胆碱前药（能够影响胆碱的全身和大脑浓度）。由于提供了 α-GPC 分子的另一半（甘油磷酸盐），它似乎也支持细胞膜的结构和维护，与胞磷胆碱类似。众所周知，运动员会使用 α-GPC，因为它据称能够增强生长激素的产生并增强功率输出（这是基于一项支持受试者在运动前摄入 600 毫克 α-GPC 的单独试点研究）。当作为补充剂服用时，这种化合物具有促智作用，可能具有治疗阿尔茨海默病和其他相关疾病的潜力。它很容易获得，并且通常通过在线补充剂和促智药供应商出售。

zh-CN.summary: 大麻二酚（也称为 CBD 和 Epidiolex®）是大麻植物中天然存在的大麻素。它是大麻植物中约 113 种已鉴定的大麻素之一，占植物提取物的 40%。它不具有与四氢大麻酚 (THC) 相同的精神活性，而四氢大麻酚是大麻的欣快感和致幻作用的原因，并且通常被描述为非中毒性的。大麻二酚可以通过多种途径给药，包括吸入大麻烟雾或蒸气、以气雾剂形式喷入脸颊以及口服。它可以以仅含有 CBD 作为活性成分（即不添加 THC 或萜烯）的 CBD 油、以 CBD 为主的全植物大麻提取物油、胶囊、干大麻或作为处方液体溶液提供。在美国，大麻二酚药物 Epidiolex 已获得美国食品和药物管理局批准用于治疗癫痫病。美国缉毒局已将 Epidiolex 列入附表 V 分类，而非 Epidiolex CBD 仍属于附表 I 禁止任何使用的药物。任何联合国药物管制条约均未将大麻二酚列入清单。主观效果包括抑制焦虑、放松肌肉和缓解疼痛。大麻二酚通常具有良好的耐受性和良好的安全性。然而，它可能有可能导致不良的药物相互作用。因此，如果使用这种物质，建议采取减少危害的做法。

zh-CN.summary: 胞二磷胆碱（CDP-胆碱、胞苷 5'-二磷酸胆碱）是一种水溶性营养素，是大脑内胆碱和胞苷的前体（随后转化为尿苷）。对于人类来说，胆碱是一种必需营养素，因为它在降低神经管缺陷、脂肪肝疾病和其他疾病风险方面的作用已被记录。 CDP-胆碱是三种可以口服补充的含胆碱磷脂之一（另外两种是α-GPC和磷脂酰胆碱）。这种补充剂旨在预防或治疗与衰老相关的记忆障碍，因为它所赋予的两种分子都具有神经保护作用，并有可能增强学习能力。这种效应也可能使年轻人受益。在这一作用中，它似乎比磷脂酰胆碱 (PC) 本身更有效，部分原因是还增加了大脑中 PC 的合成。胞磷胆碱还用于治疗由中风、血管性痴呆、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病等引起的认知障碍。该化合物的效力在某种程度上可与 α-GPC 相媲美。一项研究指出，低剂量的 CDP-胆碱（需要重复）引起了人们的关注，并且 CDP-胆碱可能具有作为可卡因和（初步证据表明）食物的抗成瘾化合物的作用。当作为补充剂服用时，这种化合物具有促智作用。它很容易获得，并且通常通过在线补充剂供应商为此目的进行销售。

A sedative and hypnotic it is of intermediate to long half life with similar effects to diazepam, though 10x more potent.

en.summary: An antihistamine which, when taken in smaller doses relieves allergies and insomnia. In larger doses works as a deliriant and can actually keep the user awake. Generally the 'high' of this drug is reported as dysphoric, potentially causing hallucinations indistinguishable from reality.

Seek urgent care for hyperthermia, seizures, severe agitation or altered consciousness.

zh-CN.summary: 乙基卡西酮（也称为 Ethylpropion、Ethcathinone，通常称为 ETH-CAT）是卡西酮化学类别的兴奋剂，服用后会产生刺激和增强注意力的效果。它在结构上与卡西酮和甲卡西酮 (MCAT) 相关，后者与安非他明或哌甲酯具有大致相同的作用特征。据报道，在替代卡西酮中，ETH-CAT 产生的刺激最温和且持久，其微妙的效果在最初的刺激后仍然持续很长时间。它被描述为具有比娱乐性更多的功能，因为它对兴奋剂产生的欣快感有限，尽管它的活性持续时间短可能会促进强迫性重服。关于 ETH-CAT 的药理特性、代谢和毒性的数据非常少，人类使用它的历史也很少。它主要作为新型精神活性物质在在线灰色市场上分销。 2008年，它被确定为两种准合法“派对药丸”的成分。据报道，它还与另一种卡西酮替代品甲氧麻黄酮一起作为“摇头丸”出售。如果使用这种物质，强烈建议采取减少危害的做法。

zh-CN.summary: 依法韦仑（Efavirenz，商品名为 Sustiva）是一种用于治疗和预防艾滋病毒/艾滋病的抗逆转录病毒药物。 It is notable for being able to produce psychedelic and hallucinogenic effects despite possessing an extremely novel pharmacological profile and chemical structure not shared with any other psychedelic substance. Efavirenz was approved for medical use in the United States in 1998. It is on the World Health Organization's List of Essential Medicines, the most effective and safe medicines needed in a health system.南非已有报告称依非韦伦因其致幻和解离作用而被用于娱乐用途。据报道，这些药片被压碎并在称为“whoonga”、“nyaope”和“wonga”的混合物中熏制。 A form of black tar heroin.尽管目前对 whoonga 样品的分析尚未证实混合物中存在依非韦伦。

zh-CN.summary: N-Ethylpentylone（也称为 bk-EBDP、βk-EBDP 和 ephylone）是卡西酮类的一种新型兴奋剂-诱生物质。 Ephylone 在化学上与戊酮相关，属于一组称为取代卡西酮的化合物。尽管它可能通过增加大脑中血清素、多巴胺和去甲肾上腺素的水平来产生作用，但对其药理学知之甚少。 Ephylone 是勃林格殷格翰 (Boehringer Ingelheim) 于 20 世纪 60 年代开发的一种中枢神经系统兴奋剂，但从未上市。娱乐用途的报告首次出现于 2015 年底。此后，其流行率稳步上升，特别是在舞蹈音乐节上，它被视为 MDMA 的掺假或假冒品。 Ephylone 与许多住院治疗和服药过量死亡有关。用户报告表明，ephylone 产生类似于 MDMA、methylone 和可卡因的经典兴奋剂和致触性作用的混合物。典型的作用包括刺激、去抑制、性欲增加、强迫性重服和欣快感。然而，与类似物质不同的是，据报道，当服用较大剂量时，ephylone 的效果非常持久。其意义尚不清楚，尽管它可能表明它与其他兴奋剂相比具有不同的毒性特征。 Ephylone 作为新型精神活性物质与乙酮和二丁酮等其他合成卡西酮一起在网上出售。由于缺乏研究，强烈建议在使用这种物质时采取减少危害的做法。

en.summary: MDPV is a potent, and extremely compulsive synthetic euphoric stimulant, which shares some empathogenic effects with MDMA. Has a reputation for causing psychosis. MDPV has been found in products sold as "bath salts", "plant food/fertilizer", and in some "ecstasy."

zh-CN.summary: N-甲基-N-丙基色胺（缩写​​为 MPT；也称为甲基丙基色胺）是色胺类的合成迷幻药，据报道显示出强大的致幻作用，有时甚至具有致诱作用。它在结构上类似于N,N-二甲基色胺（DMT）和各种基础迷幻色胺，可以给人一种“突破”的体验，如MET、EPT和DPT。虽然人们对这种物质的药理学知之甚少，但早期报告表明，汽化或游离碱化这些化合物与 DMT 经验的大部分核心成分相同，只是有其自身的药效学和动力学变化。 MPT 极其罕见，人类使用的历史也很少。它从未被记录为在街头出售，而是主要通过新型精神活性物质供应商和专门销售奇异精神活性化学品的机构获得。

en.summary: N-Methyl-N-propyltryptamine (abbreviated MPT; also known as Methylpropyltryptamine) is a synthetic psychedelic of the tryptamine class that has reported to display powerful hallucinogenic and sometimes entactogenic effects.

zh-CN.summary: 3-MeO-2′-Oxo-PCiPr（也称为 MXiPr）是芳基环己胺类的新型解离物质。它是 MXE 的结构类似物。作用机制尚不清楚，但它可能是一种 NMDA 受体拮抗剂，产生解离和欣快作用。 MXiPr 起源的情况尚不清楚。它于 2020 年底首次出现在在线新型精神活性物质市场，并专门作为 MXE 或氯胺酮的合法替代品进行销售。据报道，第一批产品闻起来有塑料味，并怀疑含有杂质。第二批含有明显不同的“神奇宝贝卡片”气味。其主观效果与氯胺酮和 MXE 相当，包括镇静、运动控制丧失、疼痛缓解、内部幻觉、概念性思维、欣快感和解离。其主观效果被描述为与 O-PCE 或 MXE 基本相似，但更难以预测和令人愉悦，这使得它在效果方面与氯胺酮效果相去甚远。据推测，它是一种强效血清素再摄取抑制剂，如 MXE。关于 MXiPr 的药理特性、代谢和毒性的数据很少，而且人类使用它的历史也很短暂。鉴于不纯批次的报告，建议纯化该物质（请参阅本节，并在使用前将其送至化学测试服务机构。强烈建议在使用该物质时采取减少危害的做法。

en.summary: A psychedelic of the phenethylamine family. Found in psychedelic cacti that have long been used by peoples native to the Southwestern US and Mexico, including Peyote and San Pedro cacti, among others. Can be found as cactus pulp, as an extract from cacti, or as a synthetic substance created in a lab.

indications: Community-documented substance; no approved clinical indication was verified. No indication or prescribing advice is provided.
contraindications: No contraindication verified against a regulatory label. Cardiovascular, psychiatric, hepatic, renal, pregnancy and medication factors require professional review.
majorWarnings: Psychedelics can cause perceptual distortion, anxiety, panic, paranoia and psychotic symptoms. Individual reactions vary, and a single use may trigger latent mental illness.
Community-reported toxicity: toxic dose is unknown.
Dependence and abuse potential: not habit-forming.
Tolerance: full tolerance almost immediately after ingestion; half tolerance recovery about 3 days; full recovery about 7 days.
Community sources specifically flag: liver injury.
This is community documentation, not a product label or clinical warning. Avoid mixing and using alone; seek emergency care for severe symptoms.
majorInteractions: Community-listed interaction risks — dangerous: ΑMT; unsafe: Tramadol; uncertain: 5-MeO-xxT, Cannabis, Substituted amphetamines, Cocaine, MAOI.
monitoring: Monitor mental state, temperature and hydration; use in a safe, familiar setting with a trusted person present.
Seek help for persistent panic, paranoia, psychotic symptoms or self-harm risk.

zh-CN.summary: 一种相当常见且非常强的中枢神经系统兴奋剂。有时以脱氧剂的形式用于治疗多动症和严重肥胖症。低剂量的甲基苯丙胺可以提升情绪、提高警觉性、注意力、精力并降低食欲。如果剂量较高，它会引发躁狂、精神病和肌肉退化等问题。耐受的用户可能报告的剂量比新用户高得多。

社区资料特别提示：精神病性症状、偏执、心脏风险、卒中、依赖。
以上为社区资料整理，不等同于药品说明书或临床警告；避免混合使用和独自使用，出现严重症状立即就医。

出现胸痛、高热、意识改变、癫痫或持续失眠时立即就医。

en.summary: A fairly common and very strong CNS stimulant. It is sometimes prescribed in the form of desoxyn for ADHD and severe obesity. In low doses, methamphetamine can elevate mood, increase alertness, concentration, energy and reduces appetite. At higher doses, it can induce mania, psychosis and muscle degeneration among other issues. Tolerant users may report much higher doses than new users.

indications: Community-documented substance; no approved clinical indication was verified. No indication or prescribing advice is provided.
contraindications: No contraindication verified against a regulatory label. Cardiovascular, psychiatric, hepatic, renal, pregnancy and medication factors require professional review.
majorWarnings: Stimulants can increase heart rate, blood pressure and body temperature and may cause anxiety, insomnia, chest pain, seizures or psychotic symptoms. Tolerance and dependence can develop with repeated use.
Dependence and abuse potential: extremely addictive with a high potential for abuse.
Tolerance: full tolerance rapidly develops with prolonged and repeated use; half tolerance recovery about 3 - 7 days; full recovery about 1 - 2 weeks.
Community sources specifically flag: psychotic symptoms, paranoia, cardiac risk, stroke, dependence.
This is community documentation, not a product label or clinical warning. Avoid mixing and using alone; seek emergency care for severe symptoms.
majorInteractions: Community-listed interaction risks — dangerous: Tramadol, ΑMT, MAOI; unsafe: Dextromethorphan, PCP, 25x-NBOMe, 2C-T-x, 5-MeO-xxT, DOx; uncertain: Alcohol, GHB, GBL, Opioids, Cocaine, Cannabis, Caffeine, Ketamine, Methoxetamine, Psychedelics.
monitoring: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, temperature and hydration; avoid alcohol, other stimulants and MAOIs.
Seek urgent care for chest pain, hyperthermia, altered consciousness, seizures or persistent insomnia.

zh-CN.summary: βk-MDMA 是一种卡西酮兴奋剂和共情剂，其结构与 MDMA 相似，但相比之下更具刺激性且不太具有共情性。在 2013 年被禁止之前，它经常被误认为是 MDMA 在街上出售。Marquis 试剂可以区分 βk-MDMA 和 MDMA。其效力低于 MDMA，且持续时间稍短。

耐受性：长期反复使用后出现；半耐受恢复约 1–3 周；完全恢复约 3–6 周。
社区资料特别提示：心脏风险。
以上为社区资料整理，不等同于药品说明书或临床警告；避免混合使用和独自使用，出现严重症状立即就医。

monitoring: 监测心率、血压、体温和水分摄入；避免与酒精、其他兴奋剂或 MAOI 合用。
出现胸痛、高热、意识改变、癫痫或持续失眠时立即就医。

en.summary: Also known as desmethyletizolam, a thienodiazepine similar in effects and structure to etizolam, but around half as potent and with around a 60% longer half-life. A sedative, and hypnotic, it may cause amnesia and lowered inhibitions in excess.

en.summary: The prototypical opioid drug, a powerful analgesic with euphoric qualities, found in the seeds and wax of the plant papaver somniferum (opium poppy).  First isolated by Friedrich Sertürner in 1805, named for its sleep-inducing qualities. Do not combine with other depressants, may cause dangerous respiratory depression in overdose.

zh-CN.summary: 6-Propynyl-6-nor-Lysergicaciddiethamide（也称为 N-PropynylnorlysergicacidN,N-diethamide、N-PropynylnorLSD 或简称 PARGY-LAD）是一种新型合成迷幻物质，属于麦角酰胺化学类别，在给药时会产生类似 LSD 的迷幻效果，但明显不太明显。它是 LSD 的结构密切同系物，主要因其默默无闻和缺乏显着特征而闻名。亚历山大·舒尔金 (Alexander Shulgin) 在其著作《TiHKAL》（《我所了解并喜爱的色胺》）中首次将 PARGY-LAD 作为 LSD 的类似物进行了简短提及。据报道，它的效力明显低于 LSD 本身，“在 160 微克的剂量下报告有一些活性”，而“在 500 微克的剂量下则具有全部活性”。关于 PARGY-LAD 的药理特性、代谢和毒性的数据很少，而且人类使用的历史也很少。它最近与研究化学迷幻麦角酰胺（如 AL-LAD、ETH-LAD 和 PRO-LAD）一起出现在市场上，作为 LSD 的合法灰色市场替代品，并通过在线新型精神活性物质供应商进行商业分销，并被认为是该系列中最不受欢迎和最不可用的药物之一。如果选择使用这种未经研究的致幻物质，强烈建议采取适当的预防措施和减少危害的做法。

en.summary: A strong dissociative drug.  PCP works primarily as an NMDA receptor antagonist. Also referred to as "wet" or "angel dust". Best known for stories of the strange and sometimes violent behaviour of those under its influence, though it is likely these are only in overdose cases.

indications: Community-documented substance; no approved clinical indication was verified. No indication or prescribing advice is provided.
contraindications: No contraindication verified against a regulatory label. Cardiovascular, psychiatric, hepatic, renal, pregnancy and medication factors require professional review.
majorWarnings: Dissociatives can cause altered consciousness, dissociation, raised blood pressure, injury risk and bladder/urinary symptoms. Repeated use carries additional risk.
Dependence and abuse potential: highly addictive with a high potential for adverse side effects such as psychosis.
Tolerance: full tolerance with prolonged and repeated use; half tolerance recovery about 3 - 7 days; full recovery about 1 - 2 weeks.
This is community documentation, not a product label or clinical warning. Avoid mixing and using alone; seek emergency care for severe symptoms.
majorInteractions: Community-listed interaction risks — dangerous: 2C-T-x, ΑMT, 5-MeO-xxT, Dextromethorphan, GHB, GBL, Tramadol, MAOI; unsafe: DOx, Substituted amphetamines, MDMA, Cocaine, Alcohol, Benzodiazepines, SSRIs; uncertain: Methoxetamine, Caffeine, Opioids.
monitoring: Monitor consciousness, blood pressure, temperature and injury risk; avoid using alone or with alcohol/sedatives.
Watch for bladder and urinary symptoms and stop repeated use if they occur.

zh-CN.summary: 一种起效缓慢、血清素释放非常强的共情剂。再加上缺乏多巴胺释放，通常会导致使用者为了获得从未出现的愉悦效果而服用更多剂量，从而导致住院和死亡。有时被误认为是 MDMA。

社区资料记录的毒性：摄入 PMA 与严重心动过速、癫痫发作、高热和死亡相关。

en.summary: An empathogen with a slow onset and very strong serotonin release. This, combined with its lack of dopamine release, often leads users to dose more for the pleasurable effects which never come, leading to hospitalisations and deaths. Sometimes mis-sold as MDMA.

indications: Community-documented substance; no approved clinical indication was verified. No indication or prescribing advice is provided.
contraindications: No contraindication verified against a regulatory label. Cardiovascular, psychiatric, hepatic, renal, pregnancy and medication factors require professional review.
majorWarnings: Entactogens can raise heart rate, blood pressure and temperature and may cause hyponatremia, anxiety and serotonin syndrome. Serotonergic drug combinations carry high risk.
Community-reported toxicity: can be considered extremely toxic when compared to other substances such as Methamphetamine or MDMA.
Community-reported toxicity: Ingestion of PMA has been associated with severe tachycardia (abnormally high heart rate), seizures, hyperthermia, and death.
Community sources specifically flag: death risk.
This is community documentation, not a product label or clinical warning. Avoid mixing and using alone; seek emergency care for severe symptoms.
majorInteractions: Community-listed interaction risks — dangerous: Tramadol, ΑMT, MAOI; unsafe: Dextromethorphan, PCP, 25x-NBOMe, 2C-T-x, 5-MeO-xxT, DOx; uncertain: Alcohol, GHB, GBL, Opioids, Cocaine, Cannabis, Caffeine, Ketamine, Methoxetamine, Psychedelics.
monitoring: Monitor temperature, hydration and electrolytes, heart rate and blood pressure; avoid overheating, excessive or inadequate fluid intake, serotonergic medicines and MAOIs.
Seek urgent care for hyperthermia, altered consciousness, muscle rigidity, seizures or severe headache.

zh-CN.summary: 对甲氧基甲基苯丙胺（也称为 4-甲氧基甲基苯丙胺、4-MeOMA，不准确地称为“4-MMA”（应保留为 4-MMA (4-MeMA)），更常见的是 PMMA）是一种高度危险和有毒的苯丙胺类合成物质，与 PMA 密切相关。与 PMA 一样，它也会产生极其危险、危及生命的副作用。在较低剂量下，其作用与 PMA 有所不同，导致严重高热的可能性降低，同时产生更多可能被误认为是 MDMA 的致内效应（尽管在较高剂量下，它确实具有与 PMA 相同的风险）。它的使用历史不详，但在 2000 年代和 2010 年代出现得更频繁。它通常不如 PMA 有效。 PMMA 以及 PMA 和 PMEA 等其他药物几乎没有娱乐价值，被认为是已知最危险和有毒的物质之一。强烈建议完全避免这两种物质。

出现高热、意识改变、肌肉僵硬、抽搐或严重头痛时立即就医。

出现胸痛、高热、意识改变、癫痫或持续失眠时立即就医。

en.summary: A relatively common CNS stimulant sold over the counter in benzedrex inhalers.

indications: Community-documented substance; no approved clinical indication was verified. No indication or prescribing advice is provided.
contraindications: No contraindication verified against a regulatory label. Cardiovascular, psychiatric, hepatic, renal, pregnancy and medication factors require professional review.
majorWarnings: Stimulants can increase heart rate, blood pressure and body temperature and may cause anxiety, insomnia, chest pain, seizures or psychotic symptoms. Tolerance and dependence can develop with repeated use.
Tolerance: full tolerance rapidly develops with prolonged and repeated use; half tolerance recovery about 3 - 7 days; full recovery about 1 - 2 weeks.
This is community documentation, not a product label or clinical warning. Avoid mixing and using alone; seek emergency care for severe symptoms.
majorInteractions: Community-listed interaction risks — dangerous: 25x-NBOMe, 25x-NBOH, Tramadol, MAOI; unsafe: Dextromethorphan, MDMA, Stimulants; uncertain: Alcohol, Methoxetamine, Dissociatives.
monitoring: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, temperature and hydration; avoid alcohol, other stimulants and MAOIs.
Seek urgent care for chest pain, hyperthermia, altered consciousness, seizures or persistent insomnia.

monitoring: Monitor mental state, temperature and hydration; use in a safe, familiar setting with a trusted person present.
Seek help for persistent panic, paranoia, psychotic symptoms or self-harm risk.

en.summary: Fungi containing psilocybin, a prototypical psychedelic with similar effects to LSD, but with a shorter duration; also considered as being more confusing, introspective and entheogenic. Usually refers to psilocybe mushrooms rather than Amanitas, which have different effects. Are considered physically safe if properly identified, which should always be done by an expert.

zh-CN.summary: RC 苯二氮卓类药物由 Hoffman-LaRoche 在 20 世纪 70 年代发现。 2010 年代初进入 RC 市场。在较低剂量时，它主要是一种抗焦虑化合物，但在较高剂量时，它可能具有相当的镇静、催眠、遗忘作用，并可能导致抑制作用丧失。结构与阿普唑仑、溴西泮和三唑仑相似。效力是地西泮的 12 倍。

en.summary: RC benzodiazepine discovered by Hoffman-LaRoche in the 1970s. Came to the RC market in the early 2010s. At lower doses it is mainly an anxiolytic compound, yet at higher doses can be quite sedating, hypnotic, amnesic, and can cause loss of inhibitions. Structurally similar to Alprazolam, Bromazepam, and Triazolam. Is 12x as potent as Diazepam.

indications: Community-documented substance; no approved clinical indication was verified. No indication or prescribing advice is provided.
contraindications: No contraindication verified against a regulatory label. Cardiovascular, psychiatric, hepatic, renal, pregnancy and medication factors require professional review.
majorWarnings: Benzodiazepines can cause sedation, amnesia, respiratory depression and dependence. Mixing with alcohol or opioids can be fatal, and abrupt withdrawal can cause seizures.
Community-reported toxicity: low toxicity.
Community-reported toxicity: potentially lethal when mixed with depressants like alcohol or opioids.
Dependence and abuse potential: extremely physically and psychologically addictive.
Tolerance: full tolerance within a couple of days of continuous use; full recovery about 7 - 14 days.
This is community documentation, not a product label or clinical warning. Avoid mixing and using alone; seek emergency care for severe symptoms.
majorInteractions: Community sources do not provide a structured interaction list; unknown interactions cannot be excluded. Avoid alcohol, sedatives, stimulants and other psychoactive substances.
monitoring: Monitor consciousness, breathing, heart rate, blood pressure and temperature; avoid mixing substances.
Seek urgent care for severe or persistent symptoms.

en.summary: Rolicyclidine, also known as PCPy, is a dissociative with effects similar to PCP. While this dissociative anesthetic has hallucinogenic and sedative effects, it is said to be much less stimulating than PCP. In this sense it is more similar to opioids, or other central nervous system depressants.

Watch for bladder and urinary symptoms and stop repeated use if they occur.

zh-CN.summary: 酪氨酸（也称为 L-酪氨酸和 4-羟基苯丙氨酸）是一种非必需氨基酸，是人体内多巴胺、肾上腺素和去甲肾上腺素的前体。据报道，作为补充剂，它可以起到温和的兴奋剂的作用。它也是细胞用来合成蛋白质的 22 种氨基酸之一，在许多高蛋白食物中含量丰富，如鸡肉、火鸡、鱼、干酪、奶酪、酸奶、杏仁、牛奶、鳄梨、香蕉、花生、南瓜子、芝麻和豆制品。一些证据表明，在某些条件下，尤其是压力下，补充酪氨酸会影响工作记忆任务的表现。酪氨酸可以增强聚合（双任务）思维。在一项研究中，酪氨酸甚至似乎可以逆转睡眠剥夺对认知能力的一些有害影响。然而，如果酪氨酸通过提高儿茶酚胺水平来提高工作记忆性能，那么这种效果很容易是短暂的。一些动物研究表明多巴胺水平很快恢复到基线。

zh-CN.summary: α-甲基色胺（也称为 Indopan，通常称为 αMT 或 aMT）是色胺类中一种鲜为人知的内生物质。 αMT 最初由 Upjohn 在 20 世纪 60 年代开发。它在苏联曾短暂用作抗抑郁药，商品名为 Indopan。 Indopan 的处方剂量为 5-10 毫克，明显低于用于娱乐效果的剂量。 Erowid 收到了“一些无法证实的关于服用高剂量（口服超过 60 毫克）αMT 后住院的报告”。在英格兰和威尔士，有 22 例死亡与 αMT 有关，该药物从 2012 年开始作为合法兴奋剂广受欢迎，直至 2015 年初被禁止。有关 aMT 的药理特性、代谢和毒性的数据有限，而且人类非医疗用途的历史也有限。如果使用这种物质，强烈建议采取减少危害的做法。

zh-CN.summary: βk-2C-B（也称为 Bk-2C-B 或 β-酮 2C-B）是苯乙胺类的新型迷幻物质。它是2C-B的结构类似物。主观效果包括睁眼和闭眼视觉、时间扭曲、欣快感和自我丧失。与 2C-B 相比，它的效果通常被描述为更加刺激、更少迷幻，且持续时间明显更长。 βk-2C-B 相对不常见，在 2014 年由在线供应商作为新型精神活性物质分发之前，几乎没有人类使用的历史。关于 βk-2C-B 的药理学特性、代谢和毒性的数据非常少。因此，建议用户在选择使用这种新颖且知之甚少的致幻物质时采取适当的预防措施和减少危害的做法。

indications: 本条目为社区资料物质，未核验获批临床适应证；不提供适应证或用药建议。
contraindications: 未找到经监管说明书核实的禁忌证；如有心血管、精神、肝肾疾病、妊娠或正在服药，使用前应咨询专业人员。
majorWarnings: 迷幻剂可导致感知扭曲、焦虑、惊恐、偏执和精神病性症状；个体反应差异大，单一使用也可能触发潜在精神障碍。
社区资料记录的毒性：中毒剂量未知。
依赖与滥用风险：通常不形成习惯性使用。
耐受性：摄入后几乎立即出现；半耐受恢复约 3 日；完全恢复约 7 日。
以上为社区资料整理，不等同于药品说明书或临床警告；避免混合使用和独自使用，出现严重症状立即就医。
majorInteractions: 社区资料未提供系统相互作用清单；不能据此排除未知相互作用。避免与酒精、镇静剂、兴奋剂或其他精神活性物质混用。
monitoring: 监测心理状态、体温和水分；在安全、熟悉的环境中使用并有人陪伴。
出现持续惊恐、偏执、精神病性症状或自伤风险时寻求帮助。

en.summary: βk-2C-B (also known as Bk-2C-B, or beta-keto 2C-B) is a novel psychedelic substance of the phenethylamine class.

indications: Community-documented substance; no approved clinical indication was verified. No indication or prescribing advice is provided.
contraindications: No contraindication verified against a regulatory label. Cardiovascular, psychiatric, hepatic, renal, pregnancy and medication factors require professional review.
majorWarnings: Psychedelics can cause perceptual distortion, anxiety, panic, paranoia and psychotic symptoms. Individual reactions vary, and a single use may trigger latent mental illness.
Community-reported toxicity: toxic dose is unknown.
Dependence and abuse potential: not habit-forming.
Tolerance: full tolerance almost immediately after ingestion; half tolerance recovery about 3 days; full recovery about 7 days.
This is community documentation, not a product label or clinical warning. Avoid mixing and using alone; seek emergency care for severe symptoms.
majorInteractions: Community sources do not provide a structured interaction list; unknown interactions cannot be excluded. Avoid alcohol, sedatives, stimulants and other psychoactive substances.
monitoring: Monitor mental state, temperature and hydration; use in a safe, familiar setting with a trusted person present.
Seek help for persistent panic, paranoia, psychotic symptoms or self-harm risk.
